product.sentenceEn: The decline of civil discourse stems in part from the fact that it is so easy for people to watch news about, buy products from, and engage—in both the virtual and real worlds—only with those of similar backgrounds and ideologies.
product.translationZh: 公民话语的衰落，部分源于人们可以轻易地只关注与自己背景和意识形态相似者的新闻、购买他们的产品，并在虚拟和现实世界中仅与这类人互动。

product.sentenceEn: However, abandoning meat and meat products is not the environmental panacea(万灵药) many would have us believe.
product.translationZh: 然而，放弃肉类及肉制品并非许多人所认为的环境万灵药。

product.sentenceEn: The back of the bottom shelf is the coldest spot in the fridge, so store perishable dairy products here to keep them edible longer.
product.translationZh: 冰箱底层搁板的后部是最冷的区域，因此应将易腐乳制品存放在这里，以延长其食用期限。
product.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

product.sentenceEn: According to market data enterprises, Americans spend nearly 10 billion dollars a year on self-help and personal-organization products .
product.translationZh: 根据市场数据企业统计，美国人每年在自助和个人组织类产品上的花费近100亿美元。
product.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

product.sentenceEn: The author doesn't believe giving up meat and meat products will be a cure-all for the environmental problem.
product.translationZh: 作者认为放弃肉类及肉制品并非解决环境问题的万能良药。

product.sentenceEn: Proper placement facilitates access to food products .
product.translationZh: 合理的摆放便于取用食品。

positive.sentenceEn: Annual summer reading programs also have a positive impact on student performance and, according to a 2010 study conducted by Dominican University's Graduate School of Library and Information Science, students' reading skills get a boost from these popular nationwide events.
positive.translationZh: 年度暑期阅读计划对学生表现也有积极影响。根据多米尼加大学图书馆与信息科学研究生院2010年的一项研究，这些在全国范围内广受欢迎的活动有助于提高学生的阅读能力。

positive.sentenceEn: It's so, so simple, yet has an immediate, positive impact on our thinking.
positive.translationZh: 它就是这么简单，却能立即对我们的思维产生积极影响。
positive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第10句

positive.sentenceEn: This can be a positive distraction.
positive.translationZh: 这可以是一种积极的分散注意力的方式。

positive.sentenceEn: A paper by Bowker and her colleagues was the first to show that a type of social withdrawal could have a positive effect—they found that creativity was linked specifically to unsociability.
positive.translationZh: Bowker及其同事的一篇论文首次表明，某种类型的社交退缩可能产生积极影响——他们发现创造力与不合群特质存在特定关联。

positive.sentenceEn: What does the speaker say has an immediate positive impact on our thinking?
positive.translationZh: 说话者认为什么对我们的思维有直接的积极影响？

positive.sentenceEn: They have tried to create a positive learning environment.
positive.translationZh: 他们努力营造了积极的学习环境。

power.sentenceEn: Hence, the sparkling cape was paired with a traditional power suit you would typically see in a business setting.
power.translationZh: 因此，这件闪亮的披风搭配了一套传统的权力套装，这种套装在商务场合中极为常见。
power.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

power.sentenceEn: It's a simple, yet profound change in perception, and what I love about it is the power it has to instantly shift us up a gear.
power.translationZh: 这是一种简单却深刻的观念转变，而我喜欢它的一点是，它拥有瞬间推动我们提升一个层次的力量。
power.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第9句

power.sentenceEn: Simulators are most often utilized within industries such as nuclear power , aviation and surgery where failure results in disastrous consequences.
power.translationZh: 模拟器最常用于核电、航空和外科手术等行业，在这些领域中，失误可能导致灾难性后果。
power.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

power.sentenceEn: One study found that people with a high tendency to seek power were more likely to give advice than those with an opposite tendency.
power.translationZh: 一项研究发现，权力欲较强的人比权力欲较低的人更倾向于向他人提供建议。
power.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

power.sentenceEn: On one side are purists who believe nuclear power isn't worth the risk and the exclusive solution to the climate crisis is renewable energy.
power.translationZh: 一方是纯粹主义者，他们认为核能不值得冒险，应对气候危机的唯一解决方案是可再生能源。
power.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

power.sentenceEn: Draw intricate patterns onto a traditional power suit.
power.translationZh: 在传统西装上绘制精致复杂的图案。

process.sentenceEn: For example, an analysis published in 2009 by the World Watch Institute based in Washington, D.C. asserted that 51 percent of global greenhouse gas emissions come from rearing and processing livestock.
process.translationZh: 例如，总部位于华盛顿特区的世界观察研究所2009年发表的一项分析断言，全球51%的温室气体排放来自牲畜的饲养和加工。

process.sentenceEn: Those monitoring the process towards salary equity at work have long watched as progress slowed in many countries around the world.
process.translationZh: 长期以来，那些关注职场薪酬公平进程的人们注意到，全球许多国家的进展都在放缓。
process.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

process.sentenceEn: Simulations provide an immersive learning experience where skills, processes and knowledge all can be highlighted in a way reality cannot.
process.translationZh: 模拟提供沉浸式学习体验，能够以现实无法实现的方式突出技能、流程和知识。
process.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

process.sentenceEn: "These days, we tend to believe that creativity emerges from a decidedly unreserved socialising process , but in fact it requires sustained attention and deep focus," she says.
process.translationZh: 她说：“如今，我们往往认为创造力源于一种毫无保留的社交过程，但实际上它需要持续的专注和深度的投入。”

process.sentenceEn: Few commodities in American homes are not reliant on people abroad in the process of manufacture and sale.
process.translationZh: 美国家庭中，很少有商品在生产和销售过程中不依赖国外人员。

process.sentenceEn: The process towards salary equity at work began to reverse.
process.translationZh: 职场薪酬公平的进程开始出现逆转。

project.sentenceEn: With projects like the Massachussets Memories Road Show and the Veterans History Project , evidence of the importance of archives is everywhere.
project.translationZh: 从马萨诸塞记忆巡回展和退伍军人历史项目等计划中可以看出，档案的重要性无处不在。

project.sentenceEn: Beyond ensuring that library construction projects consider environmental impact, libraries can take a lead in supporting local foods and craftsmen, like the Peabody Institute Library's partnering with local businesses to pioneer a farmers' market in their courtyard, or the Richmond Public Library's seed lending library which "nurtures locally-adapted plant varieties, and fosters community resilience(韧性), self-reliance and a culture of sharing."
project.translationZh: 除了确保图书馆建设项目考虑环境影响外，图书馆还可以带头支持本地食品和手工艺人，例如皮博迪研究所图书馆与当地企业合作，在其庭院开创农贸市场，或者里士满公共图书馆的种子借阅图书馆，该图书馆“培育适应当地的植物品种，培养社区韧性、自力更生和分享文化。”

project.sentenceEn: An archivist is an advocate for preservation who, among other things, coordinates the restoration of maps and paintings, the digitization of vital records, and the creation of oral history projects .
project.translationZh: 档案管理员是保护工作的倡导者，其职责包括协调地图与画作的修复、重要记录的数字化以及口述历史项目的创建等工作。

project.sentenceEn: If it's something you'll be coming back to, like a project for work, make a note to remind yourself where you left off.
project.translationZh: 如果你以后还会回过头来处理某些事情，比如工作项目，那么最好做个记录，提醒自己上次做到了哪里。
project.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

project.sentenceEn: Archives preserve historic artifacts, oral histories, digital history projects , and scholarly writings relevant to the community, including minority groups.
project.translationZh: 档案馆保存与社区相关的历史文物、口述历史、数字历史项目和学术著作，包括少数群体的相关资料。

project.sentenceEn: How does the speaker approach her research project ?
project.translationZh: 演讲者是如何处理她的研究项目的？

professor.sentenceEn: Ralph Whitehead, a professor of journalism at the University of Massachusetts at Amherst, thinks it's because Boston's upper class used manners to make class distinctions.
professor.translationZh: 马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校新闻学教授拉尔夫·怀特黑德认为，这是因为波士顿的上层阶级用礼仪来区分社会阶层。
professor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第9句

professor.sentenceEn: Boston College professor Thomas O'Connor thinks a contributing factor is Boston's history as a city where each new group of immigrants was treated with suspicion and exclusion.
professor.translationZh: 波士顿学院教授托马斯·奥康纳认为，一个促成因素是波士顿的历史——这座城市中每一波新移民都曾遭受怀疑与排斥。
professor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

professor.sentenceEn: "It'll probably be a very long time before we see a five-star robot-chef," says Noel Sharkey, professor of AI and robotics at the University of Sheffield.
professor.translationZh: 谢菲尔德大学人工智能与机器人学教授诺埃尔·沙基表示：“要看到五星级机器人厨师，可能还需要很长一段时间。”

professor.sentenceEn: In a recent startling and thoughtful book, two scholars — Brett Frischmann, a law professor , and Evan Selinger, a philosopher — argue that the answer to that question is "yes".
professor.translationZh: 在最近出版的一本发人深省、令人震惊的著作中，两位学者——法学教授布雷特·弗里希曼和哲学家埃文·塞林格——认为，那个问题的答案是肯定的。
professor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

professor.sentenceEn: Professor Oliver claims that individualism is actually bad for society, and only by realising we are part of a bigger entity can we solve pressing environmental and societal problems.
professor.translationZh: 奥利弗教授认为，个人主义实际上对社会有害，只有认识到我们是更大整体的一部分，我们才能解决紧迫的环境和社会问题。
professor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

professor.sentenceEn: What did Professor Gang Pan of the Chinese Academy of Sciences say about their study?
professor.translationZh: 中国科学院的潘纲教授对他们的研究有何评价？

policy.sentenceEn: How we choose to think of school absences matters for educational policy .
policy.translationZh: 我们如何看待学生缺课问题，对教育政策制定至关重要。
policy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

policy.sentenceEn: These policies assume that missing school for any reason harms children academically because they are missing classroom instruction.
policy.translationZh: 这些政策认为，无论何种原因缺课都会对儿童的学业造成负面影响，因为他们错过了课堂教学。
policy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第1句

policy.sentenceEn: School attendance policies typically hold schools and families accountable for the days children miss, regardless of whether they were excused or unexcused absences.
policy.translationZh: 学校出勤政策通常要求学校和家庭对儿童缺课天数负责，无论这些缺勤是有正当理由还是无正当理由。
policy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第2句

policy.sentenceEn: As a result, these attendance policies end up disproportionately punishing families dealing with out-of-school crises in their lives and pressuring schools who serve them to get students to school more often.
policy.translationZh: 结果是，这些出勤政策最终不成比例地惩罚了那些正经历校外生活危机的家庭，并给为这些家庭服务的学校带来压力，要求它们提高学生的到校率。
policy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第1句

policy.sentenceEn: What is the assumption underlying education policies in the U.S.?
policy.translationZh: 美国教育政策的基本假设是什么？

policy.sentenceEn: They are matters the American government typically ignores when formulating educational policies .
policy.translationZh: 这些都是美国政府在制定教育政策时通常会忽视的问题。

performance.sentenceEn: Free tutoring, homework help programs, and summer reading programs for kids and teens help bridge the economic divide that impacts students' academic performance .
performance.translationZh: 为儿童和青少年提供的免费辅导、作业帮助项目和暑期阅读计划，有助于弥合影响学生学业表现的经济鸿沟。

performance.sentenceEn: Annual summer reading programs also have a positive impact on student performance and, according to a 2010 study conducted by Dominican University's Graduate School of Library and Information Science, students' reading skills get a boost from these popular nationwide events.
performance.translationZh: 年度暑期阅读计划对学生表现也有积极影响。根据多米尼加大学图书馆与信息科学研究生院2010年的一项研究，这些在全国范围内广受欢迎的活动有助于提高学生的阅读能力。

performance.sentenceEn: Now, let's look at Peter's interview performance .
performance.translationZh: 现在，让我们来看看彼得的面试表现。
performance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

performance.sentenceEn: Practicing self-compassion increases your resilience(韧性), emotional intelligence, compassion toward others, and can boost your performance as well as help you develop a growth mindset.
performance.translationZh: 练习自我同情能增强你的韧性、情商以及对他人的同理心，同时还能提升你的表现，并帮助你培养成长型思维。

performance.sentenceEn: So, to gain access to an automated service that will benefit financially from my input, I first have to do some unpaid labor to help improve the performance of autonomous vehicles.
performance.translationZh: 所以，为了获得一项能从我的输入中获利的自动化服务，我首先得干些义务劳动，去帮他们改进自动驾驶汽车的性能。
performance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

performance.sentenceEn: Excused absences lead to comparatively better school performance .
performance.translationZh: 正当缺席导致相对更好的学业表现。

publish.sentenceEn: In a review published in the journal *Trends in Cognitive Sciences* on February 11th, researchers propose an explanation for why this might be happening: the brains of older adults allocate more space to accumulated knowledge and have more material to navigate when attempting to access memories.
publish.translationZh: 在2月11日发表于《认知科学趋势》期刊的一篇综述中，研究人员对这种现象提出了一种解释：老年人的大脑为积累的知识分配了更多空间，在试图提取记忆时需要处理更多信息。
publish.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

publish.sentenceEn: In 2006 the United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) published a study titled "Livestock's Long Shadow," which received widespread international attention.
publish.translationZh: 2006年，联合国粮食及农业组织（FAO）发布了一项题为《畜牧业的长影》的研究报告，引起了国际社会的广泛关注。

publish.sentenceEn: For example, an analysis published in 2009 by the World Watch Institute based in Washington, D.C. asserted that 51 percent of global greenhouse gas emissions come from rearing and processing livestock.
publish.translationZh: 例如，总部位于华盛顿特区的世界观察研究所2009年发表的一项分析断言，全球51%的温室气体排放来自牲畜的饲养和加工。

publish.sentenceEn: Now, the Journal of Applied Social Psychology has published a new study exploring the reasons for these effects.
publish.translationZh: 现在，《应用社会心理学杂志》发表了一项新研究，旨在探讨这些影响背后的原因。
publish.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

publish.sentenceEn: One pioneer marine scientist thinks archaeologists should make greater efforts to publish their findings.
publish.translationZh: 一位海洋科学先驱认为，考古学家应该更加努力地发表他们的研究成果。

publish.sentenceEn: They are going to publish their research findings in the journal Science Robotics.
publish.translationZh: 他们计划将研究成果发表在《科学·机器人学》期刊上。

potential.sentenceEn: Potential employers showed greater interest in passionate applicants in part because they believed the applicants would work hard at their jobs without expecting an increase in pay.
potential.translationZh: 潜在雇主对充满热情的求职者表现出更大兴趣，部分原因是他们认为这些求职者会在工作中努力付出，而不期望加薪。
potential.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第3句

potential.sentenceEn: The final consideration is a financial one, potential B&B hosts must be realistic about opportunities for income.
potential.translationZh: 最后一个要考虑的是财务问题，潜在的民宿经营者必须对收入前景抱有务实的态度。
potential.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第7句

potential.sentenceEn: Having the skills to foresee potential traps and treat employees' endurance with care allows leaders to provide effective short-term deterrents to MRS.
potential.translationZh: 具备预见潜在陷阱的能力并谨慎对待员工耐力的领导者，能够为MRS提供有效的短期遏制措施。

potential.sentenceEn: Researchers are trying to unlock the potential of these ignored crops—plants they describe as forgotten, under-used or "alternative" as they are displaced by increasingly uniform diets fuelled by processed ingredients from the major crops.
potential.translationZh: 研究人员正试图发掘这些被忽视作物的潜力——他们称这些作物为被遗忘、未被充分利用或"替代"作物，因为在主要作物加工原料推动下日益单一化的饮食结构已经将它们挤出了人们的餐桌。

potential.sentenceEn: What does the speaker say potential B&B hosts must be realistic about?
potential.translationZh: 发言人认为潜在的民宿房东必须对什么抱有现实的态度？

potential.sentenceEn: It is a potential market for food and beverage.
potential.translationZh: 这是一个潜在的食品饮料市场。

participant.sentenceEn: To maximize benefits from simulation, participants should immediately apply the learning from the experience to forge a smooth link between learning and doing.
participant.translationZh: 为了充分发挥模拟训练的效益，参与者应立即将从中获得的经验应用于实践，从而在学习与行动之间建立顺畅的联系。
participant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第5句

participant.sentenceEn: To maximize the value from a simulation learning experience, participants should immediately and directly apply their learning to a specific intervention within their organization.
participant.translationZh: 为了从模拟学习体验中获得最大价值，参与者应立即将所学知识直接应用于组织内的特定干预措施中。
participant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

participant.sentenceEn: Allowing participants to enter a simulated environment provides them with the opportunity to experience alternative realities which can prompt them to rethink their current beliefs.
participant.translationZh: 让参与者进入模拟环境，能为他们提供体验另类现实的机会，这可能促使他们重新思考自己当前的信念。
participant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

participant.sentenceEn: At the end of the successful simulation, participants must declare "this is us."
participant.translationZh: 模拟成功结束时，参与者必须宣告“这就是我们”。
participant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

participant.sentenceEn: An effective simulation can be better than experience as a learning tool because it accelerates time, compresses space, and unlike reality, is specifically designed to maximize participant learning.
participant.translationZh: 作为一种学习工具，有效的模拟可能比实际经验更优越，因为它能加速时间、压缩空间，而且与现实不同，模拟是专门为最大限度提升参与者学习效果而设计的。
participant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

participant.sentenceEn: What should participants do in a simulation to reap the greatest benefits possible?
participant.translationZh: 参与者在模拟活动中应如何做才能获得最大收益？

physical.sentenceEn: Through library collections, programs, and physical spaces, children learn to share, to be engaged in their communities, to participate in the arts, and to explore their immediate world and the world at large.
physical.translationZh: 通过图书馆的馆藏资源、活动项目和实体空间，孩子们学会分享，参与社区活动，投身艺术体验，并探索身边世界及更广阔的天地。

physical.sentenceEn: There are other benefits, both mental and physical , to staying consistently active that we should not disregard.
physical.translationZh: 保持规律运动对身心健康都有其他不容忽视的好处。
physical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

physical.sentenceEn: The twist is that this exclusion occurs while sharing a physical encounter and having a conversation.
physical.translationZh: 出人意料的是，这种排斥恰恰发生在双方进行身体接触和面对面交谈的过程中。
physical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

physical.sentenceEn: Now, a British academic has claimed that human individuality is indeed just an illusion, because societies are far more interconnected at a mental, physical , and cultural level than people realise.
physical.translationZh: 如今，一位英国学者声称，人类的个体性实际上只是一种错觉，因为社会在心理、生理和文化层面的相互联系远比人们意识到的要紧密得多。
physical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

physical.sentenceEn: What does the passage say about beauty in the physical world?
physical.translationZh: 这篇文章对物质世界中的美有何论述？

physical.sentenceEn: Their belief about physical punishment changed.
physical.translationZh: 他们对体罚的看法发生了改变。

professional.sentenceEn: As a sociologist, I interviewed college students and professional workers to learn what it really meant to pursue their dreams, which I will refer to here as the passion principle.
professional.translationZh: 作为一名社会学家，我采访了大学生和职场人士，以了解追求梦想的真正含义——我在此将其称为"激情原则"。
professional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

professional.sentenceEn: Any job that involves people requires good interpersonal skills, and any law professional needs to be very eloquent at articulating that argument.
professional.translationZh: 任何涉及人际交往的工作都需要良好的人际沟通能力，而任何法律专业人士都需要非常善于清晰地阐述论点。
professional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第2句

professional.sentenceEn: But for many professional cooks, the phrase means something deeper.
professional.translationZh: 但对许多专业厨师而言，这个说法有着更深层的含义。
professional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

professional.sentenceEn: The market is huge, partly because most colleges and graduate schools don't teach basic organization, but cooking schools and professional kitchens do.
professional.translationZh: 这个市场十分庞大，部分原因是大多数学院和研究生院不教授基本的组织管理技能，而烹饪学校和专业厨房却会教授。
professional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

professional.sentenceEn: What does the man think is required of any law professional ?
professional.translationZh: 这位男士认为法律专业人士需要具备哪些素质？

professional.sentenceEn: Both Rachel and Peter came across as respectful and professional .
professional.translationZh: 雷切尔和彼得都给人以尊重他人、专业可靠的印象。

promote.sentenceEn: Colleges, workplaces and career counselors who promote the "follow your passion" path for everyone, without leveling the playing field, help perpetuate socioeconomic inequalities among career aspirants.
promote.translationZh: 大学、工作场所和职业顾问向所有人宣扬"追随激情"的道路，却不创造公平的竞争环境，这会加剧职业追求者之间的社会经济不平等。
promote.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

promote.sentenceEn: By both actively promoting civil discourse through these programs, and modeling and upholding the principles of free inquiry and expression for all, libraries help individuals rediscover the importance of and increased need for civil discourse in American life.
promote.translationZh: 图书馆通过这些项目积极促进文明对话，并为所有人树立和坚持自由探究与表达的原则，帮助个人重新认识到文明对话在美国生活中的重要性和日益增长的必要性。

promote.sentenceEn: I also found that promoting the pursuit of one's passion helps perpetuate social inequalities due to the fact that not everyone has the same economic resources to allow them to pursue their passion with ease.
promote.translationZh: 我还发现，宣扬追求个人热情会加剧社会不平等，因为并非每个人都拥有同样的经济资源，能够轻松追求自己的热爱。
promote.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

promote.sentenceEn: The WHO recommends establishing institutions that facilitate community participation—educational programs and interventions that provide skills for promoting mental wellbeing.
promote.translationZh: 世界卫生组织建议建立促进社区参与的机构——提供促进心理健康技能的教育项目和干预措施。
promote.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

promote.sentenceEn: Building connections between farms and major purchasers of their produce can promote African farmers' use of advanced farming techniques.
promote.translationZh: 建立农场与其农产品主要采购商之间的联系，能够促进非洲农民采用先进的耕作技术。

promote.sentenceEn: Learn from the world's major cities in promoting tourism.
promote.translationZh: 向世界主要城市学习旅游推广经验

protein.sentenceEn: But as water disappears, the proteins self-assemble into long fibers that fill the cell's interior.
protein.translationZh: 但随着水分消失，蛋白质会自组装成长纤维，填充细胞内部。
protein.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

protein.sentenceEn: The fibers support the cell's membranes(细胞膜) and proteins , preventing them from breaking or unfolding.
protein.translationZh: 这些纤维支撑着细胞的细胞膜和蛋白质，防止它们断裂或展开。
protein.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

protein.sentenceEn: In my view, there are many reasons for either choosing animal protein or opting for a vegetarian selection.
protein.translationZh: 在我看来，选择动物蛋白或素食有诸多原因。

protein.sentenceEn: In water, the proteins are shapeless.
protein.translationZh: 在水中，蛋白质呈无定形状态。
protein.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

protein.sentenceEn: Protein supplements may overburden some internal organs, thus leading to their malfunctioning.
protein.translationZh: 蛋白质补充剂可能会给某些内部器官带来过度负担，从而导致它们功能失调。

protein.sentenceEn: How Much Protein Do You Really Need?
protein.translationZh: 你究竟需要多少蛋白质？

peer.sentenceEn: In fact, children with no unexcused absences—but 15 to 18 excused absences—have test scores equal to their peers who have no absences.
peer.translationZh: 事实上，没有无故缺勤但有15至18天正当缺勤的儿童，其考试成绩与全勤的同龄人相当。
peer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

peer.sentenceEn: Surveys revealed that working-class and first-generation college graduates, regardless of their career field, are more likely than their wealthier peers to end up in low-paying unskilled jobs when they pursue their passion.
peer.translationZh: 调查显示，工薪阶层和第一代大学毕业生无论从事何种职业领域，当他们追求自己热爱的事业时，比家境更优渥的同龄人更有可能从事低薪的非技术性工作。
peer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第5句

peer.sentenceEn: Meanwhile, the average child with even just one unexcused absence does much worse academically than peers with none.
peer.translationZh: 与此同时，即使只有一次无故缺课的普通儿童，其学业表现也比从未缺课的同龄人差得多。
peer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

peer.sentenceEn: Instead, people must learn them step by step, trusting in the wisdom of more experienced elders and peers .
peer.translationZh: 相反，人们必须一步步地学习这些技术，信赖更有经验的长辈和同辈的智慧。
peer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第3句

peer.sentenceEn: A study showed that dual-language students did significantly better than their peers in reading English texts.
peer.translationZh: 一项研究显示，双语项目学生在英语文本阅读方面的表现显著优于同龄人。

peer.sentenceEn: It can hinder kids from getting on with their peers .
peer.translationZh: 这会阻碍孩子与同龄人相处。

perform.sentenceEn: GDP growth is not a good indicator of how well a country is performing , and should not be the primary goal of governments.
perform.translationZh: GDP增长并非衡量一个国家表现的良好指标，也不应成为政府的首要目标。
perform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

perform.sentenceEn: Instead, young people measure their productivity levels by the quality of the work they perform .
perform.translationZh: 相反，年轻人通过他们所完成工作的质量来衡量自己的生产力水平。
perform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第2句

perform.sentenceEn: Part of their job is to intervene when workers perform a task without the proper equipment or if the conditions are unsafe.
perform.translationZh: 他们的部分工作是在工人未使用适当设备执行任务或工作条件不安全时进行干预。
perform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

perform.sentenceEn: Basically, it's a trigger to perform that particular habit.
perform.translationZh: 基本上，它是执行特定习惯的触发因素。

perform.sentenceEn: Besides being an information provider, the library performs many other important services for the community.
perform.translationZh: 图书馆除了提供信息外，还为社区提供许多其他重要服务。

perform.sentenceEn: Older adults generally perform cognitive tasks much slower than young adults.
perform.translationZh: 老年人执行认知任务的速度通常比年轻人慢得多。

political.sentenceEn: Rather, the slow progress of women in politics is a tale of two political parties.
political.translationZh: 相反，女性在政治领域的进展缓慢，是一个关于两大政党的故事。
political.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

political.sentenceEn: The slow progress of women in elective office is frustrating for some political observers and experts—including myself.
political.translationZh: 女性在民选职位上的进展缓慢，这让包括我在内的一些政治观察家和专家感到沮丧。
political.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

political.sentenceEn: The political limit has also been reached in some places, with citizens meeting the construction of new wind turbines with loud protests.
political.translationZh: 在一些地方，政治层面的限制也已显现，民众对新建风力涡轮机的建设发出了强烈抗议。
political.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第4句

political.sentenceEn: "Its political consequences are anything but trivial".
political.translationZh: 其政治影响绝非微不足道。
political.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

political.sentenceEn: For some, this meaning is religious, some political and some interpersonal.
political.translationZh: 对一些人来说，这种意义是宗教层面的，一些是政治层面的，还有一些是人际关系层面的。
political.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

political.sentenceEn: They regard political consequences as anything but trivial.
political.translationZh: 他们认为政治后果绝非小事。

production.sentenceEn: According to the FAO's statistical database, total direct greenhouse gas emissions from U.S. livestock have declined by 11.3 percent since 1961, while production of livestock meat has more than doubled.
production.translationZh: 根据联合国粮农组织的统计数据库，自1961年以来，美国畜牧业的直接温室气体排放总量下降了11.3%，而畜禽肉类产量却增长了一倍以上。

production.sentenceEn: This included emissions from fertilizer production , converting land from forests to pastures, growing feed, and direct emissions from animals (manure as well as expelling of gas from the stomach) from birth to death.
production.translationZh: 这包括化肥生产的排放、将森林土地转为牧场的排放、饲料种植的排放，以及动物从出生到死亡期间的直接排放（包括粪便和肠胃排气）。

production.sentenceEn: According to the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, the largest sources of U.S. greenhouse gas emissions in 2016 were electricity production (28 percent of total emissions), transportation (28 percent) and industry (22 percent).
production.translationZh: 根据美国环境保护署的数据，2016年美国温室气体排放的最大来源是电力生产（占总排放量的28%）、交通运输（28%）和工业（22%）。

production.sentenceEn: Moreover, technological, genetic and management changes that have taken place in U.S. agriculture over the past 70 years have made livestock production more efficient and less greenhouse gas-intensive.
production.translationZh: 此外，过去70年来美国农业在技术、基因和管理方面发生的变革，提高了 livestock 生产的效率，同时降低了其温室气体密集度。

production.sentenceEn: Changes in America's farming technology and management in the past decades have increased efficiency and reduced greenhouse gas emissions in meat production .
production.translationZh: 过去几十年，美国农业技术和管理的变革提高了肉类生产的效率，同时减少了温室气体排放。

production.sentenceEn: They think speed of production outweighs consumers' health.
production.translationZh: 他们认为生产速度比消费者的健康更重要。

productivity.sentenceEn: Real wages have not kept pace with productivity , driving economic inequality and a decline in labor's share of income.
productivity.translationZh: 实际工资未能跟上生产率增长的步伐，这加剧了经济不平等，并导致劳动收入占比下降。
productivity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

productivity.sentenceEn: In the U.S., full time employees work an average of 8.72 hours per day despite productivity increases.
productivity.translationZh: 在美国，尽管生产力有所提高，全职员工平均每天仍工作8.72小时。
productivity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

productivity.sentenceEn: As long as the economy is their priority, governments need go no further than ensuring citizens' continued productivity .
productivity.translationZh: 只要经济是政府的首要任务，那么确保公民持续的生产力就已足够。
productivity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第6句

productivity.sentenceEn: But as long as you have regular social contact, you are choosing solitude rather than being forced into it, you have at least a few good friends and your solitude is good for your well-being or productivity , there's no point agonising over how to fit a square personality into a round hole.
productivity.translationZh: 但只要你有正常的社交往来，是主动选择独处而非被迫独处，至少有几个好朋友，并且这种独处对你的身心健康或工作效率有益，那么就没必要纠结如何把方方正正的性格硬塞进圆洞里了。

productivity.sentenceEn: How do young people measure their productivity levels according to the man?
productivity.translationZh: 据那个人所说，年轻人是如何衡量自己的生产力水平的？

productivity.sentenceEn: Governments should set sustained productivity as their top priority.
productivity.translationZh: 政府应将持续提高生产力作为首要任务。

particularly.sentenceEn: Given the link between persistence and academic success, decisions about efforts are particularly important in childhood.
particularly.translationZh: 鉴于毅力与学业成功之间的联系，关于付出努力的决策在童年时期尤为重要。
particularly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

particularly.sentenceEn: While women are underrepresented in governments around the globe, it is a particularly formidable problem in the United States.
particularly.translationZh: 尽管全球各国政府中女性代表人数不足，但这一问题在美国尤为严峻。
particularly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

particularly.sentenceEn: The latter is particularly important given the global obesity epidemic.
particularly.translationZh: 考虑到全球肥胖症的流行，后者显得尤为重要。
particularly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

particularly.sentenceEn: A lot of headlines about moons are just ridiculous (you do not need to be particularly excited about a blue moon, it just looks like a regular full moon), but you should definitely roll out of bed to look at a blood moon if one is going to be visible in your region, even though they're just lunar eclipses and not evidence of bloody battles between the sky gods.
particularly.translationZh: 许多关于月亮的新闻标题都很荒谬（你不必对蓝月亮特别兴奋，它看起来就像普通的满月），但如果你的地区能看到血月，你绝对应该起床去看看，尽管它们只是月食，并非天空诸神之间血腥战斗的证据。

particularly.sentenceEn: Why does the author say "witnessing companies…feels particularly irritating"(Lines 2-4, Para. 6)?
particularly.translationZh: 为什么作者说“看到像脸书这样的公司将元宇宙标榜为下一个伟大前沿，而学童们却在为完成家庭作业而苦苦挣扎，这尤其令人恼火”（第6段第2-4行）？

particularly.sentenceEn: They are particularly sensitive to strange smells.
particularly.translationZh: 它们对陌生气味尤为敏感。

pressure.sentenceEn: But unless changes are made to the structure of work, automation will simply exert downward pressure on wages and further diminish work opportunities.
pressure.translationZh: 但除非对工作结构进行改革，否则自动化只会对工资造成下行压力，并进一步减少就业机会。
pressure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

pressure.sentenceEn: As a result, these attendance policies end up disproportionately punishing families dealing with out-of-school crises in their lives and pressuring schools who serve them to get students to school more often.
pressure.translationZh: 结果是，这些出勤政策最终不成比例地惩罚了那些正经历校外生活危机的家庭，并给为这些家庭服务的学校带来压力，要求它们提高学生的到校率。
pressure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第1句

pressure.sentenceEn: It has been found that listening to classical music significantly reduces a person's blood pressure .
pressure.translationZh: 研究发现，聆听古典音乐能显著降低人的血压。
pressure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

pressure.sentenceEn: In the physical world, the struggle goes against the underlying pressure exerted on women to conform to an unrealistic beauty ideal.
pressure.translationZh: 在现实世界中，这场抗争是为了对抗迫使女性符合不切实际的 beauty 标准的潜在压力。
pressure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

pressure.sentenceEn: The pressure is on, so you want all the help you can get to aid your memory and raise your grades.
pressure.translationZh: 压力越来越大，所以你会想尽一切办法来帮助记忆，提高成绩。
pressure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

pressure.sentenceEn: Women are under constant pressure to keep up with beauty models.
pressure.translationZh: 女性一直承受着紧跟 beauty models 的压力。

purchase.sentenceEn: Once that happens, the bags are donated to charity, sold at auction, or purchased by a company which sells them to the public.
purchase.translationZh: 一旦发生这种情况，这些包会被捐赠给慈善机构，或通过拍卖售出，抑或由某家公司收购后再向公众出售。
purchase.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

purchase.sentenceEn: After Professor Ward purchased the land, Jackson and his family purchased a 655 acre parcel a few miles away and moved there.
purchase.translationZh: 沃德教授买下这片土地后，杰克逊和他的家人在几英里外购买了一块655英亩的土地，并搬到了那里。

purchase.sentenceEn: Money allows us to purchase the work of others without giving any thought to them as human beings.
purchase.translationZh: 金钱让我们能够购买他人的劳动，却不必将他们视为有血有肉的人来考虑。

purchase.sentenceEn: With the average house in the city costing over $1.25 million and average flat prices over $1.11 million, the minimum qualifying income to purchase a house has increased to $254,000.
purchase.translationZh: 目前，旧金山市内房屋均价超过125万美元，公寓均价超过111万美元，这使得购房所需的最低合格收入已升至25.4万美元。

purchase.sentenceEn: Professor Ward paid Jackson over one thousand dollars when purchasing a piece of land from him.
purchase.translationZh: 沃德教授从杰克逊手中购买一块土地时，向他支付了一千多美元。

purchase.sentenceEn: Purchase irretrievably lost things at auction.
purchase.translationZh: 在拍卖会上购买无法挽回的失物。

principle.sentenceEn: By both actively promoting civil discourse through these programs, and modeling and upholding the principles of free inquiry and expression for all, libraries help individuals rediscover the importance of and increased need for civil discourse in American life.
principle.translationZh: 图书馆通过这些项目积极促进文明对话，并为所有人树立和坚持自由探究与表达的原则，帮助个人重新认识到文明对话在美国生活中的重要性和日益增长的必要性。

principle.sentenceEn: Surveys show the American public has long held the passion principle in high regard as a career decision-making priority.
principle.translationZh: 调查显示，长期以来，美国公众高度重视以热情为原则的职业决策优先事项。
principle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

principle.sentenceEn: I was stunned by what I found out about this principle in the research for my new book.
principle.translationZh: 在为新书做研究时，我发现的关于这个原理的情况让我震惊不已。
principle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

principle.sentenceEn: Advocates of the passion principle found it compelling because they believed that following one's passion can provide workers with both the motivation necessary to work hard and a place to find fulfillment.
principle.translationZh: 激情原则的拥护者认为这一理念极具吸引力，因为他们相信，追随个人激情不仅能为工作者提供努力工作所需的动力，还能为其找到成就感提供途径。
principle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

principle.sentenceEn: How did the author feel about the passion principle through his research?
principle.translationZh: 作者通过研究对激情原则有何感受？

principle.sentenceEn: It establishes the principles of beauty in a number of ways.
principle.translationZh: 它从多个方面确立了美的原则。

psychologist.sentenceEn: One of the other things is, rather than just taking one perspective, so rather than looking at aging and health just from the perspective of the psychologist , we are now bringing together a lot of different techniques and a lot of different viewpoints to actually look at the sort of different factors affecting health.
psychologist.translationZh: 另一个方面是，我们不再局限于单一视角——不再仅从心理学家的角度研究衰老与健康，而是汇集了多种不同的技术和观点，来探究影响健康的各类因素。
psychologist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第6句

psychologist.sentenceEn: A recent justification of these ideas came from University at Buffalo psychologist Julie Bowker, who researches social withdrawal.
psychologist.translationZh: 布法罗大学的心理学家朱莉·鲍克（Julie Bowker）近期为这些观点提供了理论依据，她专门研究社交退缩行为。

psychologist.sentenceEn: According to psychologists , when you have less to work with, you actually begin to see the world differently.
psychologist.translationZh: 心理学家认为，当你可利用的资源减少时，你实际上会开始以不同的视角看待世界。
psychologist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

psychologist.sentenceEn: I myself have been a shop assistant, a waitress, a student, a graduate, and a clinical psychologist .
psychologist.translationZh: 我自己曾做过店员、服务员、学生、毕业生，现在是一名临床心理学家。
psychologist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第7句

psychologist.sentenceEn: What do psychologists say people do when they are short of resources?
psychologist.translationZh: 心理学家认为，当人们资源短缺时会怎么做？

psychologist.sentenceEn: It compels them to visit a clinical psychologist .
psychologist.translationZh: 这迫使他们去看临床心理学家。

per.sentenceEn: In the U.S., full time employees work an average of 8.72 hours per day despite productivity increases.
per.translationZh: 在美国，尽管生产力有所提高，全职员工平均每天仍工作8.72小时。
per.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

per.sentenceEn: But meat consumption per person in these regions still lags that of developed countries.
per.translationZh: 但这些地区的人均肉类消费量仍落后于发达国家。

per.sentenceEn: Meat is more calorie-dense per serving than vegetarian options, and ruminant animals largely thrive on feed that is not suitable for humans.
per.translationZh: 每份肉类比素食选项的热量密度更高，而反刍动物主要以不适合人类食用的饲料为生。

per.sentenceEn: In 2015, average annual meat consumption per person in developed countries was 92 kilograms, compared to 24 kilograms in the Middle East and North Africa and 18 kilograms in Southeast Asia.
per.translationZh: 2015年，发达国家人均年肉类消费量为92公斤，而中东和北非地区为24公斤，东南亚地区为18公斤。

per.sentenceEn: Consumption of meat per person in developing countries is much less than that in countries like the U.S.
per.translationZh: 发展中国家的人均肉类消费量远低于美国等国家。

per.sentenceEn: People have only one social engagement per week.
per.translationZh: 人们每周只有一次社交活动。

particular.sentenceEn: The embroidery done by the women in a particular village was so exquisite.
particular.translationZh: 某个村子里妇女们做的刺绣非常精美。
particular.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

particular.sentenceEn: Basically, it's a trigger to perform that particular habit.
particular.translationZh: 基本上，它是执行特定习惯的触发因素。

particular.sentenceEn: At the headquarters of global research centre Crops For the Future (CFF) this particular under-used fruit has been turned into a sugar-free juice, high in vitamin C and getting top marks in sensory evaluations.
particular.translationZh: 在全球研究中心“未来作物”(CFF)的总部，这种未被充分利用的特殊水果已被制成无糖果汁，富含维生素C，在感官评估中获得了高分。

particular.sentenceEn: In his work, Bostrom uses the tools of philosophy and mathematics, in particular , probability theory, to try and determine how we as a species might achieve this safe passage.
particular.translationZh: 在其研究工作中，博斯特罗姆运用哲学与数学工具——尤其是概率论，试图确定我们人类作为一个物种如何才能实现这一安全过渡。
particular.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

particular.sentenceEn: Schedule time for reflection about your work or a particular project you're engaged in.
particular.translationZh: 为反思你的工作或正在参与的特定项目安排时间。
particular.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

particular.sentenceEn: Chronic loneliness does harm to senior citizens in particular .
particular.translationZh: 长期孤独对老年人的危害尤其严重。

psychology.sentenceEn: Gregory Feist, who focuses on the psychology of creativity at California's San Jose State University, has defined creativity as thinking or activity with two key elements: originality and usefulness.
psychology.translationZh: 格雷戈里·费斯特是加利福尼亚州圣何塞州立大学专注于创造力心理学研究的学者，他将创造力定义为具有两个关键要素的思维或活动：独创性和实用性。

psychology.sentenceEn: Now, the Journal of Applied Social Psychology has published a new study exploring the reasons for these effects.
psychology.translationZh: 现在，《应用社会心理学杂志》发表了一项新研究，旨在探讨这些影响背后的原因。
psychology.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

psychology.sentenceEn: The psychology behind this is called diffusion of responsibility.
psychology.translationZh: 这背后的心理学原理被称为责任分散效应。
psychology.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

psychology.sentenceEn: And yet a new paper in the Quarterly Journal of Experimental Psychology suggests that we actually have very poor awareness of our own belief change, meaning that we will tend to underestimate how much we've been swayed by a convincing article.
psychology.translationZh: 然而，《实验心理学季刊》上的一项新研究表明，我们实际上对自己的信念变化缺乏清晰的认知，这意味着我们往往会低估自己被一篇有说服力的文章所影响的程度。
psychology.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

psychology.sentenceEn: What does a new paper in the *Quarterly Journal of Experimental Psychology * suggest?
psychology.translationZh: 《实验心理学季刊》上的一篇新论文提出了什么观点？

psychology.sentenceEn: The editorial boards of the most important journals in psychology and neuroscience are male-dominated.
psychology.translationZh: 心理学和神经科学领域最重要期刊的编辑委员会以男性为主导。

powerful.sentenceEn: Yet, what I found is that following one's passion does not necessarily lead to fulfillment, but is one of the most powerful cultural forces perpetuating overwork.
powerful.translationZh: 然而，我发现追随个人热情并不一定能带来满足感，反而是促使过度工作现象持续存在的最强大文化力量之一。
powerful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

powerful.sentenceEn: Unexcused absences can be a powerful signal of how those out-of-school challenges affect children's academic progress.
powerful.translationZh: 无故缺课能有力地反映出校外挑战对儿童学业进展的影响。
powerful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

powerful.sentenceEn: But it's beginning to be better understood, because using our imagination is actually one of the most powerful things we could ever do.
powerful.translationZh: 但人们开始更好地理解这一点，因为运用想象力实际上是我们能做的最有力的事情之一。
powerful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

powerful.sentenceEn: Under the guise(外表) of unselfishness, people may be driven to give you unwanted advice because it makes them feel powerful or in control.
powerful.translationZh: 在无私的伪装下，人们可能会因为追求权力和掌控感而被迫向你提供一些你并不需要的建议。
powerful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

powerful.sentenceEn: When someone is giving advice in order to make themselves feel more powerful , there is underlying anxiety to their behavior that recipients of the advice tend to notice.
powerful.translationZh: 当一个人为了让自己感觉更有权势而提供建议时，其行为背后隐藏着一种焦虑，而这种焦虑往往会被建议的接受者察觉到。
powerful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

powerful.sentenceEn: It creates a powerful appeal through its brilliant radiance.
powerful.translationZh: 其璀璨光芒散发出强大的吸引力。

pattern.sentenceEn: While the researchers focus primarily on the difficulties that these disorderly, crowded memories may pose, they also highlight a few situations in which these same memory patterns may be useful.
pattern.translationZh: 虽然研究人员主要关注这些混乱、碎片化的记忆可能带来的困难，但他们也强调了在某些情况下，这些相同的记忆模式可能是有用的。
pattern.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

pattern.sentenceEn: Using glitter, I drew similar intricate patterns onto the velvet cape.
pattern.translationZh: 我用闪光粉在天鹅绒披风上绘制了类似的精致图案。
pattern.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第6句

pattern.sentenceEn: In addition, experts assert that starting younger is better because, if you make a habit of exercising when you are young, you are more likely to keep up those patterns later in life.
pattern.translationZh: 此外，专家断言，从年轻时开始运动效果更好，因为如果在年轻时养成锻炼习惯，你更有可能在以后的生活中保持这些模式。
pattern.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

pattern.sentenceEn: To identify key patterns and understand the underlying principles of variability effects, Raviv and her colleagues reviewed over 150 studies on variability and generalisation across fields, including computer science, linguistics, categorisation, visual perception and formal education.
pattern.translationZh: 为了识别关键模式并理解变异效应的基本原理，Raviv及其同事回顾了150多项关于不同领域变异与泛化的研究，包括计算机科学、语言学、分类学、视觉感知和正规教育。
pattern.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

pattern.sentenceEn: And why do they react so strongly to those patterns of light on a screen?
pattern.translationZh: 而他们为什么会对屏幕上的那些光影图案产生如此强烈的反应呢？
pattern.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

pattern.sentenceEn: Draw intricate patterns onto a traditional power suit.
pattern.translationZh: 在传统西装上绘制精致复杂的图案。

personality.sentenceEn: He has found that personality traits commonly associated with creativity are openness (receptiveness to new thoughts and experiences), self-confidence, and autonomy—which may include "a lack of concern for social norms" and "a preference for being alone".
personality.translationZh: 他发现，通常与创造力相关的人格特质包括开放性（乐于接受新思想和新体验）、自信心和自主性——其中可能包括“不太在意社会规范”和“喜欢独处”。

personality.sentenceEn: But as long as you have regular social contact, you are choosing solitude rather than being forced into it, you have at least a few good friends and your solitude is good for your well-being or productivity, there's no point agonising over how to fit a square personality into a round hole.
personality.translationZh: 但只要你有正常的社交往来，是主动选择独处而非被迫独处，至少有几个好朋友，并且这种独处对你的身心健康或工作效率有益，那么就没必要纠结如何把方方正正的性格硬塞进圆洞里了。

personality.sentenceEn: But this depends, among other things, on the personalities of their employees.
personality.translationZh: 但这一点，除其他因素外，取决于员工的个性。

personality.sentenceEn: One reason for this is that introverted people are less likely to feel threatened by strong personalities and suggestions.
personality.translationZh: 其中一个原因是内向的人不太容易被强势的性格和建议威胁到。

personality.sentenceEn: What do numerous personality quizzes online claim they are able to do?
personality.translationZh: 网上众多的性格测试声称它们能够做什么？

personality.sentenceEn: There are left-dominant people and right-dominant people with different personalities .
personality.translationZh: 人有左脑主导型和右脑主导型之分，他们的性格各不相同。

poverty.sentenceEn: Long working hours contribute to the feeling of "time poverty ", which has an adverse effect on psychological well-being.
poverty.translationZh: 长时间工作导致了"时间贫困"感，这对心理健康产生了不利影响。
poverty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

poverty.sentenceEn: In Western countries, at least—poor mental health is more detrimental to wellbeing than poverty .
poverty.translationZh: 至少在西方国家，心理健康不佳比贫困对幸福感的危害更大。
poverty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

poverty.sentenceEn: While it is true that globalization has put some downward pressure on middle-class wages in advanced economies in recent decades, it has also helped lift hundreds of millions of people above the global poverty line.
poverty.translationZh: 诚然，近几十年来全球化给发达经济体的中产阶级工资带来了一定下行压力，但它也帮助数亿人摆脱了全球贫困线。
poverty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

poverty.sentenceEn: Who wants to hear about the fact that every day some 200,000 people around the world are lifted above the $2-a-day poverty line?
poverty.translationZh: 谁想听每天全球约有20万人摆脱日均2美元贫困线的消息呢？
poverty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

poverty.sentenceEn: About 23% of the global population lives in absolute poverty .
poverty.translationZh: 全球约23%的人口生活在绝对贫困中。
poverty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

poverty.sentenceEn: Where does the speaker say we can find extreme poverty ?
poverty.translationZh: 演讲者说我们可以在哪里找到极端贫困？

previous.sentenceEn: The studies also showed that when given a cognitive task, older adults rely more heavily on previous knowledge than younger adults do.
previous.translationZh: 研究还表明，在执行认知任务时，老年人比年轻人更依赖先前的知识。
previous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

previous.sentenceEn: This was significant because while previous research had suggested that unsociability might be harmless, Bowker and colleagues' paper showed that it could actually be beneficial.
previous.translationZh: 这一发现意义重大，因为尽管先前的研究表明不爱社交可能并无害处，但Bowker及其同事的论文却显示，不爱社交实际上可能是有益的。

previous.sentenceEn: "We're urging Members of Parliament to ensure automation does not just benefit a wealthy few like previous industrial revolutions."
previous.translationZh: 我们正敦促国会议员确保自动化进程不会像之前的工业革命那样，仅仅让少数富人受益。

previous.sentenceEn: Previous studies of young children have suggested that electronic books, which incorporate extra features such as dictionaries and images that depict story events, may have advantages over print.
previous.translationZh: 针对幼儿的既往研究表明，电子书整合了词典、故事场景配图等额外功能，可能比纸质书更具优势。
previous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

previous.sentenceEn: What do we learn about previous studies of young children reading electronic books?
previous.translationZh: 关于以往对幼儿阅读电子书的研究，我们了解到了什么？

previous.sentenceEn: He has little previous work experience.
previous.translationZh: 他没有多少先前的工作经验。

passion.sentenceEn: Colleges, workplaces and career counselors who promote the "follow your passion " path for everyone, without leveling the playing field, help perpetuate socioeconomic inequalities among career aspirants.
passion.translationZh: 大学、工作场所和职业顾问向所有人宣扬"追随激情"的道路，却不创造公平的竞争环境，这会加剧职业追求者之间的社会经济不平等。
passion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

passion.sentenceEn: I also found that promoting the pursuit of one's passion helps perpetuate social inequalities due to the fact that not everyone has the same economic resources to allow them to pursue their passion with ease.
passion.translationZh: 我还发现，宣扬追求个人热情会加剧社会不平等，因为并非每个人都拥有同样的经济资源，能够轻松追求自己的热爱。
passion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

passion.sentenceEn: As a sociologist, I interviewed college students and professional workers to learn what it really meant to pursue their dreams, which I will refer to here as the passion principle.
passion.translationZh: 作为一名社会学家，我采访了大学生和职场人士，以了解追求梦想的真正含义——我在此将其称为"激情原则"。
passion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句
文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

passion.sentenceEn: What happens when everyone is encouraged to follow their passion ?
passion.translationZh: 当每个人都被鼓励追随自己的热情时，会发生什么？

passion.sentenceEn: They exploit these workers' passion to benefit themselves.
passion.translationZh: 他们利用这些员工的热情为自己谋利。

pursue.sentenceEn: I also found that promoting the pursuit of one's passion helps perpetuate social inequalities due to the fact that not everyone has the same economic resources to allow them to pursue their passion with ease.
pursue.translationZh: 我还发现，宣扬追求个人热情会加剧社会不平等，因为并非每个人都拥有同样的经济资源，能够轻松追求自己的热爱。
pursue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

pursue.sentenceEn: As a sociologist, I interviewed college students and professional workers to learn what it really meant to pursue their dreams, which I will refer to here as the passion principle.
pursue.translationZh: 作为一名社会学家，我采访了大学生和职场人士，以了解追求梦想的真正含义——我在此将其称为"激情原则"。
pursue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

pursue.sentenceEn: Surveys revealed that working-class and first-generation college graduates, regardless of their career field, are more likely than their wealthier peers to end up in low-paying unskilled jobs when they pursue their passion.
pursue.translationZh: 调查显示，工薪阶层和第一代大学毕业生无论从事何种职业领域，当他们追求自己热爱的事业时，比家境更优渥的同龄人更有可能从事低薪的非技术性工作。
pursue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第5句

pursue.sentenceEn: While letting go can be difficult, it will free up your time, energy, and mental space to imagine new possibilities and pursue new opportunities.
pursue.translationZh: 虽然放手可能很难，但这能让你腾出时间、精力和心理空间，去构想新的可能并追求新的机遇。

pursue.sentenceEn: What often happens when people are eager to pursue individual success?
pursue.translationZh: 当人们渴望追求个人成功时，通常会发生什么？

pursue.sentenceEn: Women are encouraged to pursue a beauty ideal that has never existed.
pursue.translationZh: 女性被鼓励去追求一种从未存在过的 beauty 理想。

practical.sentenceEn: While the research is still in the exploratory phase, the team believes that technology could lead to micro-sized robots that can perform practical tasks in tightly confined spaces.
practical.translationZh: 虽然这项研究仍处于探索阶段，但研究团队认为，这项技术可能会催生微型机器人，它们能够在狭小受限的空间中执行实际任务。
practical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

practical.sentenceEn: She's scientifically-minded, practical , somewhat cynical, and always skeptical.
practical.translationZh: 她具有科学思维，注重实际，略带愤世嫉俗，且总是持怀疑态度。
practical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

practical.sentenceEn: Think about this from a practical , rather than theoretical viewpoint.
practical.translationZh: 从实际而非理论的角度来考虑这个问题。
practical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

practical.sentenceEn: Aristotle argued that the capacity for making practical judgments depends on regularly making them—on habit and practice.
practical.translationZh: 亚里士多德认为，做出实际判断的能力取决于不断地进行判断——依赖于习惯和实践。
practical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

practical.sentenceEn: There are a number of practical steps anyone can take to promote a sense of gratitude.
practical.translationZh: 任何人都可以采取一些切实可行的步骤来培养感恩意识。

practical.sentenceEn: People lose the chance to cultivate the ability to make practical judgments.
practical.translationZh: 人们失去了培养做出实际判断能力的机会。

protection.sentenceEn: According to the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, the largest sources of U.S. greenhouse gas emissions in 2016 were electricity production (28 percent of total emissions), transportation (28 percent) and industry (22 percent).
protection.translationZh: 根据美国环境保护署的数据，2016年美国温室气体排放的最大来源是电力生产（占总排放量的28%）、交通运输（28%）和工业（22%）。

protection.sentenceEn: Advocates for the protection of the natural environment from destruction or pollution urge the public to eat less meat.
protection.translationZh: 倡导保护自然环境免受破坏或污染的人士呼吁公众减少肉类 consumption。

protection.sentenceEn: It fights for the protection of human dignity and listens to and acts on the cries of the most vulnerable.
protection.translationZh: 它致力于维护人的尊严，倾听并回应那些最脆弱群体的呼声。
protection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第9句

protection.sentenceEn: Protection policies were originally designed to suppress bad development and boost historic preservation in our urban areas.
protection.translationZh: 保护政策最初旨在抑制不良开发，并促进城市地区的历史保护。

protection.sentenceEn: But research shows that short periods of stress can actually provide some protection against getting sick, because it increases your immune functioning.
protection.translationZh: 但研究表明，短期压力实际上可以提供一定的保护，防止生病，因为它能增强你的免疫功能。
protection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

protection.translationZh: 提供针对精神疾病的防护

player.sentenceEn: As key municipal agencies, and focal points for community education, libraries are major players in creating livable, environmentally friendly cities and towns.
player.translationZh: 作为重要的市政机构和社区教育中心，图书馆在创建宜居、环保的城镇方面发挥着重要作用。

player.sentenceEn: Although practising in more variable conditions will be slower at first, it will likely make you a better tennis player in the end.
player.translationZh: 虽然一开始在更多变的条件下练习进度会较慢，但最终很可能会让你成为一名更优秀的网球选手。
player.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

player.sentenceEn: Although it's usually bad behavior that gets an athlete a spot on the six o'clock news, many high-profile players work hard to be positive role models to children.
player.translationZh: 尽管运动员通常是因为不良行为才登上六点钟新闻，但许多备受瞩目的运动员仍努力成为孩子们的正面榜样。
player.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

player.sentenceEn: Reflecting on generosity and gratitude, the great basketball coach John Wooden once offered two counsels to his players and students.
player.translationZh: 在思考慷慨与感恩的意义时，伟大的篮球教练约翰·伍登曾给他的球员和学生们提出过两条忠告。

player.sentenceEn: What does the speaker say many high-profile players do?
player.translationZh: 演讲者说许多知名运动员做了什么？

partner.sentenceEn: Beyond ensuring that library construction projects consider environmental impact, libraries can take a lead in supporting local foods and craftsmen, like the Peabody Institute Library's partnering with local businesses to pioneer a farmers' market in their courtyard, or the Richmond Public Library's seed lending library which "nurtures locally-adapted plant varieties, and fosters community resilience(韧性), self-reliance and a culture of sharing."
partner.translationZh: 除了确保图书馆建设项目考虑环境影响外，图书馆还可以带头支持本地食品和手工艺人，例如皮博迪研究所图书馆与当地企业合作，在其庭院开创农贸市场，或者里士满公共图书馆的种子借阅图书馆，该图书馆“培育适应当地的植物品种，培养社区韧性、自力更生和分享文化。”

partner.sentenceEn: In one version of the experiment, the phone of the participants' conversation partner remained unused on the table throughout the conversation.
partner.translationZh: 在该实验的一个版本中，受访者谈话对象的手机在整个谈话过程中一直闲置在桌子上。
partner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

partner.sentenceEn: In another version, their partner's attention was quickly drawn to something on their phone and they spent the rest of the time interacting with their phone.
partner.translationZh: 在另一个实验版本中，同伴的注意力很快被手机上的内容吸引，随后便一直摆弄着手机。
partner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

partner.sentenceEn: Participants had to imagine themselves as the closest figure in the video and then make judgments about the conversations and how they felt about their conversation partners .
partner.translationZh: 参与者需要将自己想象成视频中最亲近的人物，随后对对话内容以及他们对谈话对象的感受做出判断。
partner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

partner.sentenceEn: Burberry is working with a partner to make full use of leather materials to reduce waste.
partner.translationZh: 博柏利正在与合作伙伴合作，充分利用皮革材料以减少浪费。

partner.sentenceEn: They compete intensely for romantic partners .
partner.translationZh: 他们为了争夺恋爱对象而激烈竞争。

priority.sentenceEn: Surveys show the American public has long held the passion principle in high regard as a career decision-making priority .
priority.translationZh: 调查显示，长期以来，美国公众高度重视以热情为原则的职业决策优先事项。
priority.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

priority.sentenceEn: As long as the economy is their priority , governments need go no further than ensuring citizens' continued productivity.
priority.translationZh: 只要经济是政府的首要任务，那么确保公民持续的生产力就已足够。
priority.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第6句

priority.sentenceEn: To demand that governments set the 'happiness' of citizens as their highest priority is to demand that they view citizens as ends in themselves.
priority.translationZh: 要求政府将公民的“幸福”作为最高优先事项，就是要求政府将公民本身视为目的。
priority.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

priority.sentenceEn: The teachers share large groups of students—sometimes 100 or more—and rotate between group instruction, one-on-one interventions, small study groups, or whatever the teachers as a team agree is a priority that day.
priority.translationZh: 教师们共同负责大量学生——有时多达100人或更多——并在集体授课、一对一辅导、小组学习或教学团队当天确定的任何优先任务之间轮换。
priority.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

priority.sentenceEn: Companies can get rid of the root cause of MRS if they give priority to workers' time.
priority.translationZh: 如果企业优先考虑员工的时间，就能从根本上解决工时相关压力的根源问题。

priority.sentenceEn: Governments still take economic development as their priority .
priority.translationZh: 各国政府仍将经济发展作为首要任务。

psychological.sentenceEn: Long working hours contribute to the feeling of "time poverty", which has an adverse effect on psychological well-being.
psychological.translationZh: 长时间工作导致了"时间贫困"感，这对心理健康产生了不利影响。
psychological.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

psychological.sentenceEn: Partly it's to do with money, but there's a psychological aspect to our fears as well.
psychological.translationZh: 部分原因与金钱有关，但我们的恐惧也包含心理层面的因素。
psychological.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

psychological.sentenceEn: Is happiness not a fleeting and subjective psychological state?
psychological.translationZh: 幸福难道不是一种短暂而主观的心理状态吗？
psychological.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

psychological.sentenceEn: The conservation of resources theory, originally proposed in 1989 by Dr Stevan Hobfoll, states that psychological stress occurs when a person's resources are threatened or lost.
psychological.translationZh: 资源保护理论由Stevan Hobfoll博士于1989年首次提出，该理论认为当个体的资源受到威胁或丧失时，就会产生心理压力。

psychological.sentenceEn: And the benefits are not only psychological and physical.
psychological.translationZh: 而且这些益处不仅仅是心理和生理上的。

psychological.sentenceEn: Psychological interventions are conducive to people's wellbeing.
psychological.translationZh: 心理干预有助于人们的福祉。

perspective.sentenceEn: One of the other things is, rather than just taking one perspective , so rather than looking at aging and health just from the perspective of the psychologist, we are now bringing together a lot of different techniques and a lot of different viewpoints to actually look at the sort of different factors affecting health.
perspective.translationZh: 另一个方面是，我们不再局限于单一视角——不再仅从心理学家的角度研究衰老与健康，而是汇集了多种不同的技术和观点，来探究影响健康的各类因素。
perspective.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第6句

perspective.sentenceEn: You had better say something like, "Thanks for the idea. I have my own plan for handling this, but I really appreciate your perspective and will take it into consideration. Can I let you know when I need help in the future?"
perspective.translationZh: 你最好这样说：“谢谢你的建议。关于这件事我有自己的打算，但我非常感谢你的见解，也会认真考虑的。以后如果需要帮助，我再联系你好吗？”
perspective.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

perspective.sentenceEn: Such a perspective can be hard to discredit, can't it?
perspective.translationZh: 这种观点很难被反驳，不是吗？
perspective.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第2句

perspective.sentenceEn: But, as Rosling pointed out in his book Factfulness, it's important to put all the bad news in perspective .
perspective.translationZh: 但是，正如罗斯林在其著作《事实》中所指出的，重要的是要正确看待所有这些坏消息。
perspective.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

perspective.sentenceEn: Learning languages broadens students' international perspective and nurtures mutual respect among peoples, according to a high school language teacher.
perspective.translationZh: 一位高中语言教师表示，学习语言能拓宽学生的国际视野，并培养不同民族间的相互尊重。

perspective.sentenceEn: They incorporate more perspectives than one.
perspective.translationZh: 他们采纳了多元化的视角。

possibility.sentenceEn: Fully automated burger restaurants managed with minimal human oversight — where customers order at screens, pay electronically, and eat food cooked and delivered by robots — are now a possibility .
possibility.translationZh: 现在，通过极少的人工监管即可运行的全自动化汉堡餐厅已成为可能——在这里，顾客通过屏幕点餐并进行电子支付，而食物的烹饪与配送均由机器人完成。

possibility.sentenceEn: It is designed for domestic use, but a commercial version is planned that opens up the possibility of restaurant kitchens automating even highly technically challenging tasks.
possibility.translationZh: 该产品专为家庭使用而设计，但其计划推出的商业版本将使餐厅厨房实现极具技术挑战的任务自动化成为可能。

possibility.sentenceEn: While letting go can be difficult, it will free up your time, energy, and mental space to imagine new possibilities and pursue new opportunities.
possibility.translationZh: 虽然放手可能很难，但这能让你腾出时间、精力和心理空间，去构想新的可能并追求新的机遇。

possibility.sentenceEn: Whenever you make a decision, there will always be a possibility for regret later, but that's how life is supposed to be.
possibility.translationZh: 每当你做出决定，日后总会有遗憾的可能，但这正是生活本该有的样子。
possibility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

possibility.sentenceEn: External sources of information can help you see angles and possibilities you might not have considered.
possibility.translationZh: 外部信息源可以帮助你发现那些你可能尚未考虑到的角度和可能性。

possibility.sentenceEn: Explore the possibility of using simpler secret codes.
possibility.translationZh: 探索使用更简单密码的可能性。

politician.sentenceEn: On the contrary, decades of research shows that female candidates raise as much money and win as often as male politicians with similar credentials.
politician.translationZh: 相反，数十年的研究表明，在资历相似的情况下，女性候选人募集的资金与男性政客相当，当选率也不相上下。
politician.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

politician.sentenceEn: Democratic politicians have tended to campaign on helping people left behind by economic growth.
politician.translationZh: 民主党政治人物在竞选时，往往聚焦于帮助那些在经济增长中被落下的人群。
politician.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

politician.sentenceEn: Among celebrities, it's trendy nowadays to use their own speech writers as politicians do.
politician.translationZh: 如今，在名人圈子里，像政客那样使用专属演讲稿撰写人已成为一种潮流。
politician.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

politician.sentenceEn: This way new idols have been brought to the stage: politicians , celebrities, and other big names.
politician.translationZh: 通过这种方式，新的偶像被推上舞台：政治家、名人以及其他知名人士。
politician.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

politician.sentenceEn: As an adult, Marconi had an intuition that he had to be loyal to politicians in order to be influential.
politician.translationZh: 成年后，马可尼凭直觉意识到，要想具有影响力，就必须对政客忠诚。
他们感觉自己被政客忽视了。

pollution.sentenceEn: Advocates for the protection of the natural environment from destruction or pollution urge the public to eat less meat.
pollution.translationZh: 倡导保护自然环境免受破坏或污染的人士呼吁公众减少肉类 consumption。

pollution.sentenceEn: Outdoor air pollution in cities is a global problem, whether it be haze plaguing Calcutta or poor air impacting the health of children in London schools.
pollution.translationZh: 城市室外空气污染是一个全球性问题，无论是困扰加尔各答的阴霾，还是影响伦敦学校儿童健康的恶劣空气质量。
pollution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

pollution.sentenceEn: They found that if pollution is frozen to around –18 ℃ in a condensing tube, the particles gather together and fall to the bottom, allowing fresh, clean air to pass through.
pollution.translationZh: 研究发现，如果在冷凝管中将污染物冷冻到约 -18 ℃，颗粒就会聚集成团并沉降到底部，从而让清新洁净的空气通过。
pollution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

pollution.sentenceEn: It is estimated that pollution is linked to over 40,000 early deaths in Britain each year.
pollution.translationZh: 据估计，英国每年有超过 4 万人的早逝与污染问题有关。
pollution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

pollution.sentenceEn: Recent history shows reduction of pollution , once seemingly impossible, can actually be accomplished.
pollution.translationZh: 近代历史表明，曾经看似不可能的污染减排实际上是可以实现的。

pollution.sentenceEn: It shows the importance of eliminating indoor pollution .
pollution.translationZh: 这体现了消除室内污染的重要性。

preserve.sentenceEn: Archives preserve historic artifacts, oral histories, digital history projects, and scholarly writings relevant to the community, including minority groups.
preserve.translationZh: 档案馆保存与社区相关的历史文物、口述历史、数字历史项目和学术著作，包括少数群体的相关资料。

preserve.sentenceEn: They give up their goals to preserve the relationship.
preserve.translationZh: 他们放弃自己的目标以维护这段关系。
preserve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

preserve.sentenceEn: At the heart of this vast, 25,000-square-mile desert is Mojave National Preserve .
preserve.translationZh: 在这片广袤的25,000平方英里沙漠的中心，坐落着莫哈韦国家保护区。
preserve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

preserve.sentenceEn: The preserve is rich with history, culture, biodiversity, and endless opportunities to stimulate your interest, especially for anyone who loves the outdoors.
preserve.translationZh: 这片保护区蕴含着丰富的历史、文化和生物多样性，同时也为游客提供了无尽的探索乐趣，尤其适合热爱户外的人士。
preserve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

preserve.sentenceEn: People began to consider preserving natural resources when they feared they would have nothing to use in the future.
preserve.translationZh: 当人们担心未来将无资源可用时，他们开始考虑保护自然资源。

preserve.sentenceEn: Workers have to make sacrifices to preserve self-esteem.
preserve.translationZh: 员工不得不做出牺牲来维护自尊。

proposal.sentenceEn: As far as it goes, this has much in common with proposals tabled by 'happiness' advocates.
proposal.translationZh: 就此而言，这与“幸福”倡导者提出的建议有许多共同之处。
proposal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

proposal.sentenceEn: Have you agreed to my last proposal ?
proposal.translationZh: 你同意我上次的提议了吗？
proposal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

proposal.sentenceEn: This legislative proposal essentially set out to harmonize the aesthetic appearance of all the houses in Berkton.
proposal.translationZh: 这项立法提案的本质目的是统一伯克顿所有房屋的外观美感。
proposal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第5句

proposal.sentenceEn: There are substantial, thought-out policy proposals on both sides of the argument.
proposal.translationZh: 争论双方都提出了大量经过深思熟虑的政策建议。

proposal.sentenceEn: What resulted from the passing of the legislative proposal "Motion 836"?
proposal.translationZh: 立法提案"836号动议"获得通过后产生了什么结果？

proposal.sentenceEn: Reply to the man's last proposal within a short time.
proposal.translationZh: 尽快回复该男士的最新提议。

profit.sentenceEn: Workers are often not in control of how they work, when they work, what is done with the goods and services they produce, and what is done with the profits made from their work.
profit.translationZh: 劳动者往往无法掌控自己的工作方式、工作时间、他们生产的商品和服务的去向，以及他们劳动所产生利润的用途。
profit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

profit.sentenceEn: One 2011 study showed that in branches of a pizza chain where employees were more passive, outgoing bosses were associated with higher profits .
profit.translationZh: 2011年的一项研究显示，在员工较为被动的披萨连锁店分店中，外向的老板与更高的利润相关联。

profit.sentenceEn: In an industry keen to slash labor costs and increase profits , further automation seems inevitable.
profit.translationZh: 在一个热衷于大幅削减劳动力成本并增加利润的行业中，进一步实现自动化似乎是必然的。

profit.sentenceEn: Although tech companies will often speak of environmental sustainability, many lobby against repair legislation, fearful it will eat into their profits .
profit.translationZh: 尽管科技公司经常谈论环境可持续性，但许多公司却游说反对维修立法，担心这会侵蚀他们的利润。
profit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

profit.sentenceEn: More automation appears to be a certainty in industries eager to cut labor costs and raise profits .
profit.translationZh: 对于那些渴望降低劳动力成本并提高利润的行业来说，进一步实现自动化似乎已成必然。

profit.sentenceEn: They are longing to share the profits made from their work.
profit.translationZh: 他们渴望分享自己工作所创造的利润。

perceive.sentenceEn: If the act of giving advice is contributing actively to someone's feelings of self-worth, an outright(直率的) rejection may be perceived as a threat, activating their fight-or-flight response, possibly causing them to double down on their validation-seeking behavior, or leading to a larger conflict.
perceive.translationZh: 如果给予建议这一行为正积极地支撑着一个人的自我价值感，那么直接的拒绝可能会被视为一种威胁，从而激发其战斗或逃跑反应。这可能导致他们加倍寻求认可，或者引发更大的冲突。
perceive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

perceive.sentenceEn: Many laymen presume that there is a single standard way of speaking in each country, with one single standard accent, and that this perceived standard is inherently the best form of speech, but linguists(语言学家) often point out that the concept of a standard accent is better understood as an ideal rather than a reality.
perceive.translationZh: 许多门外汉认为每个国家都有一种标准的说话方式和一种标准的口音，并觉得这种公认的标准形式在本质上就是语言的最佳形态。但语言学家经常指出，标准口音的概念与其说是一种现实，不如说是一个理想化的标准。
perceive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

perceive.sentenceEn: An observer may perceive a rainbow to be located either near or far away, but this phenomenon is not actually located at any specific spot.
perceive.translationZh: 观察者可能会觉得彩虹近在咫尺或远在天边，但这种现象实际上并不存在于任何特定位置。
perceive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

perceive.sentenceEn: An app cannot perceive such subtleties.
perceive.translationZh: 应用程序无法感知这种细微差别。
perceive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第23句

perceive.sentenceEn: How do some musicians perceive using AI in creating music?
perceive.translationZh: 一些音乐家如何看待在音乐创作中使用人工智能？

perceive.sentenceEn: She began to perceive the world differently.
perceive.translationZh: 她开始以不同的方式看待世界。

participate.sentenceEn: Through library collections, programs, and physical spaces, children learn to share, to be engaged in their communities, to participate in the arts, and to explore their immediate world and the world at large.
participate.translationZh: 通过图书馆的馆藏资源、活动项目和实体空间，孩子们学会分享，参与社区活动，投身艺术体验，并探索身边世界及更广阔的天地。

participate.sentenceEn: The study revealed that 80% of participating dogs successfully followed pointing gestures to a specific location despite having never received prior training.
participate.translationZh: 研究显示，80%参与实验的狗尽管从未接受过相关训练，仍能成功跟随指向手势找到特定位置。
participate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

participate.sentenceEn: At the same time, when a system no longer provides opportunities for the majority to participate in wealth building, it not only robs those who are excluded from opportunities, but also deprives them of their dignity.
participate.translationZh: 同时，当一个体制不再为大多数人提供参与财富积累的机会时，它不仅剥夺了那些被排除在外的人的机会，也剥夺了他们的尊严。

participate.sentenceEn: Surely the purpose of university is to prepare young people to participate fully in civic life, rather than just to find well-paid jobs.
participate.translationZh: 大学的目的当然是培养年轻人充分参与公民生活，而不仅仅是找到高薪工作。
participate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

participate.sentenceEn: What does the passage say about 80% of participating dogs in the new study?
participate.translationZh: 这篇文章关于新研究中80%的参与犬只说了什么？

participate.sentenceEn: People are prevented from participating in making major decisions in the workplace.
participate.translationZh: 员工被剥夺了参与工作场所重大决策的机会。

presence.sentenceEn: It means practicing being fully present in another person's presence and listening to them with complete attention without judgment, while resisting the urge to make the interaction about you.
presence.translationZh: 这意味着练习全身心地投入到与他人的相处中，全神贯注地倾听对方而无需评判，同时克制住将互动中心转向自己的冲动。
presence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

presence.sentenceEn: Spiders make their presence felt in late August and through early autumn.
presence.translationZh: 每年八月下旬至初秋，蜘蛛开始频繁出现在人们的视野中。
presence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

presence.sentenceEn: A group of American researchers compared students' comprehension of verbal material when reading in the presence of background speech, instrumental music or general noise.
presence.translationZh: 一组美国研究人员比较了学生在有背景言语、器乐或一般噪音的环境中阅读时对语言材料的理解能力。
presence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

presence.sentenceEn: Comprehension was slightly better with the presence of music than with speech.
presence.translationZh: 有音乐背景时的理解能力略好于有言语背景时。
presence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

presence.sentenceEn: What does the author suggest we do in another person's presence ?
presence.translationZh: 作者建议我们在他人在场时应该如何表现？

presence.sentenceEn: They have made their presence felt when spinning webs.
presence.translationZh: 它们在织网时便存在感十足。

previously.sentenceEn: Finally, on October 9, 1942, the over 30 meter tall and 200-400 year old tree fell, rumor has it, as a result of a severe windstorm and/or via having previously died and its roots rotted.
previously.translationZh: 最终，在1942年10月9日，这棵高达30多米、树龄200-400年的古树倒下了。据传，其原因可能是一场强烈的风暴，也可能是树木先前已经枯死，根部腐烂所致。

previously.sentenceEn: According to a study, apps like Instagram, Snapchat and FaceTune allow users to achieve a level of perfection that was previously only observed in beauty magazines.
previously.translationZh: 一项研究显示，像Instagram、Snapchat和FaceTune这类应用能让用户达到一种此前只有在美容杂志中才能见到的完美程度。
previously.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

previously.sentenceEn: All those women who had previously been excluded from the covers of magazines, television series and the public agenda, have become "legitimate".
previously.translationZh: 所有那些此前被排除在杂志封面、电视剧集和公众议题之外的女性，如今都已变得“名正言顺”。
previously.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

previously.sentenceEn: And while that's not necessarily special in an oh-gosh-get-out-and-look-at-it way, it's certainly special: a blue moon is a nickname for when two full moons fall in the same calendar month, and we hadn't previously had two in one year since 1999.
previously.translationZh: 虽然这不一定是那种会让人惊呼"天哪快出来看"的特别景象，但它确实很特别：蓝月是指一个公历月内出现两次满月的昵称，而自1999年以来，我们已经很久没有在一年中遇到过两次蓝月了。

previously.sentenceEn: Free-traders point to the undeniable good that tariff-free trade has done for consumers across the world and to the observable alleviation of poverty in corners of the world where previously closed markets have been opened up.
previously.translationZh: 自由贸易支持者指出，免税贸易为全球消费者带来了不可否认的好处，同时也在那些曾经封闭但现已开放市场的地区显著缓解了贫困问题。

previously.sentenceEn: Digital tech can serve human needs in ways previously thought impossible.
previously.translationZh: 数字技术能够以以往认为不可能的方式满足人类的需求。

press.sentenceEn: Then analysts who didn't know which condition each baby was in, watched video tapes of the experiment and counted how many times babies tried to activate the toy by pressing the button.
press.translationZh: 然后，不清楚每个婴儿处于哪种实验条件的分析师们观看了实验录像，并统计了婴儿们通过按按钮试图启动玩具的次数。
press.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

press.sentenceEn: And considering that people don't see these products in shops, or advertised on TV or in the press , it has been a pretty steep rise.
press.translationZh: 考虑到人们既不会在商店里看到这些产品，也不会在电视或报刊上看到相关广告，其销量的增长确实相当迅猛。

propose.sentenceEn: In a review published in the journal *Trends in Cognitive Sciences* on February 11th, researchers propose an explanation for why this might be happening: the brains of older adults allocate more space to accumulated knowledge and have more material to navigate when attempting to access memories.

penguin.sentenceEn: Rising temperatures and overfishing in the pristine(未受污染的) waters around the Antarctic could see king penguin populations pushed to the brink of extinction by the end of the century, according to a new study.
penguin.translationZh: 一项新研究显示，随着南极周边未受污染海域的温度不断上升以及过度捕捞问题日益严重，王企鹅种群可能在本世纪末濒临灭绝。
penguin.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

penguin.sentenceEn: What does the passage say about king penguins ?
penguin.translationZh: 这篇文章关于王企鹅说了些什么？

penguin.sentenceEn: It was carried out too close to the habitats of penguins and whales.
penguin.translationZh: 磷虾捕捞活动的作业地点过于靠近企鹅和鲸鱼的栖息地。

potentially.sentenceEn: You can let them know that you have heard them and appreciate where they are coming from without taking on the potentially damaging narrative that you could not have gotten by without their help.
potentially.translationZh: 你可以让他们知道你已经听到了他们的心声，并且理解他们的出发点，但不要全盘接受那种“没有他们的帮助你就无法成功”的潜在破坏性说法。
potentially.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

potentially.sentenceEn: You will be surprised at how good it makes you feel and the potentially positive change in your health.
potentially.translationZh: 你会惊讶于它带给你的良好感觉，以及对你健康可能产生的积极变化。
potentially.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

potentially.sentenceEn: This simulation gives the child crucial information about how to avoid becoming prey, and children tend to find that kind of activity deeply satisfying, presumably because it gives them a safe experience of a potentially catastrophic scenario.
potentially.translationZh: 这种模拟为孩子提供了关于如何避免成为猎物的重要信息，而孩子们往往发现这类活动非常令人满足，可能是因为它让他们在安全的环境中体验了潜在的灾难性情景。
potentially.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

potentially.sentenceEn: We need stories and histories of change and transformation: ecological stories that make us confront the fact that human power is potentially destructive, and that the survival of our species on this planet depends on the preservation of soil and water, and the habitats and ecological systems.
potentially.translationZh: 我们需要关于变革与转变的故事和历史：那些能让我们直面以下事实的生态故事——人类力量具有潜在的破坏性，而我们物种在这个星球上的生存依赖于土壤、水、栖息地及生态系统的保护。

potentially.sentenceEn: About 1 million plastic bottles are sold each minute around the globe and, with just 14% recycled, many end up in the oceans where they have polluted even the remotest parts, harming marine life and potentially people who eat sea food.
potentially.translationZh: 全球每分钟约售出100万个塑料瓶，而仅14%得到回收利用，许多塑料瓶最终进入海洋，污染了即使是最偏远的海域，对海洋生物以及可能食用海鲜的人类造成危害。
potentially.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

potentially.sentenceEn: If the wooden frame of the towers had caught fire, it could have sent the bells—the largest of which, the Emmanuel Bell, weighs 13 tons—crashing down, potentially causing the collapse of both towers.
potentially.translationZh: 如果塔楼的木质框架起火，就可能导致这些钟——其中最大的“ Emmanuel 钟”重达13吨——轰然坠落，进而可能造成两座塔楼坍塌。

prepared.sentenceEn: Drinks and prepared foods can also live on the middle shelf if you ran out of room up top.
prepared.translationZh: 如果上层空间不足，饮料和预制食品也可以放在中层架上。
prepared.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

prepared.sentenceEn: One survey found people only spend on average $6.30 when they bring lunch prepared at home.
prepared.translationZh: 一项调查发现，人们自带午餐时，平均花费仅为 6.30 美元。
prepared.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第16句

prepared.sentenceEn: One positive consequence of this age shift is that a larger proportion of new mothers are economically prepared to raise children.
prepared.translationZh: 这种年龄变化的一个积极影响是，更大比例的新妈妈在经济上已做好抚养孩子的准备。
prepared.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

prepared.sentenceEn: Be prepared to work hard if you want to turn it into a full-time business, and try not to rush to selling advertising spaces before you have created a dedicated audience.
prepared.translationZh: 如果你想将其发展为全职事业，就要准备好努力工作，并且在建立起忠实受众之前，不要急于出售广告位。
prepared.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

prepared.sentenceEn: This means being prepared to adapt to local customs and norms, rather than expecting local conditions to adapt to travelers.
prepared.translationZh: 这意味着要准备好适应当地的风俗习惯和行为规范，而不是期望当地环境来迁就游客。
prepared.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

productive.sentenceEn: The ability to explore, experiment and repeatedly apply new knowledge in unlimited, risk-free models is what makes simulation one of the most productive forms of learning.
productive.translationZh: 能够在无限制、无风险的模型中探索、实验并反复应用新知识，这使模拟成为最高效的学习方式之一。
productive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

productive.sentenceEn: A more recent advocate of thoughtful and productive solitude is Susan Cain, author of *Quiet: The Power of Introverts in a World That Can't Stop Talking* and founder of Quiet Revolution, a company that promotes quiet and introvert-friendly workplaces.
productive.translationZh: 苏珊·凯恩是近年来倡导深思熟虑且富有成效的独处生活的代表人物，她著有《安静：内向性格的竞争力》一书，并创立了“安静革命”组织——一家致力于推广安静且适合内向者的工作环境的公司。

productive.sentenceEn: Even for the most productive and disciplined among us, undoing something that has become an automatic part of who we are takes more than an overnight effort.
productive.translationZh: 即便是我们当中最高效自律的人，要改变那些已成为自身本能的习惯，也绝非一朝一夕之功。

productive.sentenceEn: The dialogue will feel more productive , and at the same time, the relationship overall is likely to feel more positive.
productive.translationZh: 这样的对话会让人感觉更有成效，同时，整体关系也可能会让人感觉更积极。
productive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

productive.sentenceEn: On the topic of trade, productive debates might be possible, in contrast to the familiar mutual condemnation in discussing other issues.
productive.translationZh: 在贸易议题上，或许有可能进行富有成效的辩论，这与在讨论其他问题时常见的相互指责形成了对比。

productive.sentenceEn: She is one of the most productive artists.
productive.translationZh: 她是最高产的艺术家之一。

packaging.sentenceEn: Everything in the industry is about speed, from manufacturing to packaging .
packaging.translationZh: 从生产到包装，整个行业的一切都围绕着速度展开。
packaging.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第9句

packaging.sentenceEn: So, according to Coca-Cola historian Ted Ryan, the company decided to come up with packaging that couldn't be duplicated.
