packaging.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

packaging.sentenceEn: Today I'm debt-free, resourceful—and I understand that even the shiniest packaging can't predict what you'll find on the inside.
packaging.translationZh: 如今我没有债务，懂得随机应变——而且我明白了，即便是最光鲜的包装，也无法预测内里究竟是什么。

packaging.sentenceEn: Marketers must qualify their claims on the product packaging and limit them to a specific benefit, such as how much of the product is recycled.
packaging.translationZh: 营销者必须在产品包装上明确限定其宣传内容，并将宣传限于特定的环保效益，例如产品的可回收比例。
packaging.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

packaging.sentenceEn: How does the food industry operate from manufacturing to packaging , according to Moss?
packaging.translationZh: 根据莫斯的说法，食品行业从生产到包装是如何运作的？

packaging.sentenceEn: Subsidise companies to adopt plain packaging .
packaging.translationZh: 补贴企业采用标准化包装

pose.sentenceEn: While the researchers focus primarily on the difficulties that these disorderly, crowded memories may pose , they also highlight a few situations in which these same memory patterns may be useful.

pose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

pose.sentenceEn: Despite his concerns about the risks posed to humans by technological progress, Bostrom is no luddite(科技进步反对者).

pose.sentenceEn: And that's possibly the greater threat posed by extinction of experience.
pose.translationZh: 而这或许就是'体验消亡'所带来的更大威胁。

pose.translationZh: 在最近的一项研究中，研究人员假扮成有皮肤问题的患者，向16个远程医疗网站寻求帮助，结果令人不安。

pose.sentenceEn: While making significant contributions to space science, CubeSats may pose hazards to other space vehicles.
pose.translationZh: 立方体卫星在为空间科学做出重大贡献的同时，也可能对其他航天器构成危害。

pose.translationZh: 我们可能无法及时察觉数字技术对我们构成的威胁。

prior.sentenceEn: While this wealth of prior knowledge can make memory retrieval challenging, the researchers say it has its upsides—this life experience can aid with creativity and decision-making.
prior.translationZh: 虽然丰富的先前知识会使记忆提取变得困难，但研究人员表示这也有其优势——这些生活经验有助于提升创造力和决策能力。
prior.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

prior.sentenceEn: As well as giving you space, this time also acts as a buffer between events, which can be borrowed from, should you be held up in a prior meeting, allowing you to still get to the next one on time.
prior.translationZh: 这段时间除了给你留出喘息空间外，还能在不同事项之间起到缓冲作用。万一你前面的会议耽搁了，就可以利用这段时间，确保你仍能准时参加下一个会议。
prior.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

prior.sentenceEn: They further hypothesize that older adults may be well served by their prior knowledge when it comes to decision-making, where they can pull on their accumulated wisdom.

prior.translationZh: 何时可以未经事先批准杀死老鼠？

prior.translationZh: 忘记他们已有的知识可能对他们大有裨益。

properly.sentenceEn: When properly supervised, extreme sports can be a part of a healthy, balanced life.
properly.translationZh: 在适当的监督下，极限运动可以成为健康平衡生活的一部分。
properly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

properly.sentenceEn: But spider conservationists point out that it was only in the 1980s that the classification of house spiders was properly sorted out.
properly.translationZh: 但蜘蛛保护主义者指出，直到20世纪80年代，家蜘蛛的分类才得到妥善梳理。

properly.sentenceEn: "Even with an astronomical level of income," she wrote, "to properly build wealth, experts recommend saving 20% of your income and living off the remaining 80%."
properly.translationZh: 她写道：“即使收入达到天文数字，专家仍建议将收入的20%用于储蓄，靠剩余的80%生活，才能恰当地积累财富。”
properly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

properly.sentenceEn: Greenhouse gas emissions, if not properly dealt with, will pose endless risks for mankind.

properly.translationZh: 技术创新应当受到适当监管。

percentage.sentenceEn: After family leave was introduced in the US, in fact, the rate of gender wage convergence fell to just 0.03 percentage points per year, and has remained there ever since.

percentage.sentenceEn: During that decade, the gender pay gap closed by about one percentage point a year.

percentage.sentenceEn: Some argue that people should all contribute a certain percentage of their earnings.

percentage.sentenceEn: A 2007 survey by Responsive Management Inc. found that eighty percent of respondents agreed that "hunting has a legitimate place in modern society," and the percentage of Americans indicating disapproval of hunting declined from 22 percent in 1995 to 16 percent in 2007.

planning.sentenceEn: They are failing to look ahead at a time when planning for the future is more important than ever.

politics.sentenceEn: It overturned all of those habits of mind, fundamentally changing our experience of the world, affecting the conduct of politics , religion, business, and culture.

popularity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

popularity.sentenceEn: What accounts for the growing popularity of acupuncture in the United States, according to the speaker?
popularity.translationZh: 根据讲述者所说，针灸在美国越来越受欢迎的原因是什么？

popularity.sentenceEn: He was struck by its broad popularity .
popularity.translationZh: 他对它的广泛流行感到惊讶。

portray.sentenceEn: Sarcasm is mostly understood through tone of voice, which is used to portray the opposite of the literal words.
portray.translationZh: 讽刺大多通过语气来表达，这种语气用于传达与字面意思相反的含义。
portray.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

portray.sentenceEn: For example, some ancient Western philosophers counsel gratitude that is both enduring and complete, and some Eastern thinkers portray it as not merely an attitude but a virtue to be put into practice.
portray.translationZh: 例如，一些古代西方哲学家主张感恩应既持久又全然，而一些东方思想家则将感恩不仅视为一种态度，更看作是一种需要践行的美德。

portray.sentenceEn: Though it is often portrayed as a positive trait, Pryor and others say extreme perfectionism can lead to depression, anxiety, and even suicide.
portray.translationZh: 尽管完美主义常被视为一种积极特质，但普赖尔等人指出，极端的完美主义可能导致抑郁、焦虑，甚至自杀。

portray.sentenceEn: Travel is often portrayed as a tool for personal growth and tourism as an economic motor for destination countries and cities.
portray.translationZh: 旅行常被视为个人成长的工具，而旅游业则被当作目的国和目的城市的经济引擎。
portray.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

portray.sentenceEn: How does Alan Blinder portray Yellen?
portray.translationZh: 艾伦·布林德如何评价耶伦？

portray.sentenceEn: They portray drivers who enjoy speed on the road.
portray.translationZh: 它们描绘的是享受公路飞驰的司机形象。

profession.sentenceEn: "Our profession is so slow to advance because we are working in isolation."
profession.translationZh: 我们的行业发展如此缓慢，因为我们都在各自为战。
profession.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

profession.sentenceEn: M: Ah, that's a wonderful profession .
profession.translationZh: 男士：啊，这可是个很棒的专业。
profession.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

profession.sentenceEn: It's no surprise that doctors as a profession suffer a lot of ill health because they spend their lives around sick people.
profession.translationZh: 医生这个职业普遍健康状况不佳，这不足为奇，因为他们一生都在与病人打交道。
profession.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

profession.sentenceEn: Psychiatrists have a higher incidence of suicide in their profession for related reasons.
profession.translationZh: 精神科医生的自杀率在其行业中较高，原因与此相关。
profession.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

profession.sentenceEn: For example, in Massachusetts, the healthcare professions require continuing education credits, which are carefully evidenced and documented.
profession.translationZh: 例如，在马萨诸塞州，医疗保健行业要求从业人员获得继续教育学分，这些学分需经过仔细的证明和记录。

profession.sentenceEn: What did superintendent Andi Fourlis say about the teaching profession ?
profession.translationZh: 学区总监安迪·福利斯对教师职业有何评价？

profitable.sentenceEn: "We have to grow what is profitable ," he says.
profitable.translationZh: 他说：“我们必须发展盈利的业务。”

profitable.sentenceEn: It could charge a profitable markup by offering just a bit more technical equipment and professional service than competitors.
profitable.translationZh: 通过仅提供比竞争对手稍多一些的技术设备和专业服务，它就能收取可观的加价。
profitable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第15段，第4句

profitable.sentenceEn: So, if done right, it should be very profitable to raise our own cattle.
profitable.translationZh: 所以，如果做得好，我们自己养牛应该会非常有利可图。
profitable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第4句

profitable.sentenceEn: So workplace surveillance could be empowering for staff and useful for companies looking to become more efficient and profitable .
profitable.translationZh: 因此，工作场所监控既可以增强员工的能力，也有助于企业提高效率和盈利能力。
profitable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

profitable.sentenceEn: What does the woman say makes furniture marginally more profitable ?
profitable.translationZh: 这位女士说是什么让家具的利润略高一些？

perfectionism.sentenceEn: But, therapists say, there are also different ways perfectionism manifests.
perfectionism.translationZh: 但是，治疗师们表示，完美主义的表现形式也各不相同。

perfectionism.sentenceEn: Michael Brustein, a clinical psychologist in Manhattan, says when he first began practicing in 2007, he was surprised by how prevalent perfectionism was among his clients, despite how little his graduate training had focused on the phenomenon.
perfectionism.translationZh: 曼哈顿临床心理学家迈克尔·布鲁斯坦表示，2007年初执业时，他惊讶地发现完美主义在客户中如此普遍，尽管他的研究生培训对此现象关注甚少。

perfectionism.sentenceEn: What's more, perfectionism seems to be on the rise.
perfectionism.translationZh: 更重要的是，完美主义似乎有增无减。

perfectionism.sentenceEn: In maladaptive(不当的) perfectionism , meanwhile, people make an archive of all their failures.
perfectionism.translationZh: 而在不当完美主义中，人们会将所有失败都存档记录。

perfectionism.sentenceEn: Instead, she tries to help them think through the parts of their perfectionism they'd like to keep, and to lose the parts that are ruining their lives.
perfectionism.translationZh: 相反，她尝试帮助他们思考，保留完美主义中他们想要保留的部分，摒弃那些正在毁掉他们生活的部分。

perfectionism.sentenceEn: It is found that perfectionism is getting more and more prevalent among college students.
perfectionism.translationZh: 研究发现，完美主义在大学生中日益普遍。

prioritize.sentenceEn: If you are showing up late to your own life, get organized, prioritize punctuality, and address any underlying causes.
prioritize.translationZh: 如果你在自己的生活中总是迟到，那就做好规划，重视守时，并解决任何潜在原因。
prioritize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

prioritize.sentenceEn: This will require the Republican Party as a whole to prioritize recruiting women—and not just for one election cycle, but in a sustained way.
prioritize.translationZh: 这将要求共和党作为一个整体优先招募女性——而且不仅仅是为了一个选举周期，而是要以持续的方式进行。
prioritize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

prioritize.sentenceEn: If you have trouble setting boundaries tactfully, prioritize working on your own ability to self-regulate.
prioritize.translationZh: 如果你难以委婉地设定界限，请优先提升自己的自我调节能力。
prioritize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

prioritize.sentenceEn: That's because it's not unusual for many leaders to prioritize email management over people management.
prioritize.translationZh: 这是因为许多领导者优先处理邮件管理而非人员管理的情况并不罕见。
prioritize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

prioritize.sentenceEn: People often accept false beliefs because they prioritize social bonds rather than facts.
prioritize.translationZh: 人们常常接受错误的信念，因为他们优先考虑社会联系而非事实。

prioritize.sentenceEn: It prioritizes peer work over classroom instruction.
prioritize.translationZh: 它将同伴协作置于课堂教学之上。

prompt.sentenceEn: Allowing participants to enter a simulated environment provides them with the opportunity to experience alternative realities which can prompt them to rethink their current beliefs.
prompt.translationZh: 让参与者进入模拟环境，能为他们提供体验另类现实的机会，这可能促使他们重新思考自己当前的信念。
prompt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

prompt.sentenceEn: Other researchers have suggested that due to major environmental events in East Africa, humans were prompted to find greener pastures.
prompt.translationZh: 另一些研究人员则认为，由于东非发生了重大环境事件，促使人类去寻找更适宜的栖息地。
prompt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

prompt.sentenceEn: A bear, prompted by the food that a lady kept offering to him, entered the car where the generous person was sitting.
prompt.translationZh: 一位女士不断向一只熊投喂食物，在食物的引诱下，这只熊钻进了她乘坐的汽车。
prompt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

prompt.sentenceEn: Still, it is to be hoped that the Scottish government's bold move will prompt others to act.
prompt.translationZh: 尽管如此，我们仍期望苏格兰政府的这一大胆举措能促使其他地区采取行动。
prompt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

prompt.sentenceEn: The celebration of milestones may prompt staff to be more grateful about their own accomplishments and privileges.
prompt.translationZh: 对里程碑的庆祝可能会促使员工对自己的成就和所享有的待遇更加心存感激。
prompt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

prompt.sentenceEn: They are prompted to come up with ideas for making possible changes.
prompt.translationZh: 他们反而会开始思考如何改变现状

prospect.sentenceEn: Left alone on an unknown island with no apparent prospect of rescue or escape, Crusoe has much to lament(悲叹).
prospect.translationZh: 独自一人被困在一座陌生的岛屿上，没有明显的获救或逃生希望，鲁滨逊有太多事情可以悲叹。

prospect.sentenceEn: I am, however, very excited about the prospect of joining this company and very keen to start from the bottom in whatever capacity I may be of use.
prospect.translationZh: 不过，我对加入贵公司的前景感到非常兴奋，并且非常渴望从基层做起，尽我所能发挥作用。
prospect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第5句

prospect.sentenceEn: Creative arts graduates from top universities—like Oxford, with a high proportion of privately-educated students—have fairly good work prospects .
prospect.translationZh: 顶尖大学（如牛津大学，其学生中私立教育背景者比例很高）的创意艺术专业毕业生拥有相当不错的就业前景。
prospect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

prospect.sentenceEn: Ditching the web at large, however, is a far more subtle and complicated prospect .
prospect.translationZh: 然而，完全脱离互联网却是一个更加微妙和复杂的问题。
prospect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

prospect.sentenceEn: There appears little prospect of this desperate situation being remedied without radical action being taken.
prospect.translationZh: 若不采取根本性行动，这一严峻局面似乎无望得到改善。
prospect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

prospect.sentenceEn: Its prospects depend on future human behaviour.
prospect.translationZh: 其前景取决于未来的人类行为。

partly.sentenceEn: The market is huge, partly because most colleges and graduate schools don't teach basic organization, but cooking schools and professional kitchens do.
partly.translationZh: 这个市场十分庞大，部分原因是大多数学院和研究生院不教授基本的组织管理技能，而烹饪学校和专业厨房却会教授。
partly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

partly.sentenceEn: Partly it's to do with money, but there's a psychological aspect to our fears as well.
partly.translationZh: 部分原因与金钱有关，但我们的恐惧也包含心理层面的因素。
partly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

partly.sentenceEn: In China the crackdown has been driven at least partly by fear that the homegrown tech industry is becoming too powerful.
partly.translationZh: 在中国，此次打击行动的部分原因是担心本土科技行业变得过于强大。
partly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

partly.sentenceEn: This is partly because of the risk that viewers find virtual humans scary.
partly.translationZh: 部分原因是观众可能会觉得虚拟人物令人毛骨悚然。

partly.sentenceEn: People's reluctance to start conversations with nearby strangers comes partly from "underestimating others' interest in connecting".
partly.translationZh: 人们不愿与身边的陌生人开启对话，部分原因在于“低估了他人对交流的兴趣”。
partly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

partly.sentenceEn: What partly accounts for the slip in women's salaries?
partly.translationZh: 女性薪资下滑的部分原因是什么？

perfectly.sentenceEn: Having a "beautiful" campus means green and perfectly maintained lawns along with flower beds and paved sidewalks.
perfectly.translationZh: 拥有"美丽"的校园意味着有绿色且维护良好的草坪，以及花坛和铺设整齐的人行道。
perfectly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

perfectly.sentenceEn: I personally think they're perfectly appropriate.
perfectly.translationZh: 我个人认为它们是非常合适的。
perfectly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

perfectly.sentenceEn: Setting a boundary in this regard, if you feel you need one, is perfectly reasonable and something that can bring you increased emotional safety.
perfectly.translationZh: 在这方面，如果你觉得有必要，设定一个界限是完全合理的，这能为你带来更多的心理安全感。
perfectly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

perfectly.sentenceEn: But to be perfectly honest, I think anyone who was offended was being a little too sensitive.
perfectly.translationZh: 不过说实话，我觉得那些感到被冒犯的人有点太敏感了。
perfectly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第7句

perfectly.sentenceEn: The moon isn't always exactly the same distance from Earth, because its orbit isn't perfectly circular.
perfectly.translationZh: 月球与地球的距离并非总是完全相同，因为它的轨道并非完美的圆形。

perfectly.sentenceEn: Concede the advice is perfectly reasonable.
perfectly.translationZh: 承认这些建议是完全合理的。

privacy.sentenceEn: They choose an area of the island with the best Internet reception and set up a makeshift(临时凑合的) medical center which consists of plastic stools and small tables borrowed from the locals' homes, a tent in case of rain and a sheet that is strung up to give the patients privacy during their session.
privacy.translationZh: 他们会选择岛上网络信号最好的区域，搭建一个临时医疗中心。这个中心由向当地人借来的塑料凳子和小桌子、一个防雨用的帐篷，以及一块为患者就诊时提供隐私保护而拉起的布单组成。

privacy.sentenceEn: In the U.S., a new breed of anti-trust experts argues that consideration should be given to privacy , control over data, workers' rights, and the overall impact on smaller companies.
privacy.translationZh: 在美国，新一代反垄断专家认为，应当考虑隐私保护、数据控制权、工人权利以及对小型企业的整体影响。
privacy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

privacy.sentenceEn: Steinberg and Bahareh Keith, an assistant professor of pediatrics at the University of Florida College of Medicine, say most children will likely never experience problems related to what their parents share, but a tension still exists between parents' rights to share their experiences and their children's rights to privacy .
privacy.translationZh: 斯坦伯格和佛罗里达大学医学院儿科学助理教授巴哈雷·基思指出，大多数儿童可能永远不会因父母分享的内容而遭遇麻烦，但父母分享自身经历的权利与儿童隐私权之间仍存在矛盾。

privacy.sentenceEn: And what are the implications for privacy ?
privacy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

privacy.sentenceEn: Parents who share their parenting experiences may find themselves intruding into their children's privacy .
privacy.translationZh: 分享育儿经历的父母可能会发现自己侵犯了孩子的隐私。

privacy.sentenceEn: It can alert employees to intrusion into their privacy .
privacy.translationZh: 它可以提醒员工其隐私受到侵犯。

pit.sentenceEn: High-stakes fights over shipwrecks pit archaeologists against treasure hunters in a vicious cycle of accusations.
pit.translationZh: 围绕沉船的高风险争夺战使考古学家与寻宝者陷入相互指责的恶性循环。

pit.sentenceEn: And then the legal storm began, with GME and Pritchett pitted against Florida and France.
pit.translationZh: 随后，法律风暴骤起，GME公司和普里切特陷入了与佛罗里达州及法国政府的对峙。

pit.sentenceEn: The pit area is a large dinosaur graveyard, not a place where they died.
pit.translationZh: 这个坑区是大型恐龙墓地，而非它们死亡的地方。
pit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

pit.sentenceEn: Many people get the idea from the mass of bones in the pit wall that some disaster such as a volcanic explosion or a sudden flood killed a whole herd of dinosaurs in this area.
pit.translationZh: 许多人从坑壁上堆积的大量骨骼中得出这样的想法：某种灾难，比如火山爆发或突发洪水，导致了这一地区整群恐龙的死亡。
pit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

pit.sentenceEn: What occurs to many people when they see the massive bones in the pit wall?
pit.translationZh: 当许多人看到坑壁中大量的骨头时，他们会想到什么？

pit.sentenceEn: The pit should be carefully preserved for the study of dinosaurs.
pit.translationZh: 这个恐龙坑应当被精心保护，以用于恐龙研究。

possibly.sentenceEn: If the act of giving advice is contributing actively to someone's feelings of self-worth, an outright(直率的) rejection may be perceived as a threat, activating their fight-or-flight response, possibly causing them to double down on their validation-seeking behavior, or leading to a larger conflict.
possibly.translationZh: 如果给予建议这一行为正积极地支撑着一个人的自我价值感，那么直接的拒绝可能会被视为一种威胁，从而激发其战斗或逃跑反应。这可能导致他们加倍寻求认可，或者引发更大的冲突。
possibly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

possibly.sentenceEn: I am not saying this would mean beauty is completely objective, just that there could possibly be general objective principles at work, i.e., beauty is not simply in the eye of the beholder.
possibly.translationZh: 我并不是说这意味着美是完全客观的，只是说可能存在一些普遍的客观原则在起作用，也就是说，美并不仅仅存在于观赏者的眼中。
possibly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

possibly.sentenceEn: But this advice does not seem to be supported by science, possibly because there is little agreement about the meaning of "dietary diversity," which is not clearly and consistently defined.
possibly.translationZh: 但这一建议似乎并未得到科学支持，这可能是因为人们对“饮食多样性”的含义缺乏共识，其定义尚不清晰且不一致。
possibly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

possibly.sentenceEn: But I will add more clothes for children, both girls and boys, and possibly even for infants.
possibly.translationZh: 但我会增加更多儿童服装，包括女孩和男孩的，甚至可能会拓展婴儿服装。
possibly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第3句

possibly.sentenceEn: It would take more than three centuries before scientists began to understand that timber production is not the only, and possibly not the most important, function of forests.
possibly.translationZh: 科学家们用了三个多世纪才开始认识到，木材生产并非森林的唯一功能，甚至可能不是其最重要的功能。

possibly.sentenceEn: Allow them to see what could possibly be achieved.
possibly.translationZh: 让他们看到可能实现的目标。

producer.sentenceEn: Librarians know that patrons aren't just information consumers, they're information producers .
producer.translationZh: 图书馆员们知道，读者不仅仅是信息的消费者，更是信息的生产者。

producer.sentenceEn: Protectionists point to the domestic producers who've paid the price for this globalized economy in the form of lost livelihoods and hollowed-out communities.
producer.translationZh: 贸易保护主义者指出，国内生产商为这种全球化经济付出了代价，表现为生计丧失和社区空心化。

producer.sentenceEn: If free-traders are going to win policy arguments in the future, they'll have to find a way of forging bonds of affection between American consumers and foreign producers .
producer.translationZh: 如果自由贸易支持者未来想在政策辩论中获胜，他们必须找到一种方法，在美國消費者和外國生產者之間建立情感聯繫。

producer.sentenceEn: While there are always bound to be stubborn old-school musicians who refuse to use tech, music producers should consider AI as something to be embraced.
producer.translationZh: 尽管总会有一些固执的传统派音乐家拒绝使用科技，但音乐制作人应当将人工智能视为值得拥抱的新事物。
producer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

producer.sentenceEn: For their arguments to prevail, advocates of free trade must try to forge bonds of affection between consumers at home and producers overseas.
producer.translationZh: 要让自由贸易的主张获得认可，其倡导者必须努力在国内消费者与海外生产者之间建立情感纽带。

producer.sentenceEn: They create lots of trouble for GMO food producers .
producer.translationZh: 它们给转基因食品生产商制造了诸多麻烦。

phase.sentenceEn: Chancellor Angela Merkel in 2011 announced Energiewende, an energy transition that would phase out nuclear and coal while phasing in renewables.
phase.translationZh: 安格拉·默克尔总理于2011年宣布了能源转型计划(Energiewende)，该计划将逐步淘汰核能与煤炭，同时逐步引入可再生能源。
phase.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

phase.sentenceEn: While the research is still in the exploratory phase , the team believes that technology could lead to micro-sized robots that can perform practical tasks in tightly confined spaces.
phase.translationZh: 虽然这项研究仍处于探索阶段，但研究团队认为，这项技术可能会催生微型机器人，它们能够在狭小受限的空间中执行实际任务。
phase.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

phase.sentenceEn: And all the other phases are just the transition from one of those extremes to the other.
phase.translationZh: 而所有其他阶段都只是从这两个极端之一向另一个极端的过渡。

phase.sentenceEn: "We are in a revolutionary phase in terms of our ability to understand the minds of other animals."
phase.translationZh: 在理解其他动物心智方面，我们正处于一个革命性的阶段。
phase.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第2句

phase.sentenceEn: In the second phase , as they grow wealthier, they pave the roads, allowing traffic to move faster and pushing up the death rate.
phase.translationZh: 在第二阶段，随着国家日益富裕，它们开始铺设道路，这使得车辆行驶速度加快，同时也推高了死亡率。
phase.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

phase.sentenceEn: Lastly, in the third phase , countries act to make their roads safer.
phase.translationZh: 最后，在第三阶段，各国会采取措施提高道路安全性。
phase.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

plain.sentenceEn: Often my work involves negotiating agreements, plain and simple.
plain.translationZh: 我的工作常常涉及协议谈判，就这么简单。
plain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第5句

plain.sentenceEn: His summary is plain : "Dietary diversification is critical to the future of humanity."
plain.translationZh: 他的总结很直白：“饮食多样化对人类未来至关重要。”

plain.sentenceEn: As federal subsidies and land grants tempted people into the deserts and plains , the post kept them connected.
plain.translationZh: 当联邦补贴和土地授予吸引人们前往沙漠和平原地区时，邮政服务让他们与外界保持着联系。
plain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

plain.sentenceEn: When Julius Morton moved to Nebraska City in 1854, he faced a problem shared by many settlers in the territory: It was a treeless plain .
plain.translationZh: 1854年，朱利叶斯·莫顿移居内布拉斯加州城时，遇到了该地区许多定居者共同面临的一个问题：这里是一片没有树木的平原。
plain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

plain.sentenceEn: What has happened in Australia where plain packaging is implemented?
plain.translationZh: 在已实施平装的澳大利亚发生了什么？

plain.sentenceEn: It kept people in the deserts and plains connected.
plain.translationZh: 邮政服务让生活在沙漠和平原地区的人们保持着联系。

platform.sentenceEn: The active involvement of users is reflected in the gamified(游戏化的) interaction offered by the social media platforms —the ability to like, write a comment, compare, share.
platform.translationZh: 用户的积极参与体现在社交媒体平台提供的游戏化互动中——点赞、评论、比较、分享等功能。
platform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

platform.sentenceEn: Consequently, it's worth bearing in mind that while deleting all social media accounts will undoubtedly make some feel infinitely better, many other people benefit from the strong sense of community that sharing platforms can breed.
platform.translationZh: 因此，我们应当记住，虽然删除所有社交媒体账号无疑会让一些人感觉好很多，但许多其他人却从这些分享平台所孕育的强烈社区归属感中受益。
platform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

platform.sentenceEn: Tech giants are increasingly assuming powerful positions in banking, finance, advertising, retail, and other markets that force smaller businesses to rely on their platforms to reach customers.
platform.translationZh: 科技巨头正日益在银行、金融、广告、零售及其他市场占据强势地位，这迫使小型企业不得不依赖它们的平台来接触客户。
platform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

platform.sentenceEn: And Beth Ann Telford, a 47-year-old federal government worker from Fairfax and the only American female in this year's mix, is using the event as a platform to raise money for cancer research.
platform.translationZh: 而47岁的贝丝·安·特尔福德来自费尔法克斯，是一名联邦政府工作人员，也是今年参赛选手中唯一的美国女性，她正利用这项赛事作为平台为癌症研究筹集资金。

platform.sentenceEn: What is worth bearing in mind concerning social media platforms ?
platform.translationZh: 关于社交媒体平台，有什么值得我们牢记的？

platform.sentenceEn: They are frequently denied access to tech giants' platforms .
platform.translationZh: 它们常常被拒绝接入科技巨头的平台。

possess.sentenceEn: The "dark side" of this drive to acquire is being mindlessly driven to possess more and more "things" and to socially compare our "stuff" with all the stuff other people have in their lives.
possess.translationZh: 这种获取欲的“阴暗面”在于，我们会盲目地被驱使去拥有越来越多的“东西”，并在社交层面上把自己的“物品”与他人生活中的所有物品进行比较。
possess.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

possess.sentenceEn: By 1860 Morton possessed a forest of more than 300 trees.
possess.translationZh: 到1860年，莫顿已经拥有了一片300多棵树的森林。
possess.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

possess.sentenceEn: I possess a network of clients and partners in both countries.
possess.translationZh: 我在这两个国家都拥有客户和合作伙伴网络。
possess.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

possess.sentenceEn: Some even argue that a basic knowledge of others' minds is not only possessed by human infants, but must be evolutionarily old and hence shared by our nearest living relatives, the great apes.
possess.translationZh: 一些人甚至认为，对他人心智的基本认知不仅为人类婴儿所具备，而且必定是进化史上的古老能力，因此也为我们现存的最近亲——类人猿所共有。

possess.sentenceEn: We feel greater independence than we actually possess because money allows us to buy things without building any relationships.
possess.translationZh: 我们感受到的独立感比我们实际拥有的要强烈，因为金钱让我们无需建立任何关系就能买到东西。

possess.sentenceEn: They will no longer possess the human characteristic of being unpredictable.
possess.translationZh: 他们将不再拥有人类所特有的不可预测性。

prosperity.sentenceEn: A government's obligation lies in creating conditions that promote prosperity .
prosperity.translationZh: 政府的职责在于创造促进繁荣的条件。
prosperity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

prosperity.sentenceEn: Even on the broadest interpretation of 'happiness' as prosperity or 'life satisfaction', people want different things.
prosperity.translationZh: 即便将“幸福”作最宽泛的解读，理解为富裕或“生活满意度”，人们的追求依然各不相同。
prosperity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

prosperity.sentenceEn: It is obviously good news if prosperity is more shared across the globe.
prosperity.translationZh: 如果全球能更广泛地共享繁荣，这显然是个好消息。
prosperity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

prosperity.sentenceEn: If we really care about global welfare, globalization is the only way forward to ensure that economic prosperity is shared among all countries and not only a select few advanced economies.
prosperity.translationZh: 如果我们真正关心全球福祉，全球化是确保经济繁荣惠及所有国家，而非仅由少数发达经济体独享的唯一途径。
prosperity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

prosperity.sentenceEn: For generations, the stability and prosperity of the American middle class have been anchored by home ownership.
prosperity.translationZh: 几代人以来，美国中产阶级的稳定与繁荣一直以拥有住房为基石。

prosperity.sentenceEn: It is the only way for all countries to share economic prosperity .
prosperity.translationZh: 这是所有国家共享经济繁荣的唯一途径。

peak.sentenceEn: Timed traffic lights are set according to schedules that are supposed to coordinate with peak traffic hours.
peak.translationZh: 定时红绿灯是根据旨在配合交通高峰时段的时间表来设置的。

peak.sentenceEn: In just the past few years, the peak childbearing age range for American women has advanced from that of 25-29 to that of 30-34.
peak.translationZh: 在过去短短几年间，美国女性的生育高峰年龄段已从25-29岁提前至30-34岁。
peak.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

peak.sentenceEn: Even though humanity has always cherished beauty, in the last decade our obsession with looks has reached an unprecedented peak .
peak.translationZh: 尽管人类对美的追求由来已久，但在过去十年间，我们对外貌的痴迷达到了前所未有的顶峰。
peak.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

peak.sentenceEn: At its peak , it served the shipyard workers on the south side of the city.
peak.translationZh: 在其鼎盛时期，地铁主要服务于城市南侧的造船厂工人。
peak.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

peak.sentenceEn: According to researchers, in China and South Africa, traffic deaths have been falling since 2000, and in India since 2012, and the Philippines reached its peak four years ago.
peak.translationZh: 研究人员指出，中国和南非的交通死亡人数自2000年以来持续下降，印度自2012年起开始下降，而菲律宾则在四年前达到峰值。
peak.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

peak.sentenceEn: The growth in public agricultural-research spending peaked in the 1970s and has been shrinking ever since.
peak.translationZh: 公共农业研究支出的增长在20世纪70年代达到顶峰，此后一直在缩减。
peak.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

perception.sentenceEn: It's a simple, yet profound change in perception , and what I love about it is the power it has to instantly shift us up a gear.
perception.translationZh: 这是一种简单却深刻的观念转变，而我喜欢它的一点是，它拥有瞬间推动我们提升一个层次的力量。
perception.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第9句

perception.sentenceEn: Obstacles can broaden your perception and open up your thinking processes.
perception.translationZh: 障碍能拓宽你的视野，开启你的思维过程。
perception.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

perception.sentenceEn: This principle is found in many domains, including speech perception and learning categories.
perception.translationZh: 这一原则存在于许多领域，包括言语感知和类别学习。
perception.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

perception.sentenceEn: To identify key patterns and understand the underlying principles of variability effects, Raviv and her colleagues reviewed over 150 studies on variability and generalisation across fields, including computer science, linguistics, categorisation, visual perception and formal education.
perception.translationZh: 为了识别关键模式并理解变异效应的基本原理，Raviv及其同事回顾了150多项关于不同领域变异与泛化的研究，包括计算机科学、语言学、分类学、视觉感知和正规教育。
perception.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

perception.sentenceEn: It's also a way to help counter perceptions of local crops as "old or poor people's food" or as inferior "women's crops", adds Tan.
perception.translationZh: 谭补充道，这也是一种有助于改变人们对本地作物的看法的方式——不再将其视为“老年人或穷人的食物”，或次等的“女性作物”。

perception.sentenceEn: Human perception of forests has undergone a tremendous change in the past years.
perception.translationZh: 近年来，人类对森林的认知发生了巨大变化。

physically.sentenceEn: Human emotions manifest physically in chemical signals that are emitted by the body, and dogs are able to smell those as well.
physically.translationZh: 人类的情绪会通过身体释放的化学信号在生理上表现出来，而狗也能够闻到这些信号。
physically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

physically.sentenceEn: TD doctors are not meant to treat serious illnesses or conditions that require a doctor to be physically present, such as pregnancy.
physically.translationZh: 远程医生（TD）并不旨在治疗严重疾病或需要医生亲自到场的病症，例如孕期诊疗。

physically.sentenceEn: They are part of a built-in mechanism, which allows us to cope with the ups and downs of our lives both physically and mentally.
physically.translationZh: 它们是一种内在机制的组成部分，使我们能够在生理和心理上应对生活中的起起落落。
physically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

physically.sentenceEn: The Center for Disease Control has also found that teens are far less physically active than they were even a decade ago.
physically.translationZh: 疾病控制中心还发现，青少年的体育活动量甚至比十年前大幅减少。
physically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

physically.sentenceEn: More and more evidence shows it makes us mentally and physically healthier to routinely count our blessings.
physically.translationZh: 越来越多的证据表明，经常感恩有助于我们的身心健康。

physically.sentenceEn: Peter appeared slightly stronger than Rachel physically .
physically.translationZh: 彼得的体力似乎比瑞秋略强一些。

physician.sentenceEn: And of those physicians , many are concentrated in cities: 70% of the country's population live in rural areas, yet less than 20% of health workers practice there.
physician.translationZh: 而在这些医生中，许多人都集中在城市：全国70%的人口居住在农村地区，但在那里执业的卫生工作者却不到20%。

physician.sentenceEn: Inside the center, the laptop screen lights up to reveal Dr. Tina Mustahid, TD's head physician , live-streamed(网络直播) from the capital city of Dhaka for free remote medical consultations.
physician.translationZh: 在医疗中心内，笔记本电脑屏幕亮起，显现出TD的首席医师蒂娜·穆斯塔希德博士的身影，她正从首都达卡通过网络直播为患者提供免费远程医疗咨询。

physician.sentenceEn: It did not occur to the two physicians that a hallway was not the most appropriate place for that particular piece of news.
physician.translationZh: 这两位医生完全没有想到，走廊并不是宣布这种消息的合适场所。
physician.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

physician.sentenceEn: In a poll of 1500 family physicians , only 15% had used it in their practices—but 90% said they would if it were appropriately reimbursed(补偿).
physician.translationZh: 在一项针对1500名家庭医生的调查中，只有15%的医生在其诊疗工作中使用过远程医疗——但90%的医生表示，如果补偿合理，他们愿意使用。

physician.sentenceEn: An overwhelming majority of family physicians are willing to use telemedicine if they are duly paid.
physician.translationZh: 绝大多数家庭医生如果能获得适当的报酬，都愿意使用远程医疗。

physician.sentenceEn: They turn to physicians for advice.

primitive.sentenceEn: In primitive societies, he notes, the division of labor was as yet undeveloped for the most part, requiring each person, family, or tribe to be relatively independent when it came to meeting their own basic material needs.
primitive.translationZh: 他指出，在原始社会中，分工在很大程度上尚未发展，这使得每个人、每个家庭或部落在满足自身基本物质需求时都必须保持相对独立。

primitive.sentenceEn: However, the exclusively local and face-to-face nature of economic and political organization in the ancient and prehistoric worlds constantly impressed upon these primitive peoples the uncontrollable reality of others and their needs.
primitive.translationZh: 然而，在古代和史前世界，经济与政治组织完全局限于地方范围且具有面对面交流的特性，这使这些原始民族不断感受到他人及其需求是一种无法控制的现实。

primitive.sentenceEn: Tracking the economic development of mankind from primitive to modern societies, Tocqueville observed a paradox unfolding over the centuries as economic realities and human experience of those realities strayed further and further from each other.
primitive.translationZh: 托克维尔追踪人类从原始社会到现代社会的经济发展历程，观察到几个世纪以来出现了一个悖论：经济现实与人类对这些现实的体验之间的差距越来越大。

primitive.sentenceEn: This is not to deny that basic forms of trade took place, but, for the most part, our primitive ancestors lived fairly self-reliant, if crushingly poor, lives.
primitive.translationZh: 这并非否认存在基本形式的贸易活动，但在大多数情况下，我们的远古祖先过着相当自给自足、尽管极度贫困的生活。

primitive.sentenceEn: In primitive societies, people had to rely mostly on themselves to meet their personal needs.
primitive.translationZh: 在原始社会中，人们大多只能依靠自己来满足个人需求。

primitive.sentenceEn: It provides habitats for more primitive tribes.
primitive.translationZh: 它为更原始的部落提供了栖息地。

printing.sentenceEn: Capitalism turned printing from an invention into an industry.
printing.translationZh: 资本主义将印刷术从一项发明转变为一个产业。
printing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

printing.sentenceEn: The immediate effect of printing was to increase the circulation of works that were already popular in a handwritten form, while less popular works went out of circulation.
printing.translationZh: 印刷术的直接影响是增加了那些已经以手写形式流行的作品的传播，而不太受欢迎的作品则不再流传。
printing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

printing.sentenceEn: The biggest sixteenth-century printer, Plantin of Antwerp, had twenty-four printing presses and employed more than a hundred workers.
printing.translationZh: 16世纪规模最大的印刷商是安特卫普的普兰廷，他拥有24台印刷机，雇佣了100多名工人。
printing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

printing.sentenceEn: Right from the start, book printing and publishing were organized on capitalist lines.
printing.translationZh: 从一开始，书籍印刷和出版业就按照资本主义模式组织运营。
printing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

printing.sentenceEn: What was the great cultural impact of printing ?
printing.translationZh: 印刷术对文化的重大影响是什么？

printing.sentenceEn: moveable metal type began to be used in printing
printing.translationZh: 活字金属印刷术开始应用于印刷

promising.sentenceEn: When something that seemed so promising at the start doesn't turn out the way we imagined, we can become overly self-critical.
promising.translationZh: 当一件起初看起来大有可为的事情未能如我们所愿地发展时，我们往往会变得过度自责。

promising.sentenceEn: We like to think of ourselves as a prestigious institution with a highly competitive and promising student body.
promising.translationZh: 我们自视为一所享有盛誉的学府，拥有极具竞争力且充满前途的学生群体。
promising.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第3句

promising.sentenceEn: The painful lessons of recent decades point to a promising candidate: higher wages.
promising.translationZh: 近几十年来的惨痛教训指向了一个充满希望的解决方案：提高工资。
promising.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

promising.sentenceEn: But the primary benefit is usually the passion and excitement associated with playing a role in a promising new company.
promising.translationZh: 但主要的好处通常是那种在一家前景光明的新公司中发挥作用所带来的激情与兴奋。
promising.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

promising.sentenceEn: We usually start off with the more affordable methods and if everything looks promising , then it will justify trying to build a sleep lab and study sleep across cultures that way.
promising.translationZh: 我们通常从成本较低的方法入手，如果一切看起来有前景，那么就值得尝试建立睡眠实验室，通过这种方式进行跨文化睡眠研究。
promising.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

pain.sentenceEn: We stop imagining the life we'd like to have or the person we'd like to be, quickly finding ourselves shattered by the pain of our reality.
pain.translationZh: 我们不再去想象自己想要的生活或想成为的人，很快就发现自己被现实的痛苦击垮。
pain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

pain.sentenceEn: But they can write prescriptions, diagnose common ailments—including digestive issues, joint pain , skin diseases, fever and the common cold—and refer patients to doctors at local hospitals.
pain.translationZh: 但他们可以开具处方，诊断常见疾病——包括消化问题、关节疼痛、皮肤病、发烧和普通感冒——并将患者转诊至当地医院的医生。

pain.sentenceEn: It's natural to be drawn towards pleasure and to step away from pain .
pain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

pain.sentenceEn: After five treatments, there has been dramatic improvement in my arm, and the pain is a fraction of what it was.
pain.translationZh: 经过五次治疗后，我的手臂状况有了显著改善，疼痛也大大减轻了。
pain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

pain.sentenceEn: Then I remembered—the torturing pain in that left elbow.
pain.translationZh: 这时我想起来了——是左肘那钻心的疼痛。
pain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

pain.sentenceEn: It cannot be created without pains .
pain.translationZh: 它的创作离不开心血付出。

particle.sentenceEn: They found that if pollution is frozen to around –18 ℃ in a condensing tube, the particles gather together and fall to the bottom, allowing fresh, clean air to pass through.
particle.translationZh: 研究发现，如果在冷凝管中将污染物冷冻到约 -18 ℃，颗粒就会聚集成团并沉降到底部，从而让清新洁净的空气通过。
particle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

particle.sentenceEn: Indeed, scent particles , in general, can revive memories that have been long forgotten.
particle.translationZh: 事实上，气味分子通常能够唤醒那些早已被遗忘的记忆。
particle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

particle.sentenceEn: A moon can indeed take on a moody blue color, but this only happens when particles of just the right size disperse through the sky—and it has nothing to do with the moon's status as "blue".
particle.translationZh: 月亮确实可以呈现出忧郁的蓝色，但这种现象只有当特定大小的微粒在天空中分散时才会发生——而且这与月亮是否是“蓝月”毫无关系。

particle.sentenceEn: A scent is a chemical particle that floats in through the nose and into the region of the brain responsible for smell, where the sensation is first processed into a form that the brain can read.
particle.translationZh: 气味是一种化学微粒，它通过鼻子进入大脑中负责嗅觉的区域，在那里，这种感觉首先被处理成大脑能够识别的形式。
particle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

particle.sentenceEn: They take over protective functions against soil erosion and landslides(塌方); they make a significant contribution to the water balance as they prevent surface runoff; they filter dirt particles , greenhouse gases and radioactive substances from the air; they produce oxygen; they provide spaces for recreation and they preserve historic and prehistoric remains.
particle.translationZh: 它们承担着防止水土流失和塌方的保护功能；它们通过防止地表径流对水平衡做出重要贡献；它们过滤空气中的尘埃颗粒、温室气体和放射性物质；它们产生氧气；它们提供休闲空间并保护历史和史前遗迹。

particle.sentenceEn: They have managed to freeze polluting particles to around –18 °C.
particle.translationZh: 他们已成功将污染颗粒冷冻至零下 18 摄氏度左右。

passionate.sentenceEn: Potential employers showed greater interest in passionate applicants in part because they believed the applicants would work hard at their jobs without expecting an increase in pay.
passionate.translationZh: 潜在雇主对充满热情的求职者表现出更大兴趣，部分原因是他们认为这些求职者会在工作中努力付出，而不期望加薪。
passionate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第3句

passionate.sentenceEn: Employers of passionate workers do, too.
passionate.translationZh: 有热情员工的雇主也是如此。
passionate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第2句

passionate.sentenceEn: Passion-seekers from wealthy families are better able to wait until a job they are passionate about comes along without worrying about student loans in the meantime.
passionate.translationZh: 来自富裕家庭的寻梦人更有能力等待心仪的工作机会出现，而不必在此期间为学生贷款发愁。
passionate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

passionate.sentenceEn: As an executive coach, I work with numerous passionate and hard-working leaders who don't want to "quit".
passionate.translationZh: 作为一名高管教练，我与许多充满激情、工作勤奋但并不想“离职”的领导者一起工作。

passionate.sentenceEn: What does the author say about employers of passionate workers?
passionate.translationZh: 作者对热情工作者的雇主有何看法？

passionate.sentenceEn: Being passionate about work can make one wealthy.
passionate.translationZh: 对工作充满热情的人往往会收获财富。

philosopher.sentenceEn: In a recently published article, philosopher Julian Baggini suggests we should focus on 'real wealth' for citizens, which does not depend on GDP growth.
philosopher.translationZh: 哲学家朱利安·巴吉尼在最近发表的一篇文章中建议，我们应当关注公民的'真正财富'，而这并不取决于GDP增长。
philosopher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

philosopher.sentenceEn: In a recent startling and thoughtful book, two scholars — Brett Frischmann, a law professor, and Evan Selinger, a philosopher — argue that the answer to that question is "yes".
philosopher.translationZh: 在最近出版的一本发人深省、令人震惊的著作中，两位学者——法学教授布雷特·弗里希曼和哲学家埃文·塞林格——认为，那个问题的答案是肯定的。
philosopher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

philosopher.sentenceEn: Rhetoric is viewed by many philosophers as the method through which the powerful accumulate more power.
philosopher.translationZh: 许多哲学家认为，修辞是有权势者积累更多权力的手段。
philosopher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

philosopher.sentenceEn: For example, some ancient Western philosophers counsel gratitude that is both enduring and complete, and some Eastern thinkers portray it as not merely an attitude but a virtue to be put into practice.
philosopher.translationZh: 例如，一些古代西方哲学家主张感恩应既持久又全然，而一些东方思想家则将感恩不仅视为一种态度，更看作是一种需要践行的美德。

philosopher.sentenceEn: What does philosopher Julian Baggini suggest governments do in a recently published article?
philosopher.translationZh: 哲学家朱利安·巴吉尼在最近发表的一篇文章中建议政府做什么？

philosopher.sentenceEn: It gets misrepresented by philosophers and anthropologists.
philosopher.translationZh: 它遭到了哲学家和人类学家的曲解。

plus.sentenceEn: Plus , Feist says, many artists "are trying to make sense of their internal world and a lot of internal personal experiences that they're trying to give expression and meaning to through their art."
plus.translationZh: 此外，费斯特表示，许多艺术家“正试图理解自己的内心世界，以及许多个人内在体验，他们正努力通过艺术为这些体验赋予表达和意义。”

plus.sentenceEn: Plus , having children later in life can increase the risk of health complications.
plus.translationZh: 此外，晚育会增加健康并发症的风险。
plus.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

plus.sentenceEn: Someone on £ 20,000 could easily afford to give away £ 2,000 per year and still have plenty to live on plus some luxuries.
plus.translationZh: 年收入2万英镑的人完全有能力每年捐赠2000英镑，同时仍有足够的钱维持生活，甚至还能享受一些奢侈品。
plus.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

plus.sentenceEn: Plus , children don't have the cognitive ability to fully understand advertising's intent.
plus.translationZh: 此外，儿童不具备充分理解广告意图的认知能力。
plus.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

plus.sentenceEn: Plus , the majority of student debt is held by graduate degree earners, who earn approximately 25 percent more than their undergraduate counterparts.
plus.translationZh: 此外，大部分学生债务由研究生学历持有者承担，他们的收入比本科生大约高出25%。
plus.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

plus.sentenceEn: Plus , the laptop in my bag was broken too.
plus.translationZh: 而且，我包里的笔记本电脑也摔坏了。
plus.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

precious.sentenceEn: But practiced at its highest level, mise-en-place says that time is precious , resources are precious, space is precious, your self-respect and the respect of others are precious.
precious.translationZh: 但若能将"准备到位"（mise-en-place）发挥到极致，它所传达的是：时间宝贵，资源宝贵，空间宝贵，你的自尊与他人对你的尊重同样宝贵。
precious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

precious.sentenceEn: In a world increasingly focused on speed and competitiveness, solitude is precious and something to be treasured.
precious.translationZh: 在这个日益注重速度与竞争的世界里，独处是珍贵的，值得我们珍惜。

precious.sentenceEn: If we judge the value of gifts based on their price, this gift may seem worthless, but in a distracted world, it is a precious one.
precious.translationZh: 如果我们以价格来衡量礼物的价值，这份礼物或许显得微不足道；但在一个令人分心的世界里，它却弥足珍贵。
precious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

precious.sentenceEn: It takes precious time for them to vent their emotions, complain and try to regain focus after a pointless meeting—one of the main traps of MRS.
precious.translationZh: 在一场毫无意义的会议后，他们需要花费宝贵的时间来发泄情绪、抱怨并试图重新集中注意力——这是MRS的主要陷阱之一。

precious.sentenceEn: Why do many people think music is too precious to impart to AI technology?
precious.translationZh: 为什么许多人认为音乐太过珍贵而不能交给人工智能技术处理？

precious.sentenceEn: It was a good way to preserve one's precious images.
precious.translationZh: 这曾是保存珍贵影像的好方法。

precisely.sentenceEn: But it is precisely those shrinking budgets and the assault of technologically mediated life that make public libraries' cultural and community offerings more important than ever.
precisely.translationZh: 但正是这些日益缩减的预算和科技媒介生活的冲击，使得公共图书馆的文化及社区服务比以往任何时候都更加重要。

precisely.sentenceEn: But additional research has shown that older children and adults are even more likely to mindlessly copy others' actions, and infants are less likely to over-imitate—that is, to precisely copy even impractical actions.
precisely.translationZh: 但进一步的研究表明，年龄较大的儿童和成年人甚至更倾向于盲目模仿他人的行为，而婴儿则不太可能过度模仿——即精确复制甚至包括那些不实用的动作。
precisely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

precisely.sentenceEn: They think that, rather than making our living as innovators, we survive and thrive precisely because we don't think for ourselves.
precisely.translationZh: 他们认为，我们之所以能够生存和繁衍，并非因为我们是创新者，恰恰是因为我们不会独立思考。
precisely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

precisely.sentenceEn: Here when the truck arrives at its destination, staff in the operation center direct it precisely where to unload.
precisely.translationZh: 在这里，当卡车抵达目的地时，运营中心的工作人员会精确指示其卸载位置。
precisely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

precisely.sentenceEn: In January 1901, at 1,020 feet-almost precisely the depth predicted by Higgins' wild guess—the well roared and suddenly ejected mud and six tons of drilling pipe out of the ground, terrifying those present.
precisely.translationZh: 1901年1月，在1020英尺深处——几乎与希金斯胡乱猜测的深度完全一致——油井突然咆哮起来，猛地将泥浆和六吨重的钻杆喷出地面，令在场的人惊恐不已。
precisely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

precisely.sentenceEn: Few people can describe it precisely .
precisely.translationZh: 但很少有人能准确描述这种世界上最强大、最重要的货币。

predator.sentenceEn: Though a layman of economics, at least I know that investing with borrowed money will turn the borrower into the predator rather than the decent and kind lender.
predator.translationZh: 虽然我对经济学一窍不通，但至少知道借钱投资会让借款人变成掠夺者，而非原本正派善良的贷款人。
predator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

predator.sentenceEn: The kid hides and the adult pretends to be a predator , searching for the child while howling like a dangerous beast.
predator.translationZh: 孩子躲藏起来，成年人则假装成捕食者，一边像猛兽般嚎叫，一边搜寻孩子。
predator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第4句

predator.sentenceEn: If an animal encounters a predator and escapes, for example, it's important to remember where and when that encounter happened.
predator.translationZh: 例如，如果一只动物遭遇捕食者并成功逃脱，记住这次遭遇发生的地点和时间就非常重要。
predator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第10句

predator.sentenceEn: On the one hand, some say, nothing could be more natural than hunting, and indeed just about every animal species—including humans—has been either predator or prey at some point in its evolution.
predator.translationZh: 一方面，有人说，没有什么比狩猎更自然的了，事实上，几乎所有动物物种——包括人类——在其进化过程中的某个阶段都曾扮演过捕食者或猎物的角色。
predator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

predator.sentenceEn: And, ironic as it sounds, since humans have wiped out many animal predators , some see hunting as a natural way to reduce the herds of prey animals that now reproduce beyond the environment's carrying capacity.
predator.translationZh: 然而，听起来颇具讽刺意味的是，由于人类已经消灭了许多肉食动物，一些人将狩猎视为一种自然的方式，以减少如今繁殖数量已超出环境承载能力的猎物群。
predator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

predator.sentenceEn: Some predators may often turn out to be prey of other predators .
predator.translationZh: 有些捕食者常常会成为其他捕食者的猎物。

prestigious.sentenceEn: We like to think of ourselves as a prestigious institution with a highly competitive and promising student body.
prestigious.translationZh: 我们自视为一所享有盛誉的学府，拥有极具竞争力且充满前途的学生群体。
prestigious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第3句

prestigious.sentenceEn: I just can't resist the allure of all those prestigious goods.
prestigious.translationZh: 我就是无法抗拒那些名牌商品的诱惑。
prestigious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

prestigious.sentenceEn: It deterred luxury consumers who found their expensive clothing more closely associated with working-class youth culture than a prestigious heritage fashion house.
prestigious.translationZh: 这让奢侈品消费者望而却步，他们发现自己高价购买的服装，与其说是出自久负盛名的传统时尚品牌，不如说更像是与工薪阶层青年文化相关联的产物。

prestigious.sentenceEn: This classical model has traditionally produced prestigious universities, but it is now challenged by the digitalisation of society—which allows everybody who is connected to the internet to access learning—and by the need to acquire skills in step with a fast-changing world.
prestigious.translationZh: 这种传统模式在历史上造就了许多名牌大学，但如今它正面临两方面的挑战：一是社会数字化——互联网的普及让每个人都能接触到学习资源；二是在瞬息万变的世界中，人们需要不断学习新技能以跟上时代步伐。

prestigious.sentenceEn: Destroying old stock is a practice not just of luxury brands but of less prestigious fashion brands.
prestigious.translationZh: 销毁旧库存不仅是奢侈品牌的做法，也是那些不太知名的时尚品牌的做法。

prestigious.sentenceEn: It has a long history in the man's prestigious institution.
prestigious.translationZh: 这所著名的男子学府有着悠久的历史。

processing.sentenceEn: The debate centers around a system developed by Monteiro and colleagues that classifies foods by their degree of industrial processing , ranging from unprocessed to ultra-processed.
processing.translationZh: 这场争论围绕着由Monteiro及其同事开发的一个系统展开，该系统根据食品的工业加工程度对其进行分类，范围从非加工食品到超加工食品。
processing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

processing.sentenceEn: It seems the degree of interference from background noise depends on the overlap between the processing required on the task and the processing required to screen out the background noise.
processing.translationZh: 背景噪音的干扰程度似乎取决于任务所需的信息处理与屏蔽背景噪音所需的信息处理之间的重叠程度。
processing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

processing.sentenceEn: In addition to the likely negative long-term impact on sales, this verbal trick sends a message that innovations in farming and food processing are unwelcome, eventually leading to less efficiency, fewer choices for consumers, and ultimately, more costly food products.
processing.translationZh: 除了可能对销售产生长期负面影响外，这种文字游戏还传递出农业和食品加工创新不受欢迎的信号，最终会导致效率降低、消费者选择减少，并且最终会使食品价格上涨。
processing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

processing.sentenceEn: Everything from production to storage and processing must improve.
processing.translationZh: 从生产到储存再到加工的各个环节都必须得到改善。
processing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

processing.sentenceEn: Standardization of forms for automatic processing will save a lot of medical expenses.
processing.translationZh: 标准化自动处理表格将节省大量医疗费用。

processing.sentenceEn: Welcome new innovations in food processing .
processing.translationZh: 欢迎食品加工领域的创新

publication.sentenceEn: Marissa Mayer, former vice president for search products and user experience at Google, once wrote in a publication on Bloomberg, "Constraints shape and focus problems and provide clear challenges to overcome; Creativity thrives best when constrained."
publication.translationZh: 谷歌前搜索产品与用户体验副总裁玛丽莎·梅耶尔曾在彭博社的一篇文章中写道：“约束塑造并聚焦问题，提供明确的挑战去克服；创造力在受约束时才能蓬勃发展。”
publication.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

publication.sentenceEn: Women receive lower salaries and face greater childcare demands, for instance, which can result in fewer publications and grants—the kinds of things that journals look for when deciding who to appoint.
publication.translationZh: 例如，女性薪资更低，且面临更大的育儿压力，这可能导致她们发表的论文和获得的资助更少——而这些正是期刊在决定任命人选时所看重的因素。
publication.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

publication.sentenceEn: Propagating research findings beyond academic publications is particularly crucial for addressing certain social discrepancies.
publication.translationZh: 将研究成果传播到学术出版物之外，对于解决某些社会矛盾尤为关键。
publication.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

publication.sentenceEn: Yet in the years following the publication of this study, Steinberg began to believe that this interpretation did not capture the whole picture.
publication.translationZh: 然而，在这项研究发表后的几年里，斯坦伯格开始认为这一解释并未全面反映情况。

publication.sentenceEn: Merian's masterpiece came under attack a century after its publication .
publication.translationZh: 梅里安的杰作在出版一个世纪后遭到了抨击。

publication.sentenceEn: Male researchers have enough representation in the editorial boards to ensure their publications .
publication.translationZh: 男性研究人员在编辑委员会中拥有足够的代表性，足以确保其论文得到发表。

participation.sentenceEn: The WHO recommends establishing institutions that facilitate community participation —educational programs and interventions that provide skills for promoting mental wellbeing.
participation.translationZh: 世界卫生组织建议建立促进社区参与的机构——提供促进心理健康技能的教育项目和干预措施。
participation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

participation.sentenceEn: Extra features in electronic books may increase children's participation with them; however, if these features don't draw attention to the educational content, they may not serve as a supportive feature.
participation.translationZh: 电子书中的额外功能可能会增加儿童的参与度；然而，如果这些功能无法引导儿童关注教育内容，它们可能无法起到辅助作用。
participation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

participation.sentenceEn: Employees also feel taxed when they are invited together to meetings that don't inspire participation , says Cliff Scott, professor of organisational science.
participation.translationZh: 组织科学教授克利夫·斯科特表示，当员工被一同邀请参加那些无法激发参与热情的会议时，他们也会感到身心俱疲。

participation.sentenceEn: Although many such monitoring schemes use anonymised data and participation is voluntary, many staffers remain sceptical and fear an erosion of their civil liberties.
participation.translationZh: 尽管许多此类监控方案使用匿名数据且参与是自愿的，但不少员工仍持怀疑态度，并担心其公民自由受到侵蚀。
participation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

participation.sentenceEn: To establish whether effects such as improved concentration are caused by music participation itself, and not by investing time in an extracurricular activity of any kind, Assal Habibi, a psychology professor at the University of Southern California, is conducting a five-year longitudinal study with children from low-income communities in Los Angeles.
participation.translationZh: 为了确定诸如注意力提升等效果是否由参与音乐活动本身引起，而非仅仅因为投入时间参与任何类型的课外活动，南加州大学心理学教授阿萨尔·哈比比正在对洛杉矶低收入社区的儿童开展一项为期五年的纵向研究。

participation.sentenceEn: Wardian hopes his participation in the seven-day marathon series will contribute to a worthy cause.
participation.translationZh: 沃迪安希望自己参与这项七日马拉松系列赛能为一项有意义的事业做出贡献。

pave.sentenceEn: Having a "beautiful" campus means green and perfectly maintained lawns along with flower beds and paved sidewalks.
pave.translationZh: 拥有"美丽"的校园意味着有绿色且维护良好的草坪，以及花坛和铺设整齐的人行道。
pave.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

pave.sentenceEn: It is hoped that the work could pave the way for simple modification of air conditioning units so that they can also clean polluted indoor air.
pave.translationZh: 研究人员希望这项工作能为空调设备的简易改造铺平道路，使其能够同时净化受污染的室内空气。
pave.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

pave.sentenceEn: While the Georgians made 'taking the waters' or bathing particularly fashionable, it was previous generations who paved the way, creating greater interest in Bath and its springs.
pave.translationZh: 虽然乔治王朝时期的人们让“饮矿泉水”或泡温泉变得尤为流行，但正是前几代人的努力为其奠定了基础，激发了人们对巴斯及其温泉的更大兴趣。
pave.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

pave.sentenceEn: In the second phase, as they grow wealthier, they pave the roads, allowing traffic to move faster and pushing up the death rate.
pave.translationZh: 在第二阶段，随着国家日益富裕，它们开始铺设道路，这使得车辆行驶速度加快，同时也推高了死亡率。
pave.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

pave.sentenceEn: I sincerely hope that those who assert that automation will make us more effective and pave the way for new occupations are right, but the reality of automation's detrimental effects on workers makes me skeptical.
pave.translationZh: 我真诚地希望那些声称自动化将提高我们的效率并为新职业铺平道路的人是对的，但自动化对工人造成的不利影响的现实让我持怀疑态度。
pave.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

pave.sentenceEn: What do we learn from the lecture about the world's oldest paved road in Egypt?
pave.translationZh: 从讲座中我们了解到关于埃及那条世界最古老铺砌道路的哪些信息？

persist.sentenceEn: Across one study and a pre-registered duplication, babies who had seen an adult persist and succeed push the button about twice as many times as those who saw an adult effortlessly succeed.
persist.translationZh: 在一项研究及其预注册的重复实验中，那些看到成人坚持不懈并最终成功的婴儿，按按钮的次数大约是那些看到成人毫不费力就成功的婴儿的两倍。
persist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

persist.sentenceEn: We are all susceptible to the sunk-cost delusion, an unconscious bias that leads us to persist in an endeavor we have already invested time, effort, or money into — even when abandoning it would be more beneficial.
persist.translationZh: 我们都容易受到沉没成本谬误的影响。这是一种无意识的偏见，促使我们坚持投入了时间、精力或金钱的事业——即便放弃它会更有利。

persist.sentenceEn: You may feel as if you are an independent individual, acting autonomously in the world; that you have an unchanging inner self that persists throughout your lifetime, acting as a central anchor-point with the world changing around you.
persist.translationZh: 你可能会觉得自己是一个独立的个体，在世界上自主行动；你拥有一个终生不变的内在自我，在周围世界不断变化的同时，作为一个核心锚点存在。
persist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

persist.sentenceEn: So why does the idea of the American Dream persist ?
persist.translationZh: 那么，为什么美国梦的理念会持续存在呢？
persist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

persist.sentenceEn: With my family situation getting more complicated and the end of my university education nearing, persisting with Art History just doesn't seem the right choice.
persist.translationZh: 随着家庭情况日益复杂，大学毕业也日渐临近，坚持攻读艺术史似乎不再是正确的选择。
persist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

persist.sentenceEn: Socioeconomic inequality is likely to persist .
persist.translationZh: 社会经济不平等可能会持续存在。

pigeon.sentenceEn: Previous studies have suggested that other animals, including pigeons , dolphins, honeybees and some primates(灵长类动物), can discern same from different, but only after extensive training.
pigeon.translationZh: 此前的研究表明，包括鸽子、海豚、蜜蜂和一些灵长类动物在内的其他动物能够分辨相同与不同，但这需要经过大量训练。
pigeon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

pigeon.sentenceEn: Eventually those billions and billions of birds shrank to a single remaining specimen, a passenger pigeon named Martha, who died on September 1,1914, in captivity at the Cincinnati Zoo.
pigeon.translationZh: 最终，那数十亿只旅鸽凋零至仅剩最后一只——一只名叫玛莎的旅鸽，它于1914年9月1日在辛辛那提动物园的笼中离世。
pigeon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

pigeon.sentenceEn: In addition, large tracts of the pigeons' nesting territory were being cleared away for planting crops and creating pasture land.
pigeon.translationZh: 此外，大量旅鸽的筑巢领地被清理出来，用于种植农作物和开辟牧场。
pigeon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

pigeon.sentenceEn: At one point, there were more passenger pigeons than any other species of bird.
pigeon.translationZh: 曾经一度，旅鸽的数量超过了其他任何鸟类。
pigeon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

pigeon.sentenceEn: As numerous as the passenger pigeons were, they were not an infinite resource.
pigeon.translationZh: 尽管旅鸽曾数量繁多，但它们并非取之不尽的资源。
pigeon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

pigeon.sentenceEn: The now extinct passenger pigeon has the dubious honor of being the last species anyone ever expected to disappear.
pigeon.translationZh: 现已灭绝的旅鸽拥有一项不太光彩的“荣誉”——它是人类最意想不到会消失的物种。
pigeon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

prescribe.sentenceEn: They measured three types of perfectionism: self-oriented, or a desire to be perfect; socially prescribed , or a desire to live up to others' expectations; and other-oriented, or holding others to unrealistic standards.
prescribe.translationZh: 他们测量了三种类型的完美主义：自我导向型，即渴望做到完美；社会规定型，即渴望达到他人的期望；以及他人导向型，即对他人抱有不切实际的标准。

prescribe.sentenceEn: Curran describes socially prescribed perfectionism as "My self-esteem is contingent on what other people think."
prescribe.translationZh: 柯伦将社会规定型完美主义描述为“我的自尊取决于他人的看法。”

prescribe.sentenceEn: From 1989 to 2016, they found, self-oriented perfectionism scores increased by 10 percent, socially prescribed scores rose by 33 percent, and other-oriented perfectionism increased by 16 percent.
prescribe.translationZh: 他们发现，从1989年到2016年，自我导向型完美主义得分上升了10%，社会规定型完美主义得分上升了33%，他人导向型完美主义得分上升了16%。

prescribe.sentenceEn: I'm going to prescribe some special sleeping pills for you.
prescribe.translationZh: 我会给你开一些特殊的安眠药。
prescribe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第3句

prescribe.sentenceEn: Socially prescribed perfectionism is described as one's self-esteem depending on other people's opinion.
prescribe.translationZh: 社会规定型完美主义被描述为一个人的自尊取决于他人的看法。

procedure.sentenceEn: W: We are down to two candidates for one position, and we need to decide by the end of the day in order to finalize this whole procedure .
procedure.translationZh: 女：我们已经筛选到只剩两位候选人竞争一个职位，今天之内必须做出决定，以便完成整个招聘流程。
procedure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

procedure.sentenceEn: "You might imagine micro-robots as agents to repair or assemble small structures or machines in industry or as surgical assistants to clear clogged arteries, to stop internal bleeding, or to eliminate cancerous tumours—all in minimally invasive procedures ," Rogers said.
procedure.translationZh: 罗杰斯说：“你可以将微型机器人想象成工业中用于修复或组装小型结构或机器的工具，或者是外科手术的助手，用于疏通堵塞的动脉、止血或消除癌性肿瘤——所有这些都通过微创手术完成。”
procedure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

procedure.sentenceEn: It's easy to understand why people sometimes disobey procedures intentionally.
procedure.translationZh: 人们有时为何会有意不遵守规定，这一点其实不难理解。
procedure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

procedure.sentenceEn: They asked the workers a range of procedure-related questions, such as whether they found the procedures useful, how confident they felt in their job, how comfortable they were to speak up in the workplace, and how closely they followed any new procedures set by their managers.
procedure.translationZh: 他们向工人提出了一系列与规程相关的问题，例如他们是否认为这些规程有用、对自己的工作有多大信心、在工作场合表达意见时感到有多自在，以及他们对经理制定的新规程遵守得有多严格。
procedure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

procedure.sentenceEn: One way to deal with the housing crisis is for the government to simplify approval procedures for housing projects.
procedure.translationZh: 解决住房危机的一个方法是政府简化住房项目的审批程序。

procedure.sentenceEn: They hold different views on the procedure .
procedure.translationZh: 他们对这一程序持有不同看法。

pest.sentenceEn: The crop was attacked by pests .
These new crops must also be more resistant to drought, heat and pests .
pest.translationZh: 这些新型作物还必须具备更强的抗旱、抗高温和抗虫害能力。
pest.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

pest.sentenceEn: There's unpredictable weather, changes in soil quality, and the ever-present possibility that pests and diseases may pay a visit.
pest.translationZh: 天气变幻莫测，土壤质量也会变化，而且病虫害随时可能来袭。

pest.sentenceEn: At the same time, this sea-water also kills off the greedy giant apple snail, an introduced pest that feeds on young rice plants.
pest.translationZh: 与此同时，这些海水也会杀死贪婪的福寿螺——一种以水稻幼苗为食的外来害虫。
pest.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

pest.sentenceEn: White storks feed on locusts(蝗虫) and other insects that can become pests if their numbers get out of hand.
pest.translationZh: 白鹳以蝗虫及其他昆虫为食，这些昆虫的数量一旦失控就可能成为害虫。
pest.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

pest.sentenceEn: Its immediate priority is to bring the pest under control.
pest.translationZh: 该项目的首要任务是控制这种害虫。

philosophy.sentenceEn: Isn't that a philosophy for our time?
philosophy.translationZh: 这不正是我们这个时代的处世哲学吗？
philosophy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

philosophy.sentenceEn: We have learned to worry about asteroids(小行星) and super volcanoes, but the more likely scenario, according to Nick Bostrom, a professor of philosophy at Oxford, is that we humans will destroy ourselves.
philosophy.translationZh: 我们已经学会了担忧小行星和超级火山，但牛津大学哲学教授尼克·博斯特罗姆认为，更可能发生的情况是人类自我毁灭。
philosophy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

philosophy.sentenceEn: In his work, Bostrom uses the tools of philosophy and mathematics, in particular, probability theory, to try and determine how we as a species might achieve this safe passage.
philosophy.translationZh: 在其研究工作中，博斯特罗姆运用哲学与数学工具——尤其是概率论，试图确定我们人类作为一个物种如何才能实现这一安全过渡。
philosophy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

philosophy.sentenceEn: Students of mine in a political philosophy course at Indiana University are reading Daniel Defoe's 300-year-old Robinson Crusoe, often regarded as the first novel published in English.
philosophy.translationZh: 我在印第安纳大学教授的政治哲学课程上，学生们正在阅读丹尼尔·笛福300年前的作品《鲁滨逊漂流记》，这部作品通常被认为是英国文学史上第一部小说。

philosophy.sentenceEn: Most universities will encourage you to learn different things from fields as wide-ranging as philosophy and economics.
philosophy.translationZh: 大多数大学会鼓励你学习各种不同领域的知识，范围广泛，涵盖哲学和经济学等学科。
philosophy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

philosophy.sentenceEn: The topic of the nature of skill—and the differences between beginners and experts—has been one of considerable discussion in cognitive science and philosophy .
philosophy.translationZh: 技能的本质以及新手与专家之间的差异这一话题，在认知科学和哲学领域一直备受关注和讨论。
philosophy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

physicist.sentenceEn: One cannot assume communication expertise—imagine if someone just decided that they were a physicist and started trying to contribute to the field without the necessary background.
physicist.translationZh: 我们不能想当然地认为自己具备传播专业知识的能力——试想，如果有人仅凭自封就声称自己是物理学家，却在毫无必要专业背景的情况下试图在该领域做出贡献，结果会是怎样。
physicist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

physicist.sentenceEn: Shortly after Marconi's death, the nuclear physicist Enrico Fermi—soon to be the developer of the Manhattan Project—wrote that Marconi proved that theory and experimentation were complementary features of progress.
physicist.translationZh: 马可尼去世后不久，核物理学家恩里科·费米——后来的曼哈顿计划开发者——写道，马可尼证明了理论与实验是进步的互补特征。

physicist.sentenceEn: While the world-renowned physicist has often been cautious about AI, raising concerns that humanity could be the architect of its own destruction if it creates a super-intelligence with a will of its own, he was also quick to highlight the positives that AI research can bring.
physicist.translationZh: 尽管这位世界著名的物理学家对人工智能常持谨慎态度，担忧人类若创造出拥有自主意志的超级智能，可能会成为自身毁灭的缔造者，但他也迅速强调了人工智能研究可能带来的积极影响。
physicist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

physicist.sentenceEn: Particle physicists and astronomers collaborate often.
physicist.translationZh: 粒子物理学家和天文学家经常开展合作。
physicist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第1句

physicist.sentenceEn: What is the woman physicist 's main research area?
physicist.translationZh: 这位女物理学家的主要研究领域是什么？

physicist.sentenceEn: It demonstrates how they can become physicists .
physicist.translationZh: 这本书展示了他们如何能够成为物理学家。

poll.sentenceEn: The first study used data from a daily poll of US residents collected between 2013 and 2015.
poll.translationZh: 第一项研究使用了2013年至2015年间收集的美国居民每日民意调查数据。
poll.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

poll.sentenceEn: Let's take a closer look at that poll now.
poll.translationZh: 现在让我们仔细看看这项调查。
poll.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

poll.sentenceEn: More than a third of seniors in the poll said they felt lonely at least some of the time, and 27% said they sometimes or often felt isolated.
poll.translationZh: 调查中超过三分之一的老年人表示他们至少有时会感到孤独，27%的老年人称他们有时或经常感到孤立。
poll.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

poll.sentenceEn: In fact, the poll found that seniors who lived with their children were more likely to report feeling lonely than those who didn't.
poll.translationZh: 事实上，该调查发现，与子女同住的老年人比不同住的老年人更容易感到孤独。
poll.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第6句

poll.sentenceEn: Why does the speaker say the finding of a new national poll reveals a serious problem?
poll.translationZh: 为什么演讲者说一项新的全国民意调查结果揭示了一个严重问题？

poll.sentenceEn: It analysed cases from a daily poll of US residents.
poll.translationZh: 它分析了来自美国居民每日民意调查的案例。

positively.sentenceEn: Less positively , however, many women find that, as they age, they can't have as many kids as they would like.
positively.translationZh: 然而，不太乐观的是，许多女性发现随着年龄增长，她们无法拥有自己期望数量的孩子。
positively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

positively.sentenceEn: It also includes consciously aspiring to acquire things in your life that will positively impact your sense of well-being.
positively.translationZh: 它还包括有意识地渴望在生活中获得那些能对幸福感产生积极影响的事物。
positively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

positively.sentenceEn: Not surprisingly, only eight people responded positively to the wedding invitations and money requests.
positively.translationZh: 不出所料，只有八个人对婚礼邀请和费用要求给予了积极回应。
positively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

positively.sentenceEn: Just hearing something good or bad about a person, a place or thing can influence our opinions positively or negatively.
positively.translationZh: 仅仅是听到关于某人、某地或某物的一些正面或负面评价，就可能会对我们的看法产生积极或消极的影响。
positively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

positively.sentenceEn: Both absent-minded doodling and copying from life have been shown to positively affect your memory and visual perception, so complain loudly the next time your school board slashes the art department's budget.
positively.translationZh: 事实证明，无论是心不在焉的涂画还是写生临摹，都能对记忆力和视觉感知产生积极影响。因此，当下一次学校董事会削减艺术部门的预算时，一定要大声抗议。
positively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

positively.sentenceEn: Dietary diversity is positively related to good health.
positively.translationZh: 饮食多样性与良好健康呈正相关。

prediction.sentenceEn: The brain makes predictions using color.
prediction.translationZh: 大脑利用颜色进行预测。
prediction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第11句

prediction.sentenceEn: These predictions rely on expectations that come from experience.
prediction.translationZh: 这些预测基于来自经验的预期。
prediction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第12句

prediction.sentenceEn: The predictions are going to get better and better, and they will ultimately make common experiences more efficient and pleasant.
prediction.translationZh: 这些预测将会变得越来越精准，最终使日常体验更加高效和愉悦。
prediction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

prediction.sentenceEn: Vas Taras, the lead author of the study, puts it this way: "Tell me how much you make and I will make a pretty accurate prediction about your cultural values. Tell me what your nationality is and I probably will make a wrong prediction ."
prediction.translationZh: 该研究的主要作者瓦斯·塔拉斯这样说：“告诉我你的收入多少，我就能相当准确地预测出你的文化价值观。告诉我你的国籍，我很可能会做出错误的预测。”
prediction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

prediction.sentenceEn: No decentralizing technology so far—not telephones, not television, and not the internet—has dented that human desire to shake hands, despite technologists' predictions to the contrary.
prediction.translationZh: 尽管技术专家曾做出相反预测，但迄今为止，任何去中心化技术——无论是电话、电视还是互联网——都未能削弱人类握手交流的欲望。
prediction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

prediction.sentenceEn: What is Martin Neil Baily's prediction about the financial situation in the future?
prediction.translationZh: 马丁·尼尔·贝利对未来金融形势的预测是什么？

premium.sentenceEn: I can't imagine giving up a premium juicy steak or bacon cheeseburgers.
premium.translationZh: 我无法想象放弃美味多汁的顶级牛排或培根芝士汉堡。
premium.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

premium.sentenceEn: He did it to increase production—he was paying a premium to maintain a reliable workforce.
premium.translationZh: 他这么做是为了提高产量——他支付溢价以维持一支可靠的劳动力队伍。
premium.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

premium.sentenceEn: In the past, ethical products, whether they were fair trade or organic, came at a premium .
premium.translationZh: 过去，道德产品无论是公平贸易产品还是有机产品，价格都相对较高。
premium.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

premium.sentenceEn: Higher prices, called price premiums , can be justified as a way to compensate farmers for providing ecosystem services and avoiding environmental damage or external costs.
premium.translationZh: 被称为溢价的较高价格是合理的，这是对农民提供生态系统服务以及避免环境破坏或外部成本的一种补偿方式。
premium.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

premium.sentenceEn: Joseph says his products are priced 10-20% above organic versions, but depending on the product chosen, compared to non-organic conventional yogurt, consumers could pay a premium of 30-50% or more for grass-fed.
premium.translationZh: 约瑟夫表示，他的产品定价要比有机产品高出10-20%，但与非有机的传统酸奶相比，根据所选产品的不同，消费者购买草饲酸奶可能要多支付30-50%甚至更高的溢价。

premium.sentenceEn: Paying a premium to maintain a reliable workforce attracts more customers.
premium.translationZh: 支付高薪以维持可靠的劳动力队伍会吸引更多顾客。

prevalent.sentenceEn: Recommendation engines, which are increasingly prevalent intermediaries in people's consumption of culture, may serve to constrain choice and minimize luck.
prevalent.translationZh: 推荐引擎作为人们文化消费中日益普及的中介，可能会限制选择并减少偶然性。
prevalent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

prevalent.sentenceEn: Michael Brustein, a clinical psychologist in Manhattan, says when he first began practicing in 2007, he was surprised by how prevalent perfectionism was among his clients, despite how little his graduate training had focused on the phenomenon.
prevalent.translationZh: 曼哈顿临床心理学家迈克尔·布鲁斯坦表示，2007年初执业时，他惊讶地发现完美主义在客户中如此普遍，尽管他的研究生培训对此现象关注甚少。

prevalent.sentenceEn: Early marriage and young motherhood, which are prevalent in these parts of Bangladesh, also contribute to the early onset of health problems.
prevalent.translationZh: 早婚和早育在孟加拉国这些地区十分普遍，这也导致了健康问题的早发。

prevalent.sentenceEn: The overselling, he also found, was more prevalent among neuroscience studies, three quarters of which mischaracterized a mere association between music training and skills enhancement as a cause-and-effect relationship.
prevalent.translationZh: 他还发现，这种夸大其词的现象在神经科学研究中更为普遍，其中四分之三的研究将音乐训练与技能提升之间仅仅存在的关联性错误地描述为因果关系。

prevalent.sentenceEn: What happens with the prevalent use of mobile phones or social media?
prevalent.translationZh: 随着手机或社交媒体的普及使用，会发生什么情况？

prevalent.sentenceEn: It is prevalent even among academics.
prevalent.translationZh: 这种现象在学术界中也十分普遍。

printer.sentenceEn: Every week, TD's medical operators travel to the islands by boat, carrying a laptop, a portable printer for prescriptions and tools to run basic medical screenings such as blood pressure, blood sugar, body temperature and weight.
printer.translationZh: 每周，远程医疗（TD）的医护人员都会乘船前往这些岛屿，随身携带笔记本电脑、用于打印处方的便携式打印机，以及进行基础医疗检查的工具，如测量血压、血糖、体温和体重的设备。

printer.sentenceEn: The biggest sixteenth-century printer , Plantin of Antwerp, had twenty-four printing presses and employed more than a hundred workers.
printer.translationZh: 16世纪规模最大的印刷商是安特卫普的普兰廷，他拥有24台印刷机，雇佣了100多名工人。
printer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

printer.sentenceEn: I was lucky to be at the technology conference then, and I had access to 3D printers .
printer.translationZh: 幸运的是，当时我正在参加一个科技大会，能够使用那里的3D打印机。
printer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

printer.sentenceEn: So I quickly designed a skirt on my computer, and I loaded the file on the printer .
printer.translationZh: 于是我迅速在电脑上设计了一条裙子，并将文件加载到打印机中。
printer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

printer.sentenceEn: What does the speaker say about the printer , Plantin of Antwerp?
printer.translationZh: 关于安特卫普的普兰廷这位印刷商，讲述者说了什么？

printer.sentenceEn: it was the biggest printer in the 16th century.
printer.translationZh: 它是16世纪规模最大的印刷厂

parenting.sentenceEn: It's irrelevant whether their need for a desired schedule is due to, say, parenting responsibilities, or a craving to hang out with a best mate.
parenting.translationZh: 员工期望特定工作安排的原因无关紧要，无论是出于育儿责任，还是渴望与好友相聚。
parenting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

parenting.sentenceEn: It's the basis for healthy parenting , lasting friendships, career development, and so much more.
parenting.translationZh: 它是健康育儿、持久友谊、职业发展以及更多方面的基础。
parenting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第3句

parenting.sentenceEn: "There's this peer-to-peer nature of health care these days with a profound opportunity for parents to learn helpful tips, safety and prevention efforts, pro-vaccine messages and all kinds of other messages from other parents in their social communities," says Wendy Sue Swanson, a pediatrician and executive director of digital health at Seattle Children's Hospital, where she blogs about her own parenting journey to help other parents.
parenting.translationZh: 西雅图儿童医院儿科医生兼数字健康执行董事温迪·休·斯旺森表示：“如今的医疗保健具有这种点对点的性质，这为父母们提供了极好的机会，让他们能从社交圈中的其他父母那里学到有用的育儿技巧、安全防护措施、疫苗接种支持信息以及各种其他信息。”她在医院博客上分享自己的育儿经历，以帮助其他父母。

parenting.sentenceEn: A C.S. Mott survey found among the 56 percent of mothers and 34 percent of fathers who discussed parenting on social media, 72 percent of them said sharing made them feel less alone, and nearly as many said sharing helped them worry less and gave them advice from other parents.
parenting.translationZh: C.S. Mott的一项调查发现，在56%的母亲和34%的父亲中，他们会在社交媒体上讨论育儿话题，其中72%的人表示分享让他们感到不那么孤独，近同等比例的人认为分享帮助他们减少了焦虑，并能从其他父母那里获得建议。

parenting.sentenceEn: In the past decade, even as income inequality has grown, some of the socioeconomic differences in parenting , like reading to children and going to libraries, have narrowed.
parenting.translationZh: 在过去十年中，尽管收入不平等加剧，但父母教养方式中的一些社会经济差异，如给孩子读书和带孩子去图书馆等方面，已经缩小。

parenting.sentenceEn: Parents who share their parenting experiences may find themselves intruding into their children's privacy.
parenting.translationZh: 分享育儿经历的父母可能会发现自己侵犯了孩子的隐私。

partnership.sentenceEn: These are inspiring and hopefully will encourage librarians interested in community services and cultural outreach to make connections with each other, share ideas, and build partnerships .
partnership.translationZh: 这些内容令人鼓舞，希望能激励那些对社区服务和文化推广感兴趣的图书馆员们相互建立联系、分享想法并建立合作伙伴关系。

partnership.sentenceEn: Programs like ImaginOn in Charlotte, North Carolina, provide exciting models that take community partnership , creativity, and creation to a new level.
partnership.translationZh: 北卡罗来纳州夏洛特市的ImaginOn等项目提供了令人振奋的模式，将社区合作、创造力和创新提升到了新高度。

partnership.sentenceEn: These partnerships enabled the mail to quickly follow migrants, helping knit together remote parts of the country.
partnership.translationZh: 这些合作关系使邮件能够迅速跟随移民的脚步，帮助将这个国家的偏远地区连接在一起。
partnership.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

partnership.sentenceEn: Institutions and researchers should invest in partnerships that expand capacity for sharing results more broadly.
partnership.translationZh: 科研机构和研究人员应投资建立合作伙伴关系，以扩大更广泛地分享研究成果的能力。
partnership.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

partnership.sentenceEn: One such partnership is with Elvis & Kresse, an accessories brand working with reclaimed materials.
partnership.translationZh: 其中一个合作伙伴是Elvis & Kresse，这是一家使用再生材料的配饰品牌。

partnership.sentenceEn: A Burberry spokesperson further said, "On the occasions when disposal of products is necessary, we do so in a responsible manner. We are always seeking ways to reduce and revalue our waste. This is a core part of our strategy and we have forged partnerships and committed support to innovative organizations to help reach this goal."
partnership.translationZh: 博柏利发言人进一步表示：“在必须对产品进行处理的情况下，我们会以负责任的方式进行。我们一直在寻求减少浪费并提升其价值的方法。这是我们战略的核心部分，我们已与创新机构建立合作伙伴关系并提供支持，以帮助实现这一目标。”

preservation.sentenceEn: An archivist is an advocate for preservation who, among other things, coordinates the restoration of maps and paintings, the digitization of vital records, and the creation of oral history projects.
preservation.translationZh: 档案管理员是保护工作的倡导者，其职责包括协调地图与画作的修复、重要记录的数字化以及口述历史项目的创建等工作。

preservation.sentenceEn: As the world continues to urbanise, the voices calling for rural preservation may well grow louder.
preservation.translationZh: 随着世界持续城市化，呼吁保护乡村的声音很可能会越来越响亮。
preservation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

preservation.sentenceEn: For those who believe in rural preservation , this is deplorable.
preservation.translationZh: 对于那些主张保护乡村风貌的人来说，这是令人痛心的。
preservation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

preservation.sentenceEn: They're not terribly active or knowledgeable about animal preservation efforts, but they're serious about their health.
