preservation.translationZh: 他们对动物保护方面的事情并不十分积极，也不太了解，但对自己的健康却非常重视。
preservation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第4句

preservation.sentenceEn: Protection policies were originally designed to suppress bad development and boost historic preservation in our urban areas.
preservation.translationZh: 保护政策最初旨在抑制不良开发，并促进城市地区的历史保护。

preservation.sentenceEn: It is detrimental to rural preservation .

prey.sentenceEn: This simulation gives the child crucial information about how to avoid becoming prey , and children tend to find that kind of activity deeply satisfying, presumably because it gives them a safe experience of a potentially catastrophic scenario.
prey.translationZh: 这种模拟为孩子提供了关于如何避免成为猎物的重要信息，而孩子们往往发现这类活动非常令人满足，可能是因为它让他们在安全的环境中体验了潜在的灾难性情景。
prey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

prey.sentenceEn: Farmland species perform valuable ecosystem services, by preying on insects that are our competitors for crops.
prey.translationZh: 农田蜘蛛物种通过捕食那些与我们争夺农作物的昆虫，提供着宝贵的生态系统服务。
prey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

prey.sentenceEn: They use senses of vision and smell to capture their prey .
prey.translationZh: 它们依靠视觉和嗅觉来捕获猎物。
prey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

prey.sentenceEn: And, ironic as it sounds, since humans have wiped out many animal predators, some see hunting as a natural way to reduce the herds of prey animals that now reproduce beyond the environment's carrying capacity.
prey.translationZh: 然而，听起来颇具讽刺意味的是，由于人类已经消灭了许多肉食动物，一些人将狩猎视为一种自然的方式，以减少如今繁殖数量已超出环境承载能力的猎物群。
prey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

prey.sentenceEn: On the one hand, some say, nothing could be more natural than hunting, and indeed just about every animal species—including humans—has been either predator or prey at some point in its evolution.
prey.translationZh: 一方面，有人说，没有什么比狩猎更自然的了，事实上，几乎所有动物物种——包括人类——在其进化过程中的某个阶段都曾扮演过捕食者或猎物的角色。
prey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

prey.sentenceEn: They use their sense of hearing to capture their prey .
prey.translationZh: 它们依靠听觉来捕捉猎物。

privileged.sentenceEn: Gratitude has long enjoyed a privileged position in many of the world's cultural traditions.
privileged.translationZh: 感恩在世界上许多文化传统中一直享有特殊地位。

privileged.sentenceEn: It is simply wrong and unfair that most children have a fraction of the access to choirs, orchestras, art studios and drama that their more privileged peers enjoy.
privileged.translationZh: 大多数孩子能够接触到的合唱团、管弦乐队、艺术工作室和戏剧活动，仅仅是那些享有更多特权的同龄人所拥有的一小部分，这既错误又不公平。
privileged.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

privileged.sentenceEn: Travel was arduous and costly throughout the period, possible only for a privileged class—the same that produced gentlemen scientists, authors, antique experts, and patrons of the arts.
privileged.translationZh: 在整个这一时期，旅行既艰辛又昂贵，只有特权阶层才有可能进行——正是这个阶层孕育了绅士科学家、作家、古董专家和艺术赞助人。
privileged.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

privileged.sentenceEn: The students who use early decision tend to be those who have received higher-quality college guidance, usually a result of coming from a more privileged background.
privileged.translationZh: 采用提前录取方式申请的学生往往是那些获得了更高质量大学申请指导的学生，这通常是因为他们来自更优越的家庭背景。
privileged.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

privileged.sentenceEn: What can be learned about the socially and financially privileged students?
privileged.translationZh: 关于社会和经济上享有特权的学生，我们能了解到什么？

privileged.sentenceEn: Less privileged students will be more competitive at elite schools.
privileged.translationZh: 特权较少的学生在精英学校将更具竞争力。

proceed.sentenceEn: Green means it's safe to proceed (though you should still exercise caution).
proceed.translationZh: 绿色代表可以安全通行（但仍应保持警惕）。

proceed.sentenceEn: Flashing Red Arrows similarly mean to stop and then proceed to take the turn.
proceed.translationZh: 红色闪烁箭头同样表示先停车，然后在确保安全的情况下转弯。

proceed.sentenceEn: By the 1850s, commercial trapping of passenger pigeons was proceeding at an unprecedented pace.
proceed.translationZh: 到19世纪50年代，旅鸽的商业捕捉正以前所未有的速度进行。
proceed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

proceed.sentenceEn: Some "expert amateurs" in the satellite game could provide some inspiration for how to proceed responsibly.
proceed.translationZh: 卫星领域的一些"业余专家"或许能为如何负责任地推进这项技术提供一些启示。

proceed.sentenceEn: When all the participants proceeded to the second pair of tasks, the daydreamers performed 40 percent better than the others.
proceed.translationZh: 当所有参与者继续进行第二组任务时，那些经历了走神的参与者表现比其他人高出40%。
proceed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

proceed.sentenceEn: He has no idea how to proceed with his dissertation.
proceed.translationZh: 他不知道如何继续写他的论文。

punishment.sentenceEn: To me a punishment was being ordered to play games with my cousin Louis."
punishment.translationZh: 对我来说，被罚去和表哥路易斯玩游戏简直就是一种惩罚。

punishment.sentenceEn: The students reported their initial beliefs about whether physical punishment is an effective way to discipline a child on a scale from "1" completely disbelieve to "9" completely believe.
punishment.translationZh: 学生们在从“1”（完全不相信）到“9”（完全相信）的量表上报告了他们对体罚是否是管教孩子的有效方式的初始看法。
punishment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

punishment.sentenceEn: Then, the students again scored their belief about whether physical punishment is effective or not.
punishment.translationZh: 然后，学生们再次对体罚是否有效这一观点进行了评分。
punishment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

punishment.sentenceEn: The students' belief about physical punishment changed when they read a text that argued against their own initial position.
punishment.translationZh: 当学生们阅读了一篇反驳他们最初立场的文章后，他们对体罚的看法发生了改变。
punishment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

punishment.sentenceEn: Physical punishment is used much less by well-educated parents.
punishment.translationZh: 受过良好教育的父母较少使用体罚。

punishment.sentenceEn: Their experiences of physical punishment haunted them.
punishment.translationZh: 他们遭受体罚的经历一直困扰着他们。

password.sentenceEn: It's no small wonder most of us forget our passwords more often than our keys.
password.translationZh: 难怪我们大多数人忘记密码的频率比忘记钥匙还要高。
password.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

password.sentenceEn: If you follow all of the guidelines, you need to use a different password for every one of your accounts; use an incomprehensible variety of letters, numbers, and symbols; sign up for two-step verification; and change every password every time one of them is compromised.
password.translationZh: 如果您遵循所有安全准则，就需要为每个账户设置不同的密码；使用由字母、数字和符号组合而成的难以理解的密码；启用两步验证；并且每当某个密码泄露时，都要更改所有密码。
password.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

password.sentenceEn: Now a new peer-reviewed study by researchers at Aalto University in Finland is attempting to figure out why we forget our passwords in order to help put an end to this frustrating phenomenon.
password.translationZh: 如今，芬兰阿尔托大学的研究人员开展了一项新的同行评审研究，试图找出我们忘记密码的原因，以帮助终结这一令人沮丧的现象。
password.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

password.sentenceEn: Which is to say: you are far more likely to remember a complicated password if you know you'll frequently be using it to log into an account than you are to remember a simple password for an account that you don't expect to log into very often.
password.translationZh: 也就是说：对于一个你需要经常登录的账户，即使密码复杂，你记住它的可能性也远大于记住一个不常登录账户的简单密码。
password.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

password.sentenceEn: Their findings suggest that how likely you are to remember your password has less to do with the password itself and more to do with how often you anticipate using it.
password.translationZh: 他们的研究结果表明，你记住密码的可能性大小，与其说与密码本身有关，不如说与你预期使用密码的频率关系更大。
password.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

password.sentenceEn: Provide incentives for the application of creative passwords .
password.translationZh: 为创意密码的应用提供激励措施。

pasta.sentenceEn: Over there I do the same, but with Italian foods instead of furniture, things like pasta , cheese, wine, chocolates.
pasta.translationZh: 在意大利那边，我做着同样的事情，不过是经营意大利食品而非家具，比如意大利面、奶酪、葡萄酒和巧克力之类的产品。
pasta.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第7句

pasta.sentenceEn: For years, nutritionists have recommended that pasta be kept to a minimum, to cut calories, prevent fat build-up and stop blood sugar shooting up.
pasta.translationZh: 多年来，营养学家一直建议将意大利面的摄入量控制在最低水平，以减少热量摄入、防止脂肪堆积并避免血糖飙升。
pasta.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

pasta.sentenceEn: The low-carbohydrate food movement gave birth to such diets as the Atkins, Paleo and Keto, which advised swapping foods like bread, pasta and potatoes for vegetables, fish and meat.
pasta.translationZh: 低碳水化合物饮食运动催生了阿特金斯饮食法、旧石器饮食法和生酮饮食法等，这些饮食法建议用蔬菜、鱼和肉来替代面包、意大利面和土豆等食物。
pasta.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

pasta.sentenceEn: The reviewers found that pasta had been unfairly demonized(妖魔化) because it had been lumped in with other, more fat-promoting carbohydrates.
pasta.translationZh: 研究人员发现，意大利面一直被不公正地妖魔化，因为它被归入了其他更易增肥的碳水化合物类别。
pasta.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

pasta.sentenceEn: Those involved in the clinical trials on average ate 3.3 servings of pasta a week instead of other carbohydrates, one serving equaling around half a cup.
pasta.translationZh: 参与临床试验的人平均每周食用3.3份意大利面，而非其他碳水化合物，一份大约相当于半杯。
pasta.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

pasta.sentenceEn: Perhaps pasta can be part of a healthy diet.
pasta.translationZh: 或许意大利面可以成为健康饮食的一部分。
pasta.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

patience.sentenceEn: I ask this, because, frankly, some people at my end are running out of patience .
patience.translationZh: 我这么问是因为，坦白说，我方有些人已经渐渐失去耐心了。
patience.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

patience.sentenceEn: We therefore comb through the fine details of all contracts, rest assured, we all appreciate your firm's patience .
patience.translationZh: 因此，我们正在仔细梳理所有合同的细节。请放心，我们都非常感谢贵公司的耐心等待。
patience.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

patience.sentenceEn: For a photographer, it requires patience and probably a few spare tires to maneuver the network of unpaved "roads", but the rewards are plenty.
patience.translationZh: 对于摄影师而言，要想在这片土地上拍摄，不仅需要耐心，或许还得备上几条备胎，以便在纵横交错的土路网络中穿梭，但回报必定丰厚。
patience.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

patience.sentenceEn: Sometimes it's really obvious things that local doctors don't have the patience to talk through with their patients.
patience.translationZh: 有时候，问题明明很明显，但当地医生却没耐心跟病人详细沟通。

patience.sentenceEn: TD doctors are welcome to the islanders because they treat the sick with respect and patience .
patience.translationZh: 远程医生（TD）受到岛民的欢迎，因为他们以尊重和耐心的态度对待病人。

patience.sentenceEn: They lose patience when their phone call is not promptly answered.
patience.translationZh: 如果电话没有被及时接听，他们就会失去耐心。

perfection.sentenceEn: According to a study, apps like Instagram, Snapchat and FaceTune allow users to achieve a level of perfection that was previously only observed in beauty magazines.
perfection.translationZh: 一项研究显示，像Instagram、Snapchat和FaceTune这类应用能让用户达到一种此前只有在美容杂志中才能见到的完美程度。
perfection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

perfection.sentenceEn: We strive for perfection , it seems, because we feel we must in order to get ahead.
perfection.translationZh: 看来，我们追求完美是因为我们觉得为了取得成功必须如此。

perfection.sentenceEn: Along with other therapists, Pryor, who is now with the Family Institute at Northwestern University, is trying to sound the alarm about a tendency among young adults and college students to strive for perfection in their work—sometimes at any cost.
perfection.translationZh: 普赖尔目前就职于西北大学家庭研究所，她正与其他治疗师一起，试图就年轻人和大学生在工作中追求完美——有时不惜任何代价——这一趋势发出警告。

perfection.sentenceEn: Social media can lead people on the unhealthy quest for perfection .
perfection.translationZh: 社交媒体会诱导人们进行不健康的完美追求。
perfection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

perfection.sentenceEn: In trying to overcome perfectionism, some people are still pursuing perfection .
perfection.translationZh: 在试图克服完美主义的过程中，有些人仍在追求完美。

perfection.sentenceEn: Strive for perfection regardless of the cost.
perfection.translationZh: 不惜一切代价追求完美

persistent.sentenceEn: "Since our bodies are essentially made anew every few weeks, the material in them alone is clearly insufficient to explain the persistent thread of an identity."
persistent.translationZh: 既然我们的身体每隔几周就基本上会更新一次，那么显然仅凭体内的物质不足以解释身份认同这一持续存在的脉络。
persistent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

persistent.sentenceEn: After a few sessions about general health issues Fazila finally opened up about something else that was bothering her: her persistent skin condition.
persistent.translationZh: 在进行了几次关于一般健康问题的咨询后，法齐拉终于敞开心扉，谈及另一件一直困扰她的事情：她那顽固的皮肤疾病。

persistent.sentenceEn: W: I had to be really persistent and it was very hard work.
persistent.translationZh: 我必须非常坚持不懈，这是一份非常辛苦的工作。
persistent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

persistent.sentenceEn: The persistent haze over many of our cities is a reminder of the polluted air that we breathe.
persistent.translationZh: 许多城市上空挥之不去的雾霾提醒着我们，我们呼吸的空气已受到污染。
persistent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

persistent.sentenceEn: But in the early years of their marriage, both were disturbed by persistent arguments that seem to fade away without ever being truly resolved.
persistent.translationZh: 但在婚姻初期，两人都因无休止的争吵而困扰，这些争吵似乎总是不了了之，从未真正得到解决。
persistent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

persistent.sentenceEn: It was a breakthrough made with persistent efforts.
persistent.translationZh: 这是一项通过不懈努力取得的突破。

pile.sentenceEn: We may be piled up like boxes in the city, but this brings energy efficiency that the countryside cannot match.
pile.translationZh: 我们或许像城市里堆叠的盒子一样居住密集，但这带来了乡村无法比拟的能源效率。
pile.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

pile.sentenceEn: The naked eye might see a pile of rocks, but technology can reveal the precious artifacts(人工制品) that lie hidden on the ocean floor.
pile.translationZh: 肉眼可能只能看到一堆岩石，但技术却能揭示出隐藏在海底的珍贵人工制品。

pile.sentenceEn: Otherwise, the growing piles of pennies, quarters and euros could clog up the fountains' works.
pile.translationZh: 否则，越积越多的便士、25美分硬币和欧元硬币可能会堵塞喷泉的运转机制。
pile.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

pile.sentenceEn: Behind a heap of blackened oak beams that lay piled up where they had fallen, daylight from vast holes in the cathedral roof lit a golden cross over a statue by Nicolas Coustou, which appeared to have escaped damage.
pile.translationZh: 在一堆坍塌后堆积在一起的焦黑橡木梁后面，教堂屋顶巨大破洞中透进的日光，照亮了尼古拉·库斯托一尊雕像上方的金色十字架——这尊雕像似乎未受损伤。

pile.sentenceEn: During months without water under a harsh sun, they wither, shrink and contract until they look like a pile of dead gray leaves.
pile.translationZh: 在烈日下缺水的数月里，它们会枯萎、萎缩、蜷缩，直到看起来像一堆干枯的灰叶。

pile.sentenceEn: What problem might be caused by the growing piles of coins in fountains?
pile.translationZh: 喷泉中堆积的硬币越来越多可能会导致什么问题？

pill.sentenceEn: I'm going to prescribe some special sleeping pills for you.
pill.translationZh: 我会给你开一些特殊的安眠药。
pill.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第3句

pill.sentenceEn: But it's a narrative often drowned out by the shame that marketers rely on to peddle us their diet pills , miracle face creams and breathable yoga pants—as if self-love is a purchasable commodity.
pill.translationZh: 但这种叙述常常被商家利用的羞耻感所淹没——他们向我们兜售减肥药、神奇面霜和透气 yoga 裤，仿佛自爱成了一种可以购买的商品。
pill.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

pill.sentenceEn: Men aspire to be able to show off their 6 packs, or their v-shaped backs and there's a growing market of slimming pills aimed at men too.
pill.translationZh: 男性也渴望能炫耀自己的六块腹肌或V型背，而针对男性的减肥药市场也在不断扩大。
pill.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

pill.sentenceEn: They come in powders, pills and bars.
pill.translationZh: 它们有粉末、药片和能量棒等多种形式。

pill.sentenceEn: For example, aspirin is seldom thought of as dangerous, but there are many reports of accidental poisoning of young children who take too many aspirin pills as well as the possible development of Reye's syndrome in children with flu.
pill.translationZh: 例如，阿司匹林很少被认为是危险药物，但已有许多关于幼儿误服过量阿司匹林药片导致中毒的报告，同时，患流感的儿童也有可能患上雷氏综合征。
pill.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

pill.sentenceEn: Buy some sleeping pills for him from the drugstore.
pill.translationZh: 从药店给他买些安眠药。

plot.sentenceEn: Let's say for example, there are two landowners who are in a thorny disagreement about something like the borders of their adjacent plots .
plot.translationZh: 比如说，假设有两位土地所有者，他们在相邻地块的边界等问题上陷入了棘手的争执。
plot.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

plot.sentenceEn: Plots in Rwanda are so small that you could fit 250 of them onto the average American farm.
plot.translationZh: 卢旺达的农田面积非常小，大约250块这样的农田才能抵得上一个美国普通农场的面积。

plot.sentenceEn: The increasing digitisation of our society means that everything from paying a gas bill to plotting a route to a friend's house and even making a phone call is at the mercy of your internet connection.
plot.translationZh: 我们社会的日益数字化意味着，从支付燃气账单、规划去朋友家的路线，到甚至打电话，一切都依赖于你的互联网连接。
plot.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

plot.sentenceEn: Parents should instead watch with their kids and help them to understand the plot .
plot.translationZh: 相反，父母应该和孩子一起观看，并帮助他们理解剧情。
plot.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

plot.sentenceEn: We must be willing to stay alone at least for some time in order to plot our own course.
plot.translationZh: 我们必须愿意至少独处一段时间，才能规划自己的人生道路。

plot.sentenceEn: Help their children understand the program's plot .
plot.translationZh: 帮助孩子理解节目的情节

pollutant.sentenceEn: Their method was able to remove 99% of pollutants .
pollutant.translationZh: 他们的方法能够去除99%的污染物。
pollutant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

pollutant.sentenceEn: Their approach is flexible enough that in principle other important quality-of-life changes could be incorporated-for example, decreases in total emissions of pollutants and declines in crime rates.
pollutant.translationZh: 他们的方法具有足够的灵活性，原则上可以纳入其他重要的生活质量变化因素——例如，污染物排放总量的减少和犯罪率的下降。
pollutant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

pollutant.sentenceEn: Previously, scientists noticed pollutants arriving in the Arctic with the wind.
pollutant.translationZh: 此前，科学家们注意到污染物通过风力抵达北极。
pollutant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

pollutant.sentenceEn: The pollutants in the ponds appear to come from fish that fulmars eat when they're out on the ocean.
pollutant.translationZh: 池塘中的污染物似乎来自管鼻藿在海洋中捕食的鱼类。
pollutant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

pollutant.sentenceEn: What did scientists previously notice about pollutants in the Arctic?
pollutant.translationZh: 科学家此前注意到北极污染物的什么情况？

pollutant.sentenceEn: They have been seeking a way to prevent pollutants from penetrating indoors.
pollutant.translationZh: 他们一直在寻求防止污染物渗透到室内的方法。

portion.sentenceEn: A healthy portion of meat's negative reputation centers on the assertion that livestock is the largest source of greenhouse gases worldwide.
portion.translationZh: 肉类名声不佳，很大程度上源于一种说法，即畜牧业是全球最大的温室气体来源。

portion.sentenceEn: Imagine sitting down to a big dinner: a massive steak, a large portion of fried potatoes, and cake for dessert.
portion.translationZh: 想象一下，你坐下来享用一顿丰盛的晚餐：一大块牛排、一大份炸土豆，还有蛋糕作为甜点。
portion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

portion.sentenceEn: We have built endowments from donations by alumni(校友) and parents who understand and appreciate our mission to provide access and opportunity, and a significant portion of the returns from these endowments is used to fund financial aid.
portion.translationZh: 我们通过校友和家长的捐赠建立了捐赠基金，他们理解并认同我们提供教育机会的使命。这些捐赠基金产生的收益中有很大一部分用于资助助学金。
portion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

portion.sentenceEn: A huge portion of our lives involves the surrender of our freedom and personal autonomy.
portion.translationZh: 我们生命中的很大一部分都在牺牲自由和个人自主权。
portion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

portion.sentenceEn: The allegation that farm animals produce the world's largest portion of greenhouse gases is responsible for meat's bad reputation.
portion.translationZh: 关于农场动物产生全球最大份额温室气体的指控，是肉类声名狼藉的原因。

portion.sentenceEn: They tend to consume larger portions of unhealthy food.
portion.translationZh: 他们倾向于摄入更大量的健康程度较低的食物。

prejudice.sentenceEn: Candidates with disabilities should feel they have the power to make their own decisions around sharing this information free from prejudice .
prejudice.translationZh: 残障求职者应感到他们有权自主决定是否分享此类信息，且不受任何偏见影响。
prejudice.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

prejudice.sentenceEn: Forming opinions about someone or something before really knowing them well is called prejudice .
prejudice.translationZh: 在真正深入了解某人或某事之前就对其形成看法，这被称为偏见。
prejudice.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

prejudice.sentenceEn: But with education and knowledge, we can replace our prejudices with cooperation and understanding.
prejudice.translationZh: 但是，通过教育和知识，我们可以用合作与理解取代偏见。
prejudice.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第6句
文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

prejudice.sentenceEn: What does the speaker say about prejudice ?
prejudice.translationZh: 演讲者对偏见有何看法？

prejudice.sentenceEn: It arises out of ignorance of and prejudice against new science.
prejudice.translationZh: 它源于对新科学的无知与偏见。

prejudiced.sentenceEn: Sometimes we don't realize that we hold prejudiced attitudes toward or against someone or something.
prejudiced.translationZh: 有时我们并未意识到自己对某些人或事物持有偏见态度。
prejudiced.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

prejudiced.sentenceEn: For example, the prejudiced attitudes of one group may keep another group from attending certain schools, from living in any neighborhood they want, or from getting a job or a promotion.
prejudiced.translationZh: 例如，一个群体的偏见态度可能会阻止另一个群体进入某些学校、居住在他们想住的社区，或获得工作及晋升机会。
prejudiced.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

prejudiced.sentenceEn: We can be prejudiced toward or against someone or something.
prejudiced.translationZh: 我们可能对某人或某事持有偏见，既可能是正面偏见，也可能是负面偏见。
prejudiced.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

prejudiced.sentenceEn: If feelings of pride begin to turn to feelings of superiority when we think that our group or our beliefs are better than those around us, however, then we begin to develop prejudiced attitudes that can be harmful.
prejudiced.translationZh: 然而，当我们认为自己的群体或信仰优于周围的人时，如果自豪感开始转变为优越感，那么我们就会开始形成可能有害的偏见态度。
prejudiced.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

prejudiced.sentenceEn: Why does the speaker say prejudiced attitudes are dangerous?
prejudiced.translationZh: 为什么演讲者说偏见态度是危险的？

prejudiced.sentenceEn: It is prejudiced against foreign films.
prejudiced.translationZh: 它对外国电影存在偏见。

presumably.sentenceEn: Thus, had he owned some land in Athens itself, including the land the tree sat on, presumably he would have sold it to raise funds or otherwise had it taken as well.
presumably.translationZh: 因此，假如他在雅典本身拥有一些土地，包括那棵树所在的土地，想必他也会将其出售以筹集资金，否则也会被没收。

presumably.sentenceEn: This simulation gives the child crucial information about how to avoid becoming prey, and children tend to find that kind of activity deeply satisfying, presumably because it gives them a safe experience of a potentially catastrophic scenario.
presumably.translationZh: 这种模拟为孩子提供了关于如何避免成为猎物的重要信息，而孩子们往往发现这类活动非常令人满足，可能是因为它让他们在安全的环境中体验了潜在的灾难性情景。
presumably.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

presumably.sentenceEn: Presumably it's an appeal to rationality of some sort that forms the basis of more complex reasoning.
presumably.translationZh: 想必这是对某种理性的诉求，而这种理性构成了更复杂推理的基础。
presumably.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

presumably.sentenceEn: David Wallinga, for example, says, "In previous guidelines, they've always been concerned with things like food security—which is presumably the mission of the USDA. You absolutely need to be worried about climate impacts and future sustainability if you want secure food in the future."
presumably.translationZh: 例如，大卫·沃林加（David Wallinga）表示：“在以往的指南中，他们总是关注粮食安全等问题——这想必是美国农业部的使命所在。如果想要保障未来的粮食安全，就绝对需要关注气候影响和未来的可持续性。”
presumably.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

presumably.sentenceEn: When a person goes to a job interview, their interviewer has presumably read their résumé, so they don't need to repeat the information.
presumably.translationZh: 当一个人参加工作面试时，面试官很可能已经看过了他们的简历，因此他们无需重复简历上的信息。
presumably.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

presumably.sentenceEn: That presumably included much more water than the tiny trace we find blowing in the thick air today.
presumably.translationZh: 这其中很可能包含了远比我们如今在浓密大气中发现的微量水汽多得多的水。
presumably.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

privilege.sentenceEn: I've had the privilege of teaching at three different institutions of higher learning during my career—a small liberal arts college and two mid-sized public universities.
privilege.translationZh: 在我的职业生涯中，我有幸在三所不同的高等教育机构任教——一所小型文理学院和两所中型公立大学。

privilege.sentenceEn: Actively opting out of using the internet becomes a matter of privilege .
privilege.translationZh: 主动选择不使用互联网已成为一种特权。
privilege.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

privilege.sentenceEn: He was able to do this because of a combination of factors—most important, timing and opportunity—but the single-mindedness and determination with which he carried out his self-imposed mission was fundamentally character-based; millions of Marconi's contemporaries had the same class, gender, race, and colonial privilege as he, but only a handful did anything with it.
privilege.translationZh: 他之所以能做到这一点，是多种因素共同作用的结果——其中最重要的是时机和机遇——但他执行自我设定使命时所展现的专注与决心，本质上源于他的性格特质。与马可尼同时代的数百万人拥有与他相同的阶级、性别、种族和殖民特权，但只有极少数人能善用这些优势。

privilege.sentenceEn: "Australia is a multicultural society. The current overwhelming promotion of white middle-class ideas and lifestyles risks alienating children from minority groups. This can give white middle-class children a sense of superiority or privilege ," Dr. Adam said.
privilege.translationZh: 亚当博士表示：“澳大利亚是一个多元文化社会。当前对白人中产阶级观念和生活方式的过度宣扬，可能会使少数群体的儿童产生疏离感。这还可能让白人中产阶级儿童产生优越感或特权意识。”
privilege.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

privilege.sentenceEn: The celebration of milestones may prompt staff to be more grateful about their own accomplishments and privileges .
privilege.translationZh: 对里程碑的庆祝可能会促使员工对自己的成就和所享有的待遇更加心存感激。
privilege.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

privilege.sentenceEn: Why does actively opting out of using the internet become a matter of privilege ?
privilege.translationZh: 为什么主动选择不使用互联网会成为一种特权？

prohibit.sentenceEn: There are no all-direction flashing yellow lights, since it is prohibited in the United States.
prohibit.translationZh: 美国禁止使用全方位闪烁黄灯，因此该地区不存在此类信号灯。

prohibit.sentenceEn: Thereafter, we are at the mercy of a battle between our base impulses for self-fulfillment and social and cultural norms which prohibit pure indulgence.
prohibit.translationZh: 此后，我们便受制于两种力量的斗争：一是追求自我实现的原始冲动，二是禁止纯粹放纵的社会文化规范。
prohibit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

prohibit.sentenceEn: Park rules prohibit the feeding of bears.
prohibit.translationZh: 公园规定禁止投喂熊类。
prohibit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

prohibit.sentenceEn: At the time, coca leaf extract mixed with wine was a common tonic(滋补品), and Pemberton's sweet brew was a way to get around local laws prohibiting the sale of alcohol.
prohibit.translationZh: 当时，古柯叶提取物与葡萄酒混合是一种常见的滋补品，而彭伯顿的甜饮料则是为了规避当地禁止销售酒精的法律。
prohibit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

prohibit.sentenceEn: Too many workplace policies effectively prohibit employees from developing a healthy work-life balance by barring them from taking time off, even when they need it most.
prohibit.translationZh: 太多的职场政策实际上阻碍了员工建立健康的工作与生活平衡，它们限制员工休假，即便在员工最需要休息的时候也是如此。

publisher.sentenceEn: Effective Friday, Screen Actors Guild-American Federation of Television and Radio Artists (SAG-AFTRA) has declared a strike against 11 video game publishers over games that went into production after Feb. 17, 2015.
publisher.translationZh: 自本周五起，美国演员工会-美国电视与广播艺术家联合会（SAG-AFTRA）已宣布针对11家视频游戏发行商发起罢工，涉及2015年2月17日之后开始制作的游戏。
publisher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

publisher.sentenceEn: Publishers were interested only in books that would sell fairly quickly in sufficient numbers to cover the costs of production and make a profit.
publisher.translationZh: 出版商只对那些能在短时间内以足够数量销售，从而覆盖生产成本并获利的书籍感兴趣。
publisher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

publisher.sentenceEn: Mr. Rosenblatt says, "Several months ago, one of the major publishers , HarperCollins, which is a division of News Corp, announced that they were only going to allow e-books to be lent out twenty-six times, and then they would have to be purchased by the libraries again. Apart from HarperCollins, publishers are allowing libraries to purchase e-books for lending in perpetuity, meaning as many times as anyone wants to borrow them."
publisher.translationZh: 罗森布拉特先生表示：“几个月前，大型出版商之一、新闻集团旗下的哈珀柯林斯出版社宣布，他们只允许电子书被借出26次，之后图书馆必须重新购买。除哈珀柯林斯外，其他出版商允许图书馆购买电子书进行永久借阅，即可以被无限制次数借阅。”
publisher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

publisher.sentenceEn: This law is what permits libraries to lend books over and over again without having to pay publishers each time.
publisher.translationZh: 正是这项法律允许图书馆将图书反复借出，而无需每次都向出版商支付费用。
publisher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

publisher.sentenceEn: Why did SAG-AFTRA declare a strike against some video game publishers ?
publisher.translationZh: 为什么美国演员工会-美国电视与广播艺术家联合会(SAG-AFTRA)会宣布对部分电子游戏发行商发起罢工？

publisher.sentenceEn: Work hard to attract attention from publishers .
publisher.translationZh: 努力吸引出版商的关注。

purely.sentenceEn: In saying this, Wooden sought to promote purely generous acts, as opposed to those performed with an expectation of reward.
purely.translationZh: 通过这句话，伍登旨在倡导纯粹的慷慨行为，而非那些期望获得回报的行为。

purely.sentenceEn: It can hinder other more positive motivation types, such as completing a task purely because it's fulfilling or enjoyable.
purely.translationZh: 它会阻碍其他更积极的动机类型，比如纯粹因为某项任务能带来成就感或乐趣而去完成它。
purely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

purely.sentenceEn: Asking what your role will be suggests you will limit yourself purely to what is expected of you.
purely.translationZh: 询问你的工作职责范围，暗示你会将自己完全局限于预期的任务之内。
purely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

purely.sentenceEn: When it emerged towards the end of the 1980s as a purely text-based medium, it was seen as a tool to pursue knowledge, not pleasure.
purely.translationZh: 20世纪80年代末，当网络作为一种纯文本媒介出现时，它被视为追求知识而非娱乐的工具。
purely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

purely.sentenceEn: And, although AI and Machine Learning are teaching us many things about how to understand our environment, we are still far from being able to predict critical outcomes in fields like agriculture purely through the cognitive ability of machines.
purely.translationZh: 尽管人工智能和机器学习确实教会了我们许多理解环境的方法，但要完全依靠机器的认知能力来预测农业等领域的关键成果，我们还有很长的路要走。

purely.sentenceEn: A snack bar producer discovered that the supply of purely grass-fed bison meat was scarce.
purely.translationZh: 一家零食棒生产商发现纯草饲野牛肉的供应十分短缺。

parliament.sentenceEn: "We're urging Members of Parliament to ensure automation does not just benefit a wealthy few like previous industrial revolutions."
parliament.translationZh: 我们正敦促国会议员确保自动化进程不会像之前的工业革命那样，仅仅让少数富人受益。

parliament.sentenceEn: "The big get bigger and bigger but without being better," says Andreas Schwab, a German member of the European Parliament who championed a 2014 resolution to break up Google.
parliament.translationZh: 德国籍欧洲议会议员安德烈亚斯·施瓦布表示：“大公司变得越来越大，却没有变得越来越好。”他曾在2014年倡导通过拆分谷歌的决议。
parliament.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

parliament.sentenceEn: Many members of parliament are uncomfortable even with their own government's anti-obesity strategy, since it involves a "sugar tax" and a ban on the sale of energy drinks to under-16s.
parliament.translationZh: 许多国会议员甚至对本国政府的反肥胖战略感到不满，因为该战略包括一项“糖税”以及禁止向16岁以下青少年销售能量饮料的规定。
parliament.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

parliament.sentenceEn: Just earlier this year, the European Parliament voted in favor of legislation that would stop grocery giants from unfair trading practices that result in overproduction, thus creating waste.
parliament.translationZh: 就在今年早些时候，欧洲议会投票通过了一项法案，旨在制止大型食品零售商的不公平交易行为，这类行为导致了生产过剩，进而造成浪费。
parliament.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

parliament.sentenceEn: What did the European Parliament do to reduce food waste?
parliament.translationZh: 欧洲议会为减少食物浪费采取了什么措施？

parliament.sentenceEn: They are uncomfortable with parliament 's anti-obesity debate.
parliament.translationZh: 他们对议会关于反肥胖的辩论感到不安。

patent.sentenceEn: Morgan sold the patent to General Electric — and the spread of the traffic light was green lighted.
patent.translationZh: 摩根将专利卖给了通用电气，交通信号灯的普及自此获得了批准。

patent.sentenceEn: He was also a skilled and sophisticated organizer, an entrepreneurial innovator, who mastered the use of corporate strategy, media relations, government lobbying, international diplomacy, patents , and prosecution.
patent.translationZh: 他还是一位技艺高超、精明老练的组织者，一位富有创业精神的创新者，精通企业战略、媒体关系、政府游说、国际外交、专利申请以及专利诉讼。

patent.sentenceEn: Between 1896, when he applied for his first patent in England at the age of 22, and his death in Italy in 1937, Marconi was at the center of every major innovation in electronic communication.
patent.translationZh: 从1896年22岁的马可尼在英国申请第一项专利，到1937年于意大利逝世，他始终是电子通信领域每一项重大创新的核心人物。

patent.sentenceEn: He was granted over 200 patents and continued to pioneer rocket technology until his death in 1945.
patent.translationZh: 他获得了200多项专利，并继续在火箭技术领域开拓创新，直至1945年逝世。
patent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

patent.sentenceEn: It was 100 years ago this week that the bottle earned a patent .
patent.translationZh: 本周正是这款瓶子获得专利100周年的日子。
patent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

patent.sentenceEn: He was granted over 200 patents in rocket technology.
patent.translationZh: 他在火箭技术方面获得了200多项专利

penalty.sentenceEn: The motherhood penalty has become a shorthand for describing why: In many places, especially rich countries, women earn the same as men until they reach their childbearing years.
penalty.translationZh: 母职惩罚已成为解释这一现象的简略说法：在许多地方，尤其是富裕国家，女性在进入生育年龄之前，收入与男性相当。
penalty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

penalty.sentenceEn: There is a fear of penalty , a fear that they'll have to do more work if they intervene.
penalty.translationZh: 他们担心会受到惩罚，也担心如果干预了就得做更多工作。
penalty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

penalty.sentenceEn: M: In France, the government has banned supermarkets from throwing away edible foods and imposed harsh penalties on businesses that fail to comply with the regulations.
penalty.translationZh: 男主持人：在法国，政府已禁止超市丢弃可食用食品，并对不遵守该规定的企业实施严厉处罚。
penalty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

penalty.sentenceEn: Juries sympathetic to the victims of machines will punish entrepreneurs with company-crushing penalties and damages.
penalty.translationZh: 同情机器受害者的陪审团会对企业家处以足以令公司破产的罚款和赔偿金。
penalty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

penalty.sentenceEn: To one writer, being forced to play with others was a penalty while being kept alone in a room was quite a pleasure.
penalty.translationZh: 对于一位作家而言，被迫与他人玩耍是一种惩罚，而独自待在房间里则是一种莫大的享受。
对超速行驶处以更严厉的处罚。

perfectionist.sentenceEn: The perfectionist in you might be screaming to abandon your goals altogether, but try to see it in the bigger picture.
perfectionist.translationZh: 你内心的完美主义可能在尖叫着让你彻底放弃目标，但不妨从更宏观的角度来看待这件事。

perfectionist.sentenceEn: There's a habit that many perfectionists tend to fall into when they try to establish a behavior change.
perfectionist.translationZh: 许多完美主义者在尝试改变行为时，往往会陷入一种习惯。

perfectionist.sentenceEn: A person living with an other-oriented perfectionist might feel criticized by the perfectionist spouse for not doing household chores exactly the "right" way.
perfectionist.translationZh: 与具有他人导向型完美主义倾向的人共同生活的人，可能会因为家务没有完全按照“正确”方式完成而受到这位完美主义伴侣的批评。

perfectionist.sentenceEn: But he warns that some people go into therapy expecting too much—an instant transformation of themselves from a pathological(病态的) perfectionist to a (still high-achieving) non-perfectionist.
perfectionist.translationZh: 但他警告说，有些人接受治疗时期望过高——希望自己能立即从病态的完美主义者转变为（依然成就斐然的）非完美主义者。

perfectionist.sentenceEn: Brustein likes to get his perfectionist clients to create values that are important to them, then try to shift their focus to living according to those values rather than achieving specific goals.
perfectionist.translationZh: 布鲁斯坦喜欢让他的完美主义客户确立对他们而言重要的价值观，然后尝试将他们的注意力转向依照这些价值观生活，而非实现特定目标。

perfectionist.sentenceEn: Perfectionists focus too much on their big target and neglect celebrating the small gains they make in the process.
perfectionist.translationZh: 完美主义者过于关注他们的远大目标，而忽视了庆祝过程中取得的小成就。

pesticide.sentenceEn: Most institutions of higher education rely on synthetic pesticides and fertilizers to achieve aesthetic goals.
pesticide.translationZh: 大多数高等教育机构依靠合成农药和化肥来达到美观目的。
pesticide.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

pesticide.sentenceEn: Pesticide use also decreases the life in soil, hampering the ability of soils to absorb carbon or retain water and thus reducing campuses' ability to recover quickly from climate-related extreme weather events like droughts and floods.
pesticide.translationZh: 农药的使用还会减少土壤中的生物活性，削弱土壤吸收碳和保持水分的能力，从而降低校园从干旱和洪水等气候相关极端天气事件中快速恢复的能力。
pesticide.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

pesticide.sentenceEn: In her second year, Charlene Duong learned of the use of poisonous, synthetic pesticides on her college campus.
pesticide.translationZh: 大二那年，沙琳·杜昂了解到她所在的大学校园使用有毒的合成杀虫剂。
pesticide.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

pesticide.sentenceEn: Pesticide use on college campuses also contributes to our global climate crisis.
pesticide.translationZh: 大学校园使用农药也加剧了全球气候危机。
pesticide.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

pesticide.sentenceEn: A recent landmark study identified a 75% fall in insect populations between 1989 and 2016, with pesticide use thought to be to blame along with the destruction of wild areas for development.
pesticide.translationZh: 近期一项具有里程碑意义的研究发现，1989年至2016年间昆虫数量下降了75%。人们认为，杀虫剂的使用以及为开发而破坏野生区域是造成这一现象的主要原因。
pesticide.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

pesticide.sentenceEn: An increasing number of spiders are being killed by deadly pesticides .
pesticide.translationZh: 越来越多的蜘蛛正被致命的杀虫剂杀死。

petroleum.sentenceEn: The boom made some prospectors millionaires, but the sudden surplus of petroleum was not entirely a blessing for Texas.
petroleum.translationZh: 这场石油繁荣使一些勘探者成为了百万富翁，但石油的突然过剩对得克萨斯州而言并非全是福音。
petroleum.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

petroleum.sentenceEn: Meanwhile, there are few who are willing and able to perform jobs requiring a petroleum engineering major, so the value of one more of those people is very high.
petroleum.translationZh: 与此同时，愿意且有能力从事石油工程专业相关工作的人很少，因此这类人才的价值非常高。
petroleum.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

petroleum.sentenceEn: In addition, other factors are putting downward pressure on oil prices: change in the strategic behavior of the Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries, the projected increase in Iranian exports, the scaling-down of global demand (especially from emerging markets), the long-term drop in petroleum consumption in the United States, and some displacement of oil by substitutes.
petroleum.translationZh: 此外，其他因素也在给油价带来下行压力：石油输出国组织战略行为的改变、伊朗出口的预期增长、全球需求的缩减（尤其是来自新兴市场的需求）、美国石油消费的长期下降，以及部分石油被替代品取代。

petroleum.sentenceEn: The real controversy surrounding the amounts of petroleum we have is how much we need to keep in reserve for future use.
petroleum.translationZh: 关于我们拥有的石油储量，真正的争议在于我们需要为未来储备多少石油。
petroleum.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

petroleum.sentenceEn: W: Is the threat of running out of petroleum real?
petroleum.translationZh: 女：石油枯竭的威胁是真的吗？
petroleum.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

petroleum.sentenceEn: M: It has taken thousands of years to create the natural stores of petroleum we have now.
petroleum.translationZh: 男士：我们现在拥有的这些天然石油储备，是经过数千年才形成的。
petroleum.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

phonics.sentenceEn: The panel found that phonics , along with explicit instruction in phonemic(音位的) awareness, fluency and comprehension, worked best.
phonics.translationZh: 该委员会发现，将自然拼读法与音位意识、阅读流畅度和阅读理解能力的明确教学相结合，效果最佳。
phonics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

phonics.sentenceEn: Phonics , which involves sounding out words syllable(音节) by syllable, is the best way to teach children to read.
phonics.translationZh: 自然拼读法（Phonics）是教儿童阅读的最佳方法，这种方法要求逐个音节地读出单词。
phonics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

phonics.sentenceEn: To the teacher who is a proficient reader, literacy seems like a natural process that requires educated guessing, rather than the deliberate process emphasized by phonics .
phonics.translationZh: 对于精通阅读的教师而言，识字似乎是一个需要有根据猜测的自然过程，而非自然拼读法所强调的刻意过程。
phonics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

phonics.sentenceEn: So much so that some teachers have had to sneak phonics teaching materials into the classroom.
phonics.translationZh: 以至于一些教师不得不偷偷地将自然拼读教学材料带入课堂。
phonics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

phonics.sentenceEn: What do we learn about phonics in many American classrooms?
phonics.translationZh: 关于自然拼读法，我们在许多美国课堂中了解到什么？

phonics.sentenceEn: Sprinkling in a little phonics deters the progress of even adequately motivated children.
phonics.translationZh: 零散地教一点 phonics 甚至会阻碍那些学习动机足够强的孩子的进步。

phrase.sentenceEn: But for many professional cooks, the phrase means something deeper.
phrase.translationZh: 但对许多专业厨师而言，这个说法有着更深层的含义。
phrase.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

phrase.sentenceEn: It's a French phrase that means to gather and arrange the ingredients and tools needed for cooking.
phrase.translationZh: 这是一个法语短语，意思是收集并整理烹饪所需的食材和工具。
phrase.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

phrase.sentenceEn: Darwin's theory has even been summarized as "survival of the fittest"—a phrase Darwin himself never used—further highlighting competition's role in success.
phrase.translationZh: 达尔文的理论甚至被概括为"适者生存"——这是一个达尔文本人从未使用过的短语——这进一步突显了竞争在成功中的作用。
phrase.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

phrase.sentenceEn: The results of the study showed that factual language activated a rapid increase in brain activity, with the brain responding more powerfully and showing more engagement with factual phrases compared to those communicating possibility.
phrase.translationZh: 研究结果表明，事实性语言会引发大脑活动的快速增强，与处理表达可能性的语句相比，大脑对事实性短语的反应更强烈，参与度也更高。
phrase.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

phrase.sentenceEn: For lack of a better phrase , we might call this approach "factually false, but socially accurate."
phrase.translationZh: 由于找不到更贴切的说法，我们或许可以将这种方式称为“事实层面有误，但社交层面准确”。

phrase.sentenceEn: Sandy Cohen, owner of a graphic print production business, created the Quote Board to document the bizarre phrases people say when under strict deadlines.
phrase.translationZh: 桑迪·科恩是一家图文印刷制作公司的老板，他创建了一个“语录板”，用来记录人们在紧迫的截止日期压力下说出的各种离奇话语。
phrase.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

policymaker.sentenceEn: Raising the wages of American workers ought to be the priority of economic policymakers .
policymaker.translationZh: 提高美国工人的工资应当成为经济政策制定者的首要任务。
policymaker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

policymaker.sentenceEn: It can help families, communities, healthcare providers, policymakers , government agencies and other stakeholders to understand and respond to crises that plague society.
policymaker.translationZh: 这有助于家庭、社区、医疗服务提供者、政策制定者、政府机构及其他利益相关方理解并应对困扰社会的危机。
policymaker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

policymaker.sentenceEn: Whether policymakers and politicians admit it or not, workers have made clear their feelings about their economic insecurity and desire to keep good jobs in America.
policymaker.translationZh: 无论政策制定者和政客们是否承认，工人们已经明确表达了他们对经济不安全的感受，以及希望在美国保住好工作的愿望。
policymaker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

policymaker.sentenceEn: Policymakers in India have traditionally pushed for a cereal-heavy "vegetarian diet" on a meat-eating population as a way of providing the cheapest sources of food.
policymaker.translationZh: 印度的政策制定者历来向食肉人口推行以谷物为主的"素食饮食"，将其作为提供最廉价食物来源的一种方式。
policymaker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

policymaker.sentenceEn: Policymakers should not allow low energy prices to derail the clean energy transition.
policymaker.translationZh: 政策制定者不应允许低能源价格阻碍清洁能源转型。

policymaker.sentenceEn: The cult of tax cuts has been relentlessly propagated by all policymakers .
policymaker.translationZh: 所有政策制定者都在不遗余力地宣扬减税崇拜。

poorly.sentenceEn: Professor Bostrom, who directs Oxford's Future of Humanity Institute, has argued over the course of several papers that human extinction risks are poorly understood and, worse still, severely underestimated by society.
poorly.translationZh: 博斯特罗姆教授是牛津大学人类未来研究所的所长，他在多篇论文中指出，人类对灭绝风险的理解不足，更糟糕的是，社会严重低估了这些风险。
poorly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

poorly.sentenceEn: M: So then why do I feel so poorly all the time?
poorly.translationZh: 那么为什么我总是感觉这么不舒服呢？
poorly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

poorly.sentenceEn: Texas passed a bill in 2013 that allows students to substitute computer coding only after they have attempted and performed poorly in a foreign language class.
poorly.translationZh: 德克萨斯州于2013年通过一项法案，允许学生只有在尝试学习外语课程但表现不佳后，才能用计算机编程课替代外语课。

poorly.sentenceEn: Scientists have proven that despite their poorly developed small eyes, these bats still can see during the day.
poorly.translationZh: 科学家已经证实，尽管这些蝙蝠的小眼睛发育不佳，但它们白天仍然能够看见东西。
poorly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

poorly.sentenceEn: It's true that the main reason inner-city schools do poorly isn't teachers' unions, but poverty.
poorly.translationZh: 的确，市中心学校表现不佳的主要原因并非教师工会，而是贫困问题。
poorly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

poorly.sentenceEn: It does poorly on frequent, high-volume tasks.
poorly.translationZh: 人类在处理频繁、大量的任务时表现不佳。

possession.sentenceEn: It isn't the goods themselves we seek, it is the love we stand to gain through our possession of them.
possession.translationZh: 我们所追求的并非物品本身，而是通过拥有它们所能获得的爱。
possession.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

possession.sentenceEn: The deed read, "W. H. Jackson for and in consideration of the great affection which he bears the said tree, and his great desire to see it protected has conveyed unto the said oak tree entire possession of itself and of all land within eight feet of it on all sides."
possession.translationZh: 地契上写道：'W·H·杰克逊出于对上述橡树的深厚感情，以及他渴望看到其得到保护的强烈愿望，特将该橡树本身及其四周各八英尺范围内所有土地的完整所有权，转让给上述橡树。'

possession.sentenceEn: It's also one that's forever developing new ways to persuade our children to desire material possessions , and because of advertisements' viral effect they only need to infect a few to reach the many.
possession.translationZh: 这一行业还在不断开发新方法，诱导孩子们渴望物质财富，而且由于广告的病毒式传播效应，他们只需影响一小部分孩子，就能渗透到更多孩子中去。
possession.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

possession.sentenceEn: Indeed, it's a bit of a mystery why governments, archaeologists, and treasure hunters can't work together—and why salvors aren't at least given a substantial finder's fee before the original owner takes possession of the vessel and its artifacts.
possession.translationZh: 的确，令人费解的是，为何政府、考古学家和寻宝者不能携手合作——以及为何在原主收回沉船及其文物之前，打捞者至少不能获得一笔可观的发现者报酬。

possession.sentenceEn: What the protagonist did not know was that an antagonist had come and messed with his possessions .
possession.translationZh: 主角不知道的是，一个反派角色过来动了他的东西。

possession.sentenceEn: It is rooted in our desire for material possessions .
possession.translationZh: 它源于我们对物质财富的渴望。

postal.sentenceEn: In 1864, there were few postal branches on land controlled by Native Americans, which still accounted for most of the West.
postal.translationZh: 1864年，在当时仍占西部大部分地区的美洲原住民控制的土地上，邮政分支机构寥寥无几。
postal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

postal.sentenceEn: Mr. Blevins, a digital historian, wrote a book on the history of the US postal service.
postal.translationZh: 数字历史学家布莱文斯先生撰写了一本关于美国邮政服务历史的著作。
postal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

postal.sentenceEn: Amid all the changes, one feature remained constant—the postal service.
postal.translationZh: 历经种种变迁，有一项事物始终未变——邮政服务。
postal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

postal.sentenceEn: To keep up with migration patterns, postal services were added to existing businesses.
postal.translationZh: 为了跟上移民潮的步伐，邮局服务被增设到了现有的各类商户中。
postal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

postal.sentenceEn: What did the federal government do to meet the increasing demand for the postal service in the West?
postal.translationZh: 联邦政府做了什么来满足西部对邮政服务日益增长的需求？

postal.sentenceEn: It centralized postal services in its remote areas.
postal.translationZh: 它将邮政服务集中到了偏远地区。

pour.sentenceEn: When 3 p. m. comes around, that's your cue to pour yourself a cup of hot water and drink that tea, instead of walking to the vending machine.
pour.translationZh: 下午三点一到，你就该给自己倒杯热水泡茶喝，而不是走去自动售货机。

plague.translationZh: 城市室外空气污染是一个全球性问题，无论是困扰加尔各答的阴霾，还是影响伦敦学校儿童健康的恶劣空气质量。
plague.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

plague.sentenceEn: Before he died, baseball star Mickey Mantle, who was plagued with alcohol problems, told young ballplayers and the fans who admired him "to play like me, don't be like me."
plague.translationZh: 棒球明星米基·曼特尔生前深受酗酒问题困扰，他曾告诫那些年轻球员和仰慕他的球迷：'要像我一样打球，但不要像我一样生活。'
plague.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

plague.sentenceEn: It can help families, communities, healthcare providers, policymakers, government agencies and other stakeholders to understand and respond to crises that plague society.
plague.translationZh: 这有助于家庭、社区、医疗服务提供者、政策制定者、政府机构及其他利益相关方理解并应对困扰社会的危机。
plague.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

plague.sentenceEn: Further, while competition and betrayal are the main thorns to female friendship, men are plagued in almost equal amounts by two additional issues: lack of frankness and a fear of appearing unmanly.
plague.translationZh: 此外，虽然竞争和背叛是女性友谊中的主要棘手问题，但男性则受到另外两个几乎同等严重问题的困扰：缺乏坦率和害怕显得不够男子气概。
plague.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

plague.sentenceEn: The women's movement has been plagued by stereotypes, misrepresentations by the media, and accusations of man-hating and radicalism, when the basic foundation of feminism is simply that women deserve equal rights in all facets of life.
plague.translationZh: 妇女运动一直饱受刻板印象、媒体歪曲以及“仇恨男性”和“激进主义”的指责之苦，然而女权主义的根本基础其实很简单——女性在生活的方方面面都应享有平等权利。
plague.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

pledge.sentenceEn: We all applaud when very rich people pledge to give away most of their billions, but they are usually left with millions to pass on, still much more than most people would expect to earn in their lifetime.
pledge.translationZh: 当超级富豪承诺捐赠他们数十亿财富中的大部分时，我们都会为之喝彩，但他们通常仍会留下数百万遗产，这依然远超过大多数人一生的预期收入。
pledge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

pledge.sentenceEn: The Sierra Club's Beyond Coal campaign, which also leads campaigns for universities to withdraw their investments in coal and other fossil fuels, lists 22 schools that have pledged to move "beyond coal," including Clemson University, Indiana University, Ohio University, Penn State University, the University of Louisville and the University of Tennessee, Knoxville.
pledge.translationZh: 塞拉俱乐部的“超越煤炭”运动也领导着推动大学撤资煤炭及其他化石燃料的行动，该运动列出了22所承诺“超越煤炭”的学校，包括克莱姆森大学、印第安纳大学、俄亥俄大学、宾夕法尼亚州立大学、路易斯维尔大学以及田纳西大学诺克斯维尔分校。
pledge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

pledge.sentenceEn: Thirty percent of the participants have pledged to be carbon neutral within 20 years.
pledge.translationZh: 30%的参与院校已承诺在20年内实现碳中和。
pledge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

pledge.sentenceEn: The only other guarantee on the bill is a Federal Reserve pledge as a confirmation in the form of government securities.
pledge.translationZh: 美元纸币上唯一的其他保证是以政府证券形式提供的美联储承诺，作为一种确认。
pledge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

pledge.sentenceEn: Maple Hill signs a contract pledging to buy the farmer's milk at a guaranteed base price, plus quality premiums and incentives for higher protein, butter-fat and other solids.
pledge.translationZh: 枫叶山农场签订合同，承诺以保证的基准价格收购农户的牛奶，此外还包括质量溢价，以及针对高蛋白、高乳脂和其他固体成分的奖励。

pledge.sentenceEn: The company pledged to cut 600 back-office positions, though some 150 workers in those roles would be reassigned to other jobs.
pledge.translationZh: 该公司承诺削减600个后勤办公室职位，不过这些岗位上约有150名员工将被重新分配到其他工作岗位。
pledge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

pole.sentenceEn: The four-sided box, raised on a ten-foot pole , looked like a birdhouse and was operated manually by an officer.
pole.translationZh: 那个架在十英尺高杆上的四方盒子看起来像个鸟巢箱，由一名警官手动操作。

pole.sentenceEn: It was at the North Pole Marathon, a race that Donovan organizes, that Wardian first heard about the Irishman's plan for the World Marathon Challenge—a challenge that Donovan himself completed in 2009 and 2012.
pole.translationZh: 正是在多诺万组织的北极马拉松比赛中，沃迪安第一次听说了这位爱尔兰人发起世界马拉松挑战赛的计划——多诺万本人曾在2009年和2012年完成这项挑战。

pole.sentenceEn: At the 2014 North Pole Marathon, the temperature dipped to minus-22 degrees F, with a wind chill that made it feel even colder.
pole.translationZh: 在2014年北极马拉松赛上，气温降至零下22华氏度，寒风袭人，让人感觉更加寒冷。

pole.sentenceEn: He also used ski poles in an unorthodox way—to propel himself as he skied.
pole.translationZh: 他还以一种非常规的方式使用滑雪杖——在滑行时用它们来推动自己前进。
pole.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

pole.sentenceEn: In emerging economies, rural communities are bypassing the wires and wooden poles that spread power.
pole.translationZh: 在新兴经济体中，农村社区正在绕过传统的电力传输线路和木杆。
pole.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

pole.sentenceEn: They promoted the scientific use of skiing poles .
pole.translationZh: 他们推广了滑雪杖的科学使用方法。

practically.sentenceEn: So, we agree that Rachel appeared inexperienced and less mature than Peter, even though both candidates are the same age and have practically no work experience.
practically.translationZh: 那么，我们都认为雷切尔显得不如彼得有经验，也不够成熟，尽管两位候选人年龄相同，而且实际上都没有工作经验。
practically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

practically.sentenceEn: It also has lots of power and can easily cut and crush practically anything.
practically.translationZh: 它还拥有强大的动力，几乎可以轻松切割和粉碎任何东西。
practically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

practically.sentenceEn: As leaders, they are expected to motivate and inspire their team in pursuit of longer-term strategic goals and also, less ambitiously but more practically , to monitor their daily output, to set clear expectations and to give regular feedback.
practically.translationZh: 作为领导者，人们期望他们能够激励和鼓舞团队追求长期战略目标，同时，虽然目标不那么宏大但更为实际的是，监督团队的日常产出、设定明确的期望并提供定期反馈。
practically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

practically.sentenceEn: In those days, Texas was almost entirely rural, with no large cities and practically no industry; cotton and beef were the foundation of the economy.
practically.translationZh: 那时的得克萨斯州几乎完全是乡村，没有大城市，也几乎没有工业；棉花和牛肉是当地经济的基础。
practically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

practically.sentenceEn: Practically , to say that AI and Machine Learning can be developed to solve all problems related to our physical environment is to basically say that we have a complete understanding of all aspects of the interaction of physical or material activity on the planet.
practically.translationZh: 实际上，如果说我们可以开发人工智能和机器学习来解决与物理环境相关的所有问题，基本上就等于说我们已完全理解地球上物质活动相互作用的方方面面。

practically.sentenceEn: The show has been running for over ten years, and some of the actors are practically global superstars, now that they are such famous celebrities.
practically.translationZh: 这部剧已经播了十多年了，有些演员现在已经成了举世闻名的大明星。
practically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第6句

precedent.sentenceEn: When a group of employees sees unsafe behavior not being addressed at a leadership level it creates the precedent that this is how these situations should be addressed, thus defining the safety culture for everyone.
precedent.translationZh: 当一群员工看到不安全行为在领导层未得到处理时，这就开创了先例，表明这些情况就应该这样处理，从而为每个人定义了安全文化。
precedent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

precedent.sentenceEn: The human brain works from precedent .
precedent.translationZh: 人类大脑的运作以先例为基础。
precedent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第8句

precedent.sentenceEn: "It sets such an awful precedent for the future of performance."
precedent.translationZh: 这为表演艺术的未来开创了一个极其糟糕的先例。

precedent.sentenceEn: Historical precedent suggests that science and politics can overcome resistance from businesses that pollute and poison but it takes time, and success often starts small.
precedent.translationZh: 历史先例表明，科学和政治能够克服来自造成污染和危害健康企业的阻力，但这需要时间，而且成功往往始于小处。
precedent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

precedent.sentenceEn: The order essentially asks Apple to hack its own devices, and once it is in place, the precedent could be used to justify law enforcement efforts to get around encryption technologies in other investigations far removed from national security threats.
precedent.translationZh: 这项命令实质上是要求苹果公司入侵自己的设备，一旦实施，这一先例可能被用来为执法部门的相关行动提供正当理由——在与国家安全威胁毫无关联的其他调查中规避加密技术。

precedent.sentenceEn: It repeats precedent on a regular basis.
precedent.translationZh: 人类大脑会经常性地借鉴先例。

preschool.sentenceEn: Preschool children really don't get the moral of the story.
preschool.translationZh: 学龄前儿童其实无法理解故事所传达的寓意。
preschool.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

preschool.sentenceEn: Swiss psychologist Jean Piaget, who is credited with founding the scientific study of children's thinking, was convinced that preschool children cannot consider what goes on in the minds of others.
preschool.translationZh: 瑞士心理学家让·皮亚杰被誉为儿童思维科学研究的奠基人，他坚信学龄前儿童无法理解他人的想法。

preschool.sentenceEn: The most common topics they discussed included kids' sleep, nutrition, discipline, behavior problems and day care and preschool .
preschool.translationZh: 他们讨论的最常见话题包括孩子的睡眠、营养、管教、行为问题以及日托和学前教育。

preschool.sentenceEn: Most affluent parents enroll their children in preschool or day care, while low-income parents are more likely to depend on family members.
preschool.translationZh: 大多数富裕家庭的父母会为孩子报名学前班或日托，而低收入家庭的父母则更可能依赖家庭成员照料孩子。

preschool.sentenceEn: Social scientists say the differences arise in part because low-income parents have less money to spend on music class or preschool , and less flexible schedules to take children to museums or attend school events.
preschool.translationZh: 社会科学家表示，这种差异的部分原因在于低收入父母用于音乐课或学前教育的资金较少，且他们的时间安排不够灵活，难以带孩子去博物馆或参加学校活动。

preschool.sentenceEn: Why can't preschool children get the moral conveyed in the TV programs?
preschool.translationZh: 为什么学龄前儿童无法理解电视节目中传达的道德寓意？

prescription.sentenceEn: These are areas where algorithmic(算法的) prescription is replacing human judgment, and so people who might have had the chance to develop practical judgment in these areas no longer will.
prescription.translationZh: 这些领域正逐步由算法指令取代人类判断，因此原本可能在这些领域培养实际判断力的人们将不再有这样的机会。
prescription.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

prescription.sentenceEn: But they can write prescriptions , diagnose common ailments—including digestive issues, joint pain, skin diseases, fever and the common cold—and refer patients to doctors at local hospitals.
prescription.translationZh: 但他们可以开具处方，诊断常见疾病——包括消化问题、关节疼痛、皮肤病、发烧和普通感冒——并将患者转诊至当地医院的医生。

prescription.sentenceEn: Every week, TD's medical operators travel to the islands by boat, carrying a laptop, a portable printer for prescriptions and tools to run basic medical screenings such as blood pressure, blood sugar, body temperature and weight.
prescription.translationZh: 每周，远程医疗（TD）的医护人员都会乘船前往这些岛屿，随身携带笔记本电脑、用于打印处方的便携式打印机，以及进行基础医疗检查的工具，如测量血压、血糖、体温和体重的设备。

prescription.sentenceEn: "Presumably it's because it's simple and easy to write a prescription and consider a patient case closed rather than investigate further," Polman says.
prescription.translationZh: 波尔曼表示：“这可能是因为开具处方并结案似乎简单易行，而不愿做进一步检查。”
prescription.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

prescription.sentenceEn: What is the consequence of algorithmic prescription replacing human judgment?
prescription.translationZh: 算法指令取代人类判断的后果是什么？

prescription.sentenceEn: Prescription of antibiotics can be harmful to patients' health.
prescription.translationZh: 开具抗生素处方可能对患者健康有害。

presentation.sentenceEn: W: So, how is our presentation about the restructuring of the company coming along?
presentation.translationZh: 那么，我们关于公司重组的演示文稿准备得怎么样了？
presentation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

presentation.sentenceEn: W: …So what's the outline of the presentation ?
presentation.translationZh: 那么，这次演示的大纲是什么？
presentation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

presentation.sentenceEn: Perhaps we should do a practice round of the presentation first.
presentation.translationZh: 或许我们应该先进行一次演示彩排。
presentation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第15段，第2句

presentation.sentenceEn: W: Um, and we'll make the presentation and the questions available via the company's own computer network, right?
presentation.translationZh: 女：嗯，我们会通过公司自己的电脑网络提供演示文稿和问题解答，对吧？
presentation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第13段，第1句

presentation.sentenceEn: Then, they try to teach the students something with a specific presentation style, like using visual aids, and do a follow-up test to see how much they learned.
presentation.translationZh: 然后，他们尝试采用特定的呈现方式（例如使用视觉辅助工具）向学生传授知识，并进行后续测试以了解他们学到了多少内容。
presentation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

presentation.sentenceEn: Well, it actually seems that multiple presentation formats, especially if one of them is visual, help most people learn.
presentation.translationZh: 事实上，似乎多种呈现形式，尤其是包含视觉形式时，能帮助大多数人更好地学习。
presentation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

presume.sentenceEn: Many laymen presume that there is a single standard way of speaking in each country, with one single standard accent, and that this perceived standard is inherently the best form of speech, but linguists(语言学家) often point out that the concept of a standard accent is better understood as an ideal rather than a reality.
presume.translationZh: 许多门外汉认为每个国家都有一种标准的说话方式和一种标准的口音，并觉得这种公认的标准形式在本质上就是语言的最佳形态。但语言学家经常指出，标准口音的概念与其说是一种现实，不如说是一个理想化的标准。
presume.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

presume.sentenceEn: However, their research quickly saw some misinterpretations in the general public: Some presumed creative people must be right-brained and logical people left-brained.
presume.translationZh: 然而，他们的研究很快在公众中引发了一些误解：有些人认为创造性强的人一定是右脑主导，而逻辑性强的人则是左脑主导。
presume.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

presume.sentenceEn: Those marketing experts assert that the impact of the appearance of food is greater than we might presume , and might hold the key to encouraging better eating.
presume.translationZh: 这些营销专家认为，食物外观的影响比我们想象的要大，并且可能是鼓励人们改善饮食习惯的关键。
presume.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

presume.sentenceEn: But most of us are reluctant to start these conversations because we presume the opposite.
presume.translationZh: 但我们大多数人却不愿开启这样的对话，因为我们的想法恰恰相反。
presume.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

presume.sentenceEn: The sad thing is that people presume that a nearby stranger doesn't want to converse and don't start a conversation.
presume.translationZh: 令人遗憾的是，人们总是假定身边的陌生人不想交谈，因此也就不会主动开口。
presume.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

presume.sentenceEn: M: So I presume you sell both lines of products wholesale in each respective country.
presume.translationZh: 男：这么说，我猜您是在这两个国家分别批发销售这两类产品吧。
presume.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

prevail.sentenceEn: Farmers and consumers alike can choose whether or not to use whichever version prevails : "I'm giving people an option."
prevail.translationZh: 农民和消费者都可以选择是否使用最终成功的任何一种版本：“我是在给人们提供一种选择。”

prevail.sentenceEn: For now, though, life prevails —even in a lake that kills almost everything it touches.
prevail.translationZh: 不过目前，生命依然占据着主导地位——即便是在这个几乎能杀死一切接触者的湖泊中。
prevail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

prevail.sentenceEn: There will probably be months of legal confrontation, and it is not at all clear which side will prevail in court, nor in the battle for public opinion and legislative favor.
prevail.translationZh: 这场法律对峙可能会持续数月之久，目前完全无法确定哪一方会在法庭上胜出，也无法预料谁能赢得公众舆论和立法机构的支持。

prevail.sentenceEn: "We are very proud of our accomplishments under the Greenlist system and we believe that we will prevail in these cases," Christopher Beard, director of public affairs for SC Johnson, said, while acknowledging that "this has been an area that is difficult to navigate."
prevail.translationZh: 庄臣公司公共事务总监克里斯托弗·比尔德表示：“我们对‘绿色清单’体系下所取得的成就感到非常自豪，并相信我们会在这些案件中胜诉。”同时他也承认，“这是一个难以驾驭的领域。”
prevail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

prevail.sentenceEn: If you are at home trying to decide where to go for dinner, however, the knowledge component may prevail , and you decide to go where you can eat a healthier meal.
prevail.translationZh: 然而，如果你正在家里决定去哪里吃晚餐，认知成分可能会占上风，你会决定去一个可以吃到更健康餐食的地方。
prevail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第8句

prevail.sentenceEn: For their arguments to prevail , advocates of free trade must try to forge bonds of affection between consumers at home and producers overseas.
prevail.translationZh: 要让自由贸易的主张获得认可，其倡导者必须努力在国内消费者与海外生产者之间建立情感纽带。

processed.sentenceEn: Researchers are trying to unlock the potential of these ignored crops—plants they describe as forgotten, under-used or "alternative" as they are displaced by increasingly uniform diets fuelled by processed ingredients from the major crops.
processed.translationZh: 研究人员正试图发掘这些被忽视作物的潜力——他们称这些作物为被遗忘、未被充分利用或"替代"作物，因为在主要作物加工原料推动下日益单一化的饮食结构已经将它们挤出了人们的餐桌。

processed.sentenceEn: It's a strategy to appeal to the world's growing middle classes who are increasingly turning to the fast and processed food industries.
processed.translationZh: 这是一种吸引全球日益壮大的中产阶级的策略，这些中产阶级正越来越多地转向快餐和加工食品行业。

processed.sentenceEn: But the rising interest in forgotten foods in some quarters is overtaken by the global spread of Western-style diets heavy in sugar, fat and processed foods in others.
processed.translationZh: 然而，某些群体对被遗忘食物的兴趣日益浓厚，却被全球范围内另一种趋势所超越——西式饮食的普及，这类饮食富含糖、脂肪和加工食品。

processed.sentenceEn: Investigative reporter Michael Moss says processed food is engineered to hook you, not unlike alcohol, cigarettes, or other harmful substances.
processed.translationZh: 调查记者迈克尔·莫斯表示，加工食品经过精心设计，旨在让你上钩，这与酒精、香烟或其他有害物质并无二致。
processed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

processed.sentenceEn: "Especially if you consider that eating less meat, especially red and processed , has health benefits," she says.
processed.translationZh: 她表示：“尤其是考虑到减少肉类摄入，特别是红肉和加工肉类，对健康有益。”
processed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

processed.sentenceEn: In what way does Michael Moss think processed food is comparable to alcohol and cigarettes?
processed.translationZh: 迈克尔·莫斯认为加工食品在哪些方面可与酒精和香烟相提并论？

profile.sentenceEn: To use the app, you first input your profile about your previous training experiences and preferences, as well as your desired goals.
profile.translationZh: 要使用这款应用，您首先需要输入您的个人资料，包括过往的培训经历、偏好以及期望达成的目标。
profile.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第8句

profile.sentenceEn: W: As we all know, being such a famous football player at Real Madrid, Mr. Sanchez has a very high public profile .
profile.translationZh: W：众所周知，桑切斯先生作为皇家马德里的著名足球运动员，公众关注度非常高。
profile.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

profile.sentenceEn: The fact that she's still the second most-followed woman on Instagram suggests it's entirely possible to maintain a significant web profile to promote various projects—by way of a dedicated team—without being exposed to the cruel comments, hate mail and rape or death threats.
profile.translationZh: 事实上，她仍是Instagram上粉丝数第二多的女性，这表明完全可以通过一个专门团队来维持重要的网络形象以推广各类项目，同时避免接触那些恶毒评论、仇恨邮件以及强奸或死亡威胁。
profile.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

profile.sentenceEn: It reduces our curiosity by showing us exactly what we already want and think, based on our profiles and preferences.
profile.translationZh: 社交媒体根据我们的个人资料和偏好，精准地向我们推送我们已然想要和思考的内容，从而削弱了我们的好奇心。
profile.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

profile.sentenceEn: But a passing reference in a recent profile by Glamour magazine to her 20-hour workdays prompted an outpouring of admiration.
profile.translationZh: 但《魅力》杂志近期一篇人物专访中顺带提及她每日工作20小时，引发了人们对她的由衷赞叹。
profile.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

profile.sentenceEn: They will not be able to comprehend some of the profiles users put in.
profile.translationZh: 他们无法理解用户填写的一些个人资料。

prominent.sentenceEn: In fact, Feist's research on both artists and scientists shows that one of the most prominent features of creative folks is their lesser interest in socialising.
prominent.translationZh: 事实上，费斯特对艺术家和科学家的研究表明，富有创造力的人的一个最显著特征是他们对社交的兴趣较低。

prominent.sentenceEn: For researchers in the tenure-track system, their main goal is winning tenure, which in part can be achieved by getting a number of papers published in prominent journals.
prominent.translationZh: 对于处于终身教职轨道体系的研究人员而言，他们的主要目标是获得终身教职，而这在一定程度上要通过在知名期刊上发表多篇论文来实现。
prominent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

prominent.sentenceEn: American families and prominent business leaders are aware that there's a big problem with automation.
prominent.translationZh: 美国家庭和知名商界领袖都意识到自动化存在一个重大问题。
prominent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

prominent.sentenceEn: It's particularly striking centuries later when these issues are still prominent in public discussions about social justice and women's rights.
prominent.translationZh: 几个世纪后的今天，这些问题在关于社会正义和妇女权利的公开讨论中依然突出，这一点尤其引人注目。

prominent.sentenceEn: A number of prominent economists have also argued that it's harder for the poor to climb the economic ladder today because the rungs(横档) in that ladder have grown farther apart.
prominent.translationZh: 许多著名经济学家也认为，如今穷人更难攀登经济阶梯，因为阶梯上的横档间距变得越来越大。
prominent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

prominent.sentenceEn: Obama is only the most prominent public figure to declare inequality Public Enemy No.1 and the greatest threat to reducing poverty in America.
prominent.translationZh: 奥巴马只是宣称不平等是美国头号公敌和减贫最大威胁的最知名公众人物。
prominent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

proof.sentenceEn: The economist J. K. Galbraith once wrote, "Faced with a choice between changing one's mind and proving there is no need to do so, almost everyone gets busy with the proof ."
proof.translationZh: 经济学家J. K. 加尔布雷斯曾写道：“面对是改变自己的想法，还是证明无需改变想法的选择时，几乎每个人都会忙于证明后者。”

proof.sentenceEn: It's not only the proof of acquired knowledge but plays into the reputation game of where you were trained.
proof.translationZh: 它不仅是所学知识的证明，还关乎你所受教育机构的声誉。

proof.sentenceEn: The company might be very optimistic, but the ability of their machine to detect deception has not provided credible proof .
proof.translationZh: 该公司或许满怀乐观，但他们的机器探测欺骗的能力尚未提供可信的证据。
proof.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

proof.sentenceEn: "I think that by having people adopt a healthy lifestyle, both from a medical standpoint as well as nutritional and cognitive stimulation standpoint, we can reduce the incidence of cognitive decline, which will be proof that these factors are, in fact, important."
proof.translationZh: 我认为，通过让人们采取健康的生活方式——无论是从医疗角度，还是从营养和认知刺激角度——我们可以降低认知衰退的发生率，这将证明这些因素确实很重要。
proof.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

proof.sentenceEn: For proof of this go back to our response to the Great Recession, where we socialized losses, even as we privatized gains.
proof.translationZh: 若要证明这一点，只需回顾我们对大衰退的应对措施：我们将损失社会化，却将收益私有化。

proof.sentenceEn: No proof has been found from an extensive search that Jackson had ever owned the land where the oak tree grew.
proof.translationZh: 经过广泛调查，并未发现任何证据表明杰克逊曾拥有那棵橡树生长的土地。

protest.sentenceEn: The political limit has also been reached in some places, with citizens meeting the construction of new wind turbines with loud protests .
protest.translationZh: 在一些地方，政治层面的限制也已显现，民众对新建风力涡轮机的建设发出了强烈抗议。
protest.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第4句

protest.sentenceEn: It is time that we showed successes and accelerations in ecological awareness, action and restoration: stories that include past successes and future visions about the rise of urban gardening and of renaturalised riverscapes, of successful protests against polluted air and water, of the rise of regional markets and slow food, and the planting of trees around the globe, of initiatives and enterprises that work towards ecological restoration.
protest.translationZh: 现在是时候展示我们在生态意识、行动和恢复方面取得的成功和进展了：这些故事应包含过去的成就和未来的愿景，如城市园艺的兴起、河流景观的自然化修复、成功抗议空气和水污染的行动、区域市场和慢食运动的发展、全球植树造林，以及致力于生态恢复的各类倡议和企业。

protest.sentenceEn: Protests in heavily visited destinations suggest that traditional tourism has overstayed its welcome.
protest.translationZh: 游客密集地区的抗议活动表明，传统旅游业已不再受欢迎。
protest.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

protest.sentenceEn: Recent protests in ports of call like Venice and Barcelona against disturbances created by cruise ships show the unfortunate consequences of emphasizing quantity over quality in tourism.
protest.translationZh: 最近，在威尼斯和巴塞罗那等邮轮停靠港口爆发了反对邮轮造成干扰的抗议活动，这些事件揭示了旅游业重数量轻质量所带来的不幸后果。
protest.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

protest.sentenceEn: And despite their protests to the contrary, they have only themselves to blame.
protest.translationZh: 而且，尽管他们口口声声否认，但这只能怪他们自己。
protest.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

protest.sentenceEn: Additionally, those affected by inadequate health and social care are too vulnerable to launch the protests that have addressed other forms of discrimination.
protest.translationZh: 此外，那些受到医疗和社会护理服务不足影响的老年人过于脆弱，无法发起抗议活动，而这类抗议在应对其他形式的歧视时曾发挥作用。
protest.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句
